Number of bytes allocated and still in u.id: Jumlah byte yang dialokasikan dan masih digunakan.
Number of bytes allocated and still in u.zh: 已分配且仍在使用的字节数。
Number of bytes allocated and still in u.zh-hant: 已分配且仍在使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers.en: Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers (for ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer).
Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers.id: Jumlah byte yang dialokasikan untuk buffer IO (untuk ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer).
Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers.zh: 为 IO 缓冲区分配的字节数（对于 ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer）。
Number of bytes allocated for IO buffers.zh-hant: 為 IO 緩衝區分配的位元組數（對於 ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer）。

Number of bytes allocated for memory Are.en: Number of bytes allocated for memory Arena (used for GROUP BY and similar operations)
Number of bytes allocated for memory Are.id: Jumlah byte yang dialokasikan untuk memori Arena (digunakan untuk GROUP BY dan operasi serupa)
Number of bytes allocated for memory Are.zh: 为内存 Arena 分配的字节数（用于 GROUP BY 和类似操作）
Number of bytes allocated for memory Are.zh-hant: 為記憶體 Arena 分配的位元組數（用於 GROUP BY 和類似操作）

Number of bytes currently allocated by a.en: Number of bytes currently allocated by application.
Number of bytes currently allocated by a.id: Jumlah byte yang saat ini dialokasikan oleh aplikasi.
Number of bytes currently allocated by a.zh: 应用程序当前分配的字节数。
Number of bytes currently allocated by a.zh-hant: 應用程式目前分配的位元組數。

Number of bytes evicted from the uncompr.en: Number of bytes evicted from the uncompressed cache.
Number of bytes evicted from the uncompr.id: Jumlah byte yang dikeluarkan dari cache yang tidak terkompresi.
Number of bytes evicted from the uncompr.zh: 从未压缩缓存中逐出的字节数。
Number of bytes evicted from the uncompr.zh-hant: 从未压缩缓存中逐出的字节数。

Number of bytes flushed (from mem tables.en: Number of bytes flushed (from mem tables) into Level 0.
Number of bytes flushed (from mem tables.id: Jumlah byte yang dipindahkan (dari tabel mem) ke Level 0.
Number of bytes flushed (from mem tables.zh: （从内存表）刷新到 0 级的字节数。
Number of bytes flushed (from mem tables.zh-hant: （从内存表）刷新到 0 级的字节数。

Number of bytes from prefetched buffer.en: Number of bytes from prefetched buffer
Number of bytes from prefetched buffer.id: Jumlah byte dari buffer yang diambil sebelumnya

Number of bytes from un prefetched buffe.en: Number of bytes from un prefetched buffer
Number of bytes from un prefetched buffe.id: Jumlah byte dari buffer yang tidak diambil sebelumnya
Number of bytes from un prefetched buffe.zh: 未预取缓冲区的字节数
Number of bytes from un prefetched buffe.zh-hant: 未預取緩衝區的位元組數

Number of bytes in Raft messages receive.en: Number of bytes in Raft messages received by this store. Note that this does not include raft snapshot received.
Number of bytes in Raft messages receive.id: Jumlah byte dalam pesan Raft yang diterima oleh penyimpanan ini. Perhatikan bahwa ini tidak termasuk snapshot rakit yang diterima.
Number of bytes in Raft messages receive.zh: 该存储接收到的 Raft 消息中的字节数。请注意，这不包括收到的 raft 快照。
Number of bytes in Raft messages receive.zh-hant: 此儲存空間接收到的 Raft 訊息中的位元組數。請注意，這不包括收到的 raft 快照。

Number of bytes in Raft messages sent by.en: Number of bytes in Raft messages sent by this store. Note that this does not include raft snapshot sent.
Number of bytes in Raft messages sent by.id: Jumlah byte dalam pesan Raft yang dikirim oleh toko ini. Perhatikan bahwa ini tidak termasuk snapshot rakit yang dikirim.
Number of bytes in Raft messages sent by.zh: 该存储发送的 Raft 消息中的字节数。请注意，这不包括发送的 raft 快照。
Number of bytes in Raft messages sent by.zh-hant: 该存储发送的 Raft 消息中的字节数。请注意，这不包括发送的 raft 快照。

Number of bytes in buffers of Buffer tab.en: Number of bytes in buffers of Buffer tables
Number of bytes in buffers of Buffer tab.id: Jumlah byte dalam buffer tabel Buffer
Number of bytes in buffers of Buffer tab.zh: 缓冲区表缓冲区中的字节数
Number of bytes in buffers of Buffer tab.zh-hant: 缓冲区表缓冲区中的字节数

Number of bytes in free, mapped pages in.en: Number of bytes in free, mapped pages in page heap.
Number of bytes in free, mapped pages in.id: Jumlah byte di halaman gratis yang dipetakan di tumpukan halaman.
Number of bytes in free, mapped pages in.zh: 页堆中空闲、映射页的字节数。
Number of bytes in free, mapped pages in.zh-hant: 页堆中空闲、映射页的字节数。

Number of bytes in messages currently wa.en: Number of bytes in messages currently waiting for raft processing.
Number of bytes in messages currently wa.id: Jumlah byte dalam pesan yang sedang menunggu pemrosesan rakit.
Number of bytes in messages currently wa.zh: 当前等待 raft 处理的消息中的字节数。
Number of bytes in messages currently wa.zh-hant: 目前等待 raft 處理的訊息中的位元組數。

Number of bytes in messages processed by.en: Number of bytes in messages processed by Raft.Messages reflected here have been handed to Raft (via RawNode.Step). This does not imply that the messages are no longer held in memory or that IO has been performed.
Number of bytes in messages processed by.id: Jumlah byte dalam pesan yang diproses oleh Raft. Pesan yang ditampilkan di sini telah diserahkan ke Raft (melalui RawNode.Step). Hal ini tidak berarti bahwa pesan tidak lagi disimpan dalam memori atau IO telah dilakukan.
Number of bytes in messages processed by.zh: 这里反映的 Raft.Messages 处理的消息中的字节数已交给 Raft（通过 RawNode.Step）。这并不意味着消息不再保存在内存中或已执行 IO。
Number of bytes in messages processed by.zh-hant: 這裡反映的 Raft.Messages 處理的訊息中的位元組數已交給 Raft（透過 RawNode.Step）。這並不意味著訊息不再保存在記憶體中或已執行 IO。

Number of bytes in the abort span..en: Number of bytes in the abort span.

Number of bytes in the heap..en: Number of bytes in the heap.

Number of bytes in use by mcache structu.en: Number of bytes in use by mcache structures.
Number of bytes in use by mcache structu.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh struktur mcache.
Number of bytes in use by mcache structu.zh: mcache 结构使用的字节数。
Number of bytes in use by mcache structu.zh-hant: mcache 結構使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes in use by mspan structur.en: Number of bytes in use by mspan structures.
Number of bytes in use by mspan structur.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh struktur mspan.
Number of bytes in use by mspan structur.zh: mspan 结构使用的字节数。
Number of bytes in use by mspan structur.zh-hant: mspan 結構使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes in use by the stack allo.en: Number of bytes in use by the stack allocator.
Number of bytes in use by the stack allo.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh pengalokasi tumpukan.
Number of bytes in use by the stack allo.zh: 堆栈分配器使用的字节数。
Number of bytes in use by the stack allo.zh-hant: 堆疊分配器使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 0.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 0.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到 0 级的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到 0 級的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 1.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 1.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到级别 1 的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到等級 1 的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 2.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 2.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到级别 2 的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到等級 2 的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 3.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 3.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到第 3 级的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接摄取到第 3 级的字节数。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 4.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 4.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到级别 4 的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到等級 4 的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 5.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 5.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到第 5 级的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到第 5 級的位元組數。

Number of bytes ingested directly into L.en: Number of bytes ingested directly into Level 6.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.id: Jumlah byte yang diserap langsung ke Level 6.
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh: 直接摄取到第 6 级的字节数。
Number of bytes ingested directly into L.zh-hant: 直接攝取到第 6 級的位元組數。

Number of bytes left before syncing is c.en: Number of bytes left before syncing is complete (may be negative when master_sync_total_bytes is 0).
Number of bytes left before syncing is c.id: Jumlah byte yang tersisa sebelum sinkronisasi selesai (mungkin negatif jika master_sync_total_bytes adalah 0).
Number of bytes left before syncing is c.zh: 同步完成之前剩余的字节数（当 master_sync_total_bytes 为 0 时可能为负数）。
Number of bytes left before syncing is c.zh-hant: 同步完成之前剩餘的位元組數（當 master_sync_total_bytes 為 0 時可能為負數）。

Number of bytes observed for this flow..en: Number of bytes observed for this flow.
Number of bytes observed for this flow..id: Jumlah byte yang diamati untuk aliran ini.
Number of bytes observed for this flow..zh: 为此流观察到的字节数。
Number of bytes observed for this flow..zh-hant: 為此流觀察到的位元組數。

Number of bytes obtained from system for.en: Number of bytes obtained from system for stack allocator.
Number of bytes obtained from system for.id: Jumlah byte yang diperoleh dari sistem untuk pengalokasi tumpukan.
Number of bytes obtained from system for.zh: 从系统获取的堆栈分配器的字节数。
Number of bytes obtained from system for.zh-hant: 从系统获取的堆栈分配器的字节数。

Number of bytes obtained from system..en: Number of bytes obtained from system.
Number of bytes obtained from system..id: Jumlah byte yang diperoleh dari sistem.
Number of bytes obtained from system..zh-hant: 從系統取得的位元組數。

Number of bytes per second being sent fo.en: Number of bytes per second being sent for `XDCR` DCP connections for this bucket.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.id: Jumlah byte per detik yang dikirim untuk koneksi DCP `XDCR` untuk bucket ini.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh: 此存储桶的“XDCR”DCP 连接每秒发送的字节数。
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh-hant: 此儲存桶的“XDCR”DCP 連線每秒發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes per second being sent fo.en: Number of bytes per second being sent for indexes DCP connections.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.id: Jumlah byte per detik yang dikirim untuk koneksi indeks DCP.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh: 每秒为索引 DCP 连接发送的字节数。
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh-hant: 每秒為索引 DCP 連線發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes per second being sent fo.en: Number of bytes per second being sent for other DCP connections for this bucket.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.id: Jumlah byte per detik yang dikirim untuk koneksi DCP lain untuk bucket ini.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh: 此存储桶的其他 DCP 连接每秒发送的字节数。
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh-hant: 此儲存桶的其他 DCP 連線每秒發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes per second being sent fo.en: Number of bytes per second being sent for replication DCP connections for this bucket.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.id: Jumlah byte per detik yang dikirim untuk replikasi koneksi DCP untuk bucket ini.
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh: 每秒为此存储桶的复制 DCP 连接发送的字节数。
Number of bytes per second being sent fo.zh-hant: 每秒為此儲存桶的複製 DCP 連線發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes read from disks or block.en: Number of bytes read from disks or block devices. Does not include bytes read from page cache. May include excessive data due to block size, `readahead`, etc.
Number of bytes read from disks or block.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dari disk atau perangkat blok. Tidak termasuk byte yang dibaca dari cache halaman. Mungkin berisi data berlebihan karena ukuran blok, `readahead`, dll.
Number of bytes read from disks or block.zh: 从磁盘或块设备读取的字节数。不包括从页面缓存读取的字节。由于块大小、“预读”等原因，可能包含过多的数据。
Number of bytes read from disks or block.zh-hant: 從磁碟或區塊設備讀取的位元組數。不包括從頁面快取讀取的位元組。由於區塊大小、「預讀」等原因，可能包含過多的資料。

Number of bytes read from file descripto.en: Number of bytes read from file descriptors. If the file is compressed, this will show the compressed data size.
Number of bytes read from file descripto.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dari deskriptor file. Jika file dikompres, ini akan menampilkan ukuran data yang dikompresi.
Number of bytes read from file descripto.zh: 从文件描述符读取的字节数。如果文件被压缩，这将显示压缩数据的大小。
Number of bytes read from file descripto.zh-hant: 從檔案描述符讀取的位元組數。如果檔案被壓縮，這將顯示壓縮資料的大小。

Number of bytes read from filesystem, in.en: Number of bytes read from filesystem, including page cache.
Number of bytes read from filesystem, in.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dari sistem file, termasuk cache halaman.
Number of bytes read from filesystem, in.zh: 从文件系统读取的字节数，包括页面缓存。
Number of bytes read from filesystem, in.zh-hant: 從檔案系統讀取的位元組數，包括頁面快取。

Number of bytes read from temporary disk.en: Number of bytes read from temporary disk storage as a result of spilling.
Number of bytes read from temporary disk.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dari penyimpanan disk sementara akibat tumpah.
Number of bytes read from temporary disk.zh: 由于溢出而从临时磁盘存储中读取的字节数。
Number of bytes read from temporary disk.zh-hant: 由於溢位而從臨時磁碟儲存中讀取的位元組數。

Number of bytes read from the NFS server.en: Number of bytes read from the NFS server, in total.
Number of bytes read from the NFS server.id: Jumlah total byte yang dibaca dari server NFS.
Number of bytes read from the NFS server.zh: 从 NFS 服务器读取的总字节数。
Number of bytes read from the NFS server.zh-hant: 從 NFS 伺服器讀取的總位元組數。

Number of bytes read from the block devi.en: Number of bytes read from the block device. It can be lower than the number of bytes read from the filesystem due to the usage of the OS page cache, that saves IO. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. Source: `/sys/block`.
Number of bytes read from the block devi.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dari perangkat blok. Ini bisa lebih rendah dari jumlah byte yang dibaca dari sistem file karena penggunaan cache halaman OS, yang menghemat IO. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Sumber: `/sys/block`.
Number of bytes read from the block devi.zh: 从块设备读取的字节数。由于使用了操作系统页面缓存，它可以低于从文件系统读取的字节数，从而节省 IO。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。来源：`/sys/block`。
Number of bytes read from the block devi.zh-hant: 從區塊設備讀取的位元組數。由於使用了作業系統頁面緩存，它可以低於從檔案系統讀取的位元組數，從而節省 IO。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。來源：`/sys/block`。

Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.en: Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolReader when it was done from page cache.
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca di dalam ThreadPoolReader ketika dilakukan dari cache halaman.
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.zh: 从页面缓存完成时，ThreadPoolReader 内部读取的字节数。
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.zh-hant: 從頁面快取完成時，ThreadPoolReader 內部讀取的位元組數。

Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.en: Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolReader when read was not done from page cache and was hand off to thread pool.
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca di dalam ThreadPoolReader ketika pembacaan tidak dilakukan dari cache halaman dan diserahkan ke kumpulan thread.
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.zh: 当读取未从页面缓存完成并移交给线程池时，ThreadPoolReader 内部读取的字节数。
Number of bytes read inside ThreadPoolRe.zh-hant: 當讀取未從頁面快取完成並移交給執行緒池時，ThreadPoolReader 內部讀取的位元組數。

Number of bytes read recently per second.en: Number of bytes read recently per second, considering the last 30 minutes.
Number of bytes read recently per second.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca baru-baru ini per detik, mengingat 30 menit terakhir.
Number of bytes read recently per second.zh: 最近每秒读取的字节数（考虑过去 30 分钟）。
Number of bytes read recently per second.zh-hant: 最近每秒讀取的位元組數（考慮過去 30 分鐘）。

Number of bytes read using the read() sy.en: Number of bytes read using the read() syscall in O_DIRECT mode.
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca menggunakan syscall read() dalam mode O_DIRECT.
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.zh: 在 O_DIRECT 模式下使用 read() 系统调用读取的字节数。
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.zh-hant: 在 O_DIRECT 模式下使用 read() 系統呼叫讀取的位元組數。

Number of bytes read using the read() sy.en: Number of bytes read using the read() syscall.
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca menggunakan syscall read().
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.zh: 使用 read() 系统调用读取的字节数。
Number of bytes read using the read() sy.zh-hant: 使用 read() 系統呼叫讀取的位元組數。

Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeB.en: Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface
Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeB.id: Jumlah byte yang dibaca dengan antarmuka Linux atau FreeBSD AIO
Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeB.zh: 使用 Linux 或 FreeBSD AIO 接口读取的字节数
Number of bytes read with Linux or FreeB.zh-hant: 使用 Linux 或 FreeBSD AIO 介面讀取的位元組數

Number of bytes received by the socket..en: Number of bytes received by the socket.
Number of bytes received by the socket..id: Jumlah byte yang diterima oleh soket.
Number of bytes received by the socket..zh: 套接字接收到的字节数。
Number of bytes received by the socket..zh-hant: 套接字接收到的位元組數。

Number of bytes received by this store f.en: Number of bytes received by this store for cross region Raft messages (when region tiers are configured). Note that this does not include raft snapshot received.
Number of bytes received by this store f.id: Jumlah byte yang diterima oleh penyimpanan ini untuk pesan Raft lintas wilayah (saat tingkat wilayah dikonfigurasi). Perhatikan bahwa ini tidak termasuk snapshot rakit yang diterima.
Number of bytes received by this store f.zh: 此存储接收的跨区域 Raft 消息的字节数（配置区域层时）。请注意，这不包括收到的 raft 快照。
Number of bytes received by this store f.zh-hant: 此儲存空間接收的跨區域 Raft 訊息的位元組數（配置區域層時）。請注意，這不包括收到的 raft 快照。

Number of bytes received by this store f.en: Number of bytes received by this store for cross zone, same region Raft messages (when region and zone tiers are configured). If region tiers are not configured, this count may include data sent between different regions.
Number of bytes received by this store f.id: Jumlah byte yang diterima oleh penyimpanan ini untuk pesan Raft lintas zona dan wilayah yang sama (bila tingkat wilayah dan zona dikonfigurasi). Jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi, penghitungan ini mungkin mencakup data yang dikirim antar wilayah berbeda.
Number of bytes received by this store f.zh: 此存储接收的跨区域、同一区域 Raft 消息的字节数（当配置了区域和区域层时）。如果未配置区域层，则此计数可能包括不同区域之间发送的数据。
Number of bytes received by this store f.zh-hant: 此儲存空間接收的跨區域、同一區域 Raft 訊息的位元組數（當配置了區域和區域層時）。如果未配置區域層，則此計數可能包括在不同區域之間發送的資料。

Number of bytes received for a given ope.en: Number of bytes received for a given operation, including RPC headers and payload.
Number of bytes received for a given ope.id: Jumlah byte yang diterima untuk operasi tertentu, termasuk header RPC dan payload.
Number of bytes received for a given ope.zh: 给定操作接收到的字节数，包括 RPC 标头和负载。
Number of bytes received for a given ope.zh-hant: 給定操作接收到的位元組數，包括 RPC 標頭和負載。

Number of bytes received over network wh.en: Number of bytes received over network while communicating with ZooKeeper.
Number of bytes received over network wh.id: Jumlah byte yang diterima melalui jaringan saat berkomunikasi dengan ZooKeeper.
Number of bytes received over network wh.zh: 与 ZooKeeper 通信时通过网络接收的字节数。
Number of bytes received over network wh.zh-hant: 與 ZooKeeper 通訊時透過網路接收的位元組數。

Number of bytes received via the network.en: Number of bytes received via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
Number of bytes received via the network.id: Jumlah byte yang diterima melalui antarmuka jaringan. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
Number of bytes received via the network.zh: 通过网络接口接收的字节数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
Number of bytes received via the network.zh-hant: 透過網路介面接收的位元組數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

Number of bytes send over network while.en: Number of bytes send over network while communicating with ZooKeeper.
Number of bytes send over network while.id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim melalui jaringan saat berkomunikasi dengan ZooKeeper.
Number of bytes send over network while.zh: 与 ZooKeeper 通信时通过网络发送的字节数。
Number of bytes send over network while.zh-hant: 與 ZooKeeper 通訊時透過網路發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes sent by the socket..en: Number of bytes sent by the socket.
Number of bytes sent by the socket..id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim oleh soket.
Number of bytes sent by the socket..zh-hant: 套接字發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes sent by this store for c.en: Number of bytes sent by this store for cross region Raft messages (when region tiers are configured). Note that this does not include raft snapshot sent.
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim oleh penyimpanan ini untuk pesan Raft lintas wilayah (saat tingkat wilayah dikonfigurasi). Perhatikan bahwa ini tidak termasuk snapshot rakit yang dikirim.
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.zh: 此存储为跨区域 Raft 消息发送的字节数（配置区域层时）。请注意，这不包括发送的 raft 快照。
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.zh-hant: 此儲存為跨區域 Raft 訊息發送的位元組數（配置區域層時）。請注意，這不包括發送的 raft 快照。

Number of bytes sent by this store for c.en: Number of bytes sent by this store for cross zone, same region Raft messages (when region and zone tiers are configured). If region tiers are not configured, this count may include data sent between different regions. To ensure accurate monitoring of transmitted data, it is important to set up a consistent locality configuration across nodes. Note that this does not include raft snapshot sent.
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim oleh penyimpanan ini untuk pesan Raft lintas zona dan wilayah yang sama (bila tingkat wilayah dan zona dikonfigurasi). Jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi, penghitungan ini mungkin mencakup data yang dikirim antar wilayah berbeda. Untuk memastikan pemantauan data yang dikirimkan secara akurat, penting untuk menyiapkan konfigurasi lokalitas yang konsisten di seluruh node. Perhatikan bahwa ini tidak termasuk snapshot rakit yang dikirim.
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.zh: 该存储为跨区域、同一区域 Raft 消息发送的字节数（当配置了区域和区域层时）。如果未配置区域层，则此计数可能包括不同区域之间发送的数据。为了确保准确监控传输的数据，跨节点设置一致的局部性配置非常重要。请注意，这不包括发送的 raft 快照。
Number of bytes sent by this store for c.zh-hant: 此儲存為跨區域、同一區域 Raft 訊息發送的位元組數（當配置了區域和區域層時）。如果未配置區域層，則此計數可能包括在不同區域之間發送的資料。為了確保準確監控傳輸的數據，跨節點設定一致的局部性配置非常重要。請注意，這不包括發送的 raft 快照。

Number of bytes sent for a given operati.en: Number of bytes sent for a given operation, including RPC headers and payload.
Number of bytes sent for a given operati.id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim untuk operasi tertentu, termasuk header RPC dan payload.
Number of bytes sent for a given operati.zh: 为给定操作发送的字节数，包括 RPC 标头和负载。
Number of bytes sent for a given operati.zh-hant: 為給定操作發送的位元組數，包括 RPC 標頭和負載。

Number of bytes sent via the network int.en: Number of bytes sent via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
Number of bytes sent via the network int.id: Jumlah byte yang dikirim melalui antarmuka jaringan. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
Number of bytes sent via the network int.zh: 通过网络接口发送的字节数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
Number of bytes sent via the network int.zh-hant: 透過網路介面發送的位元組數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

Number of bytes taken up by range key va.en: Number of bytes taken up by range key values (e.g. Multi-Version Concurrency Control range tombstones).
Number of bytes taken up by range key va.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan berdasarkan nilai kunci rentang (misalnya batu nisan rentang Kontrol Konkurensi Multi-Versi).
Number of bytes taken up by range key va.zh: 范围键值占用的字节数（例如多版本并发控制范围逻辑删除）。
Number of bytes taken up by range key va.zh-hant: 範圍鍵值所佔用的位元組數（例如多版本並發控制範圍邏輯刪除）。

Number of bytes taken up by range keys (.en: Number of bytes taken up by range keys (e.g. Multi-Version Concurrency Control range tombstones).
Number of bytes taken up by range keys (.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh kunci rentang (misalnya batu nisan rentang Kontrol Konkurensi Multi-Versi).
Number of bytes taken up by range keys (.zh: 范围键占用的字节数（例如多版本并发控制范围逻辑删除）。
Number of bytes taken up by range keys (.zh-hant: 範圍鍵佔用的位元組數（例如多版本並發控制範圍邏輯刪除）。

Number of bytes taken up by replicated l.en: Number of bytes taken up by replicated lock key-values (shared and exclusive strength, not intent strength).
Number of bytes taken up by replicated l.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh nilai kunci kunci yang direplikasi (kekuatan bersama dan eksklusif, bukan kekuatan maksud).
Number of bytes taken up by replicated l.zh: 复制锁键值占用的字节数（共享和独占强度，而不是意图强度）。
Number of bytes taken up by replicated l.zh-hant: 複製鎖鍵值所佔用的位元組數（共享和獨佔強度，而不是意圖強度）。

Number of bytes that Redis allocated as.en: Number of bytes that Redis allocated as seen by the operating system (a.k.a *Resident Set Size*).
Number of bytes that Redis allocated as.id: Jumlah byte yang dialokasikan Redis seperti yang terlihat oleh sistem operasi (alias *Resident Set Size*).
Number of bytes that Redis allocated as.zh: 操作系统看到的 Redis 分配的字节数（也称为“驻留集大小”）。
Number of bytes that Redis allocated as.zh-hant: 作業系統看到的 Redis 分配的位元組數（也稱為「駐留集合大小」）。

Number of bytes this server is allowed t.en: Number of bytes this server is allowed to use for storage
Number of bytes this server is allowed t.id: Jumlah byte yang boleh digunakan server ini untuk penyimpanan
Number of bytes this server is allowed t.zh: 该服务器允许用于存储的字节数
Number of bytes this server is allowed t.zh-hant: 該伺服器允許用於儲存的位元組數

Number of bytes used across all thread c.en: Number of bytes used across all thread caches.
Number of bytes used across all thread c.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan di semua cache thread.
Number of bytes used across all thread c.zh: 所有线程缓存使用的字节数。
Number of bytes used across all thread c.zh-hant: 所有執行緒快取使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes used by cached Lua scrip.en: Number of bytes used by cached Lua scripts.
Number of bytes used by cached Lua scrip.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh skrip Lua yang di-cache.
Number of bytes used by cached Lua scrip.zh: 缓存的 Lua 脚本使用的字节数。
Number of bytes used by cached Lua scrip.zh-hant: 快取的 Lua 腳本使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes used by the Lua engine..en: Number of bytes used by the Lua engine.
Number of bytes used by the Lua engine..id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh mesin Lua.
Number of bytes used by the Lua engine..zh: Lua 引擎使用的字节数。
Number of bytes used by the Lua engine..zh-hant: Lua 引擎使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes used by the profiling bu.en: Number of bytes used by the profiling bucket hash table.
Number of bytes used by the profiling bu.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan oleh tabel hash keranjang pembuatan profil.
Number of bytes used by the profiling bu.zh: 分析桶哈希表使用的字节数。
Number of bytes used by the profiling bu.zh-hant: 分析桶哈希表使用的位元組數。

Number of bytes used for expressions com.en: Number of bytes used for expressions compilation.
Number of bytes used for expressions com.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan untuk kompilasi ekspresi.
Number of bytes used for expressions com.zh: 用于表达式编译的字节数。
Number of bytes used for expressions com.zh-hant: 用於表達式編譯的位元組數。

Number of bytes used for garbage collect.en: Number of bytes used for garbage collection system metadata.
Number of bytes used for garbage collect.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan untuk metadata sistem pengumpulan sampah.
Number of bytes used for garbage collect.zh: 用于垃圾收集系统元数据的字节数。
Number of bytes used for garbage collect.zh-hant: 用於垃圾收集系統元資料的位元組數。

Number of bytes used for mcache structur.en: Number of bytes used for mcache structures obtained from system.
Number of bytes used for mcache structur.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan untuk struktur mcache yang diperoleh dari sistem.
Number of bytes used for mcache structur.zh: 从系统获取的用于 mcache 结构的字节数。
Number of bytes used for mcache structur.zh-hant: 從系統取得的用於 mcache 結構的位元組數。

Number of bytes used for mspan structure.en: Number of bytes used for mspan structures obtained from system.
Number of bytes used for mspan structure.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan untuk struktur mspan yang diperoleh dari sistem.
Number of bytes used for mspan structure.zh: 从系统获取的用于 mspan 结构的字节数。
Number of bytes used for mspan structure.zh-hant: 從系統取得的用於 mspan 結構的位元組數。

Number of bytes used for other system al.en: Number of bytes used for other system allocations.
Number of bytes used for other system al.id: Jumlah byte yang digunakan untuk alokasi sistem lainnya.
Number of bytes used for other system al.zh: 用于其他系统分配的字节数。
Number of bytes used for other system al.zh-hant: 用於其他系統分配的位元組數。

Number of bytes waiting to be sent by th.en: Number of bytes waiting to be sent by the socket.
Number of bytes waiting to be sent by th.id: Jumlah byte yang menunggu untuk dikirim oleh soket.
Number of bytes waiting to be sent by th.zh: 等待套接字发送的字节数。
Number of bytes waiting to be sent by th.zh-hant: 等待套接字發送的位元組數。

Number of bytes written recently per sec.en: Number of bytes written recently per second, considering the last 30 minutes.
Number of bytes written recently per sec.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis baru-baru ini per detik, mengingat 30 menit terakhir.
Number of bytes written recently per sec.zh: 最近每秒写入的字节数（考虑过去 30 分钟）。
Number of bytes written recently per sec.zh-hant: 最近每秒寫入的位元組數（考慮過去 30 分鐘）。

Number of bytes written to disk for aggr.en: Number of bytes written to disk for aggregation in external memory.
Number of bytes written to disk for aggr.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke disk untuk diagregasi di memori eksternal.
Number of bytes written to disk for aggr.zh: 写入磁盘以在外部存储器中聚合的字节数。
Number of bytes written to disk for aggr.zh-hant: 寫入磁碟以在外部記憶體中聚合的位元組數。

Number of bytes written to disks or bloc.en: Number of bytes written to disks or block devices. Does not include bytes that are in page cache dirty pages. May not include data that was written by OS asynchronously.
Number of bytes written to disks or bloc.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke disk atau perangkat blok. Tidak termasuk byte yang ada di halaman cache halaman kotor. Tidak boleh menyertakan data yang ditulis oleh OS secara asinkron.
Number of bytes written to disks or bloc.zh: 写入磁盘或块设备的字节数。不包括页缓存脏页中的字节。可能不包括操作系统异步写入的数据。
Number of bytes written to disks or bloc.zh-hant: 寫入磁碟或區塊設備的位元組數。不包括頁快取髒頁中的位元組。可能不包括作業系統非同步寫入的資料。

Number of bytes written to file descript.en: Number of bytes written to file descriptors. If the file is compressed, this will show compressed data size.
Number of bytes written to file descript.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke deskriptor file. Jika file dikompresi, ini akan menampilkan ukuran data terkompresi.
Number of bytes written to file descript.zh: 写入文件描述符的字节数。如果文件被压缩，这将显示压缩数据的大小。
Number of bytes written to file descript.zh-hant: 寫入檔案描述符的位元組數。如果檔案被壓縮，這將顯示壓縮資料的大小。

Number of bytes written to filesystem, i.en: Number of bytes written to filesystem, including page cache.
Number of bytes written to filesystem, i.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke sistem file, termasuk cache halaman.
Number of bytes written to filesystem, i.zh: 写入文件系统的字节数，包括页面缓存。
Number of bytes written to filesystem, i.zh-hant: 寫入檔案系統的位元組數，包括頁面快取。

Number of bytes written to temporary dis.en: Number of bytes written to temporary disk storage as a result of spilling.
Number of bytes written to temporary dis.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke penyimpanan disk sementara akibat tumpah.
Number of bytes written to temporary dis.zh: 由于溢出而写入临时磁盘存储的字节数。
Number of bytes written to temporary dis.zh-hant: 由於溢出而寫入臨時磁碟儲存的位元組數。

Number of bytes written to the InnoDB lo.en: Number of bytes written to the InnoDB log.
Number of bytes written to the InnoDB lo.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke log InnoDB.
Number of bytes written to the InnoDB lo.zh: 写入 InnoDB 日志的字节数。
Number of bytes written to the InnoDB lo.zh-hant: 寫入 InnoDB 日誌的位元組數。

Number of bytes written to the NFS serve.en: Number of bytes written to the NFS server, in total.
Number of bytes written to the NFS serve.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditulis ke server NFS.
Number of bytes written to the NFS serve.zh: 写入 NFS 服务器的总字节数。
Number of bytes written to the NFS serve.zh-hant: 寫入 NFS 伺服器的總位元組數。

Number of bytes written to the block dev.en: Number of bytes written to the block device. It can be lower than the number of bytes written to the filesystem due to the usage of the OS page cache, that saves IO. A write to the block device may happen later than the corresponding write to the filesystem due to write-through caching. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. Source: `/sys/block`.
Number of bytes written to the block dev.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis ke perangkat blok. Ini bisa lebih rendah dari jumlah byte yang ditulis ke sistem file karena penggunaan cache halaman OS, yang menghemat IO. Penulisan ke perangkat blok mungkin terjadi lebih lambat dari penulisan yang terkait ke sistem file karena cache write-through. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Sumber: `/sys/block`.
Number of bytes written to the block dev.zh: 写入块设备的字节数。由于使用了操作系统页面缓存，它可以低于写入文件系统的字节数，从而节省 IO。由于直写式缓存，对块设备的写入可能会晚于对文件系统的相应写入。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。来源：`/sys/block`。
Number of bytes written to the block dev.zh-hant: 寫入區塊設備的位元組數。由於使用了作業系統頁面緩存，它可以低於寫入檔案系統的位元組數，從而節省 IO。由於直寫式緩存，對塊設備的寫入可能會晚於對檔案系統的相應寫入。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。來源：`/sys/block`。

Number of bytes written using the write(.en: Number of bytes written using the write() syscall in O_DIRECT mode.
Number of bytes written using the write(.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis menggunakan syscall write() dalam mode O_DIRECT.
Number of bytes written using the write(.zh: 在 O_DIRECT 模式下使用 write() 系统调用写入的字节数。
Number of bytes written using the write(.zh-hant: 在 O_DIRECT 模式下使用 write() 系統呼叫寫入的位元組數。

Number of bytes written using the write(.en: Number of bytes written using the write() syscall.
Number of bytes written using the write(.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis menggunakan syscall write().
Number of bytes written using the write(.zh: 使用 write() 系统调用写入的字节数。
Number of bytes written using the write(.zh-hant: 使用 write() 系統呼叫寫入的位元組數。

Number of bytes written with Linux or Fr.en: Number of bytes written with Linux or FreeBSD AIO interface
Number of bytes written with Linux or Fr.id: Jumlah byte yang ditulis dengan antarmuka Linux atau FreeBSD AIO
Number of bytes written with Linux or Fr.zh: 使用 Linux 或 FreeBSD AIO 接口写入的字节数
Number of bytes written with Linux or Fr.zh-hant: 使用 Linux 或 FreeBSD AIO 介面寫入的位元組數

Number of cache evictions across all cac.en: Number of cache evictions across all caches since this node has been running.
Number of cache evictions across all cac.id: Jumlah penggusuran cache di semua cache sejak node ini berjalan.
Number of cache evictions across all cac.zh: 自该节点运行以来所有缓存中的缓存逐出次数。
Number of cache evictions across all cac.zh-hant: 自該節點運行以來所有緩存中的緩存逐出次數。

Number of cache evictions for the curren.en: Number of cache evictions for the current index searcher.
Number of cache evictions for the curren.id: Jumlah penggusuran cache untuk pencari indeks saat ini.
Number of cache evictions for the curren.zh: 当前索引搜索器的缓存逐出次数。
Number of cache evictions for the curren.zh-hant: 目前索引搜尋器的快取逐出次數。

Number of cache hits across all the cach.en: Number of cache hits across all the caches since this node has been running.
Number of cache hits across all the cach.id: Jumlah cache yang ditemukan di semua cache sejak node ini berjalan.
Number of cache hits across all the cach.zh: 自该节点运行以来所有缓存的缓存命中次数。
Number of cache hits across all the cach.zh-hant: 自該節點運行以來所有快取的快取命中次數。

Number of cache insertions across all th.en: Number of cache insertions across all the caches since this node has been running.
Number of cache insertions across all th.id: Jumlah penyisipan cache di semua cache sejak node ini berjalan.
Number of cache insertions across all th.zh: 自该节点运行以来所有缓存中的缓存插入次数。
Number of cache insertions across all th.zh-hant: 自該節點運行以來所有快取中的快取插入次數。

Number of cache lookups across all the c.en: Number of cache lookups across all the caches since this node has been running.
Number of cache lookups across all the c.id: Jumlah pencarian cache di semua cache sejak node ini berjalan.
Number of cache lookups across all the c.zh: 自该节点运行以来在所有缓存中的缓存查找次数。
Number of cache lookups across all the c.zh-hant: 自該節點運行以來在所有快取中的快取查找次數。

Number of cache lookups in the Raft entr.en: Number of cache lookups in the Raft entry cache.
Number of cache lookups in the Raft entr.id: Jumlah pencarian cache di cache entri Raft.
Number of cache lookups in the Raft entr.zh: Raft 条目缓存中的缓存查找次数。
Number of cache lookups in the Raft entr.zh-hant: Raft 條目快取中的快取查找次數。

Number of cache objects in the cache..en: Number of cache objects in the cache.
Number of cache objects in the cache..zh: 缓存中缓存对象的数量。
Number of cache objects in the cache..zh-hant: 快取中緩存物件的數量。

Number of calls to IsAlive that do not r.en: Number of calls to IsAlive that do not return from the cache.
Number of calls to IsAlive that do not r.id: Jumlah panggilan ke IsAlive yang tidak kembali dari cache.
Number of calls to IsAlive that do not r.zh: 未从缓存返回的 IsAlive 调用数。
Number of calls to IsAlive that do not r.zh-hant: 未從快取傳回的 IsAlive 呼叫數。

Number of calls to IsAlive that return f.en: Number of calls to IsAlive that return from the cache.
Number of calls to IsAlive that return f.id: Jumlah panggilan ke IsAlive yang kembali dari cache.
Number of calls to IsAlive that return f.zh: 从缓存返回的 IsAlive 调用次数。
Number of calls to IsAlive that return f.zh-hant: 從快取返回的 IsAlive 呼叫次數。

Number of calls to delete sessions which.en: Number of calls to delete sessions which have been performed.
Number of calls to delete sessions which.id: Jumlah panggilan untuk menghapus sesi yang telah dilakukan.
Number of calls to delete sessions which.zh: 已执行的删除会话调用次数。
Number of calls to delete sessions which.zh-hant: 已執行的刪除會話呼叫次數。

Number of change feed jobs currently con.en: Number of change feed jobs currently considered Idle and can be freely shut down.
Number of change feed jobs currently con.id: Jumlah pekerjaan umpan perubahan yang saat ini dianggap Menganggur dan dapat dihentikan secara bebas.
Number of change feed jobs currently con.zh: 当前被视为空闲且可以自由关闭的更改源作业数量。
Number of change feed jobs currently con.zh-hant: 目前被視為空閒且可以自由關閉的更改來源作業數量。

Number of change feed jobs currently con.en: Number of change feed jobs currently considered Paused.
Number of change feed jobs currently con.id: Jumlah tugas umpan perubahan yang saat ini dianggap Dijeda.
Number of change feed jobs currently con.zh: 当前被视为已暂停的变更源作业数量。
Number of change feed jobs currently con.zh-hant: 目前被視為已暫停的變更來源作業數量。

Number of discard operations requested f.en: Number of discard operations requested from the block device and merged together by the OS IO scheduler. These operations are relevant for SSD. Discard operations are not used by ClickHouse, but can be used by other processes on the system. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. Source: `/sys/block`.
Number of discard operations requested f.id: Jumlah operasi pembuangan yang diminta dari perangkat blok dan digabungkan bersama oleh penjadwal OS IO. Operasi ini relevan untuk SSD. Operasi pembuangan tidak digunakan oleh ClickHouse, namun dapat digunakan oleh proses lain pada sistem. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Sumber: `/sys/block`.
Number of discard operations requested f.zh: 从块设备请求并由 OS IO 调度程序合并在一起的丢弃操作的数量。这些操作与SSD相关。丢弃操作不被 ClickHouse 使用，但可以被系统上的其他进程使用。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。来源：`/sys/block`。
Number of discard operations requested f.zh-hant: 從區塊設備請求並由 OS IO 調度程序合併在一起的丟棄操作的數量。這些操作與SSD相關。丟棄操作不被 ClickHouse 使用，但可以被系統上的其他程序使用。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。來源：`/sys/block`。

Number of discard operations requested f.en: Number of discard operations requested from the block device. These operations are relevant for SSD. Number of discard operations requested f.id: Jumlah operasi pembuangan yang diminta dari perangkat blok. Operasi ini relevan untuk SSD. Number of discarded bytes on the block d.en: Number of discarded bytes on the block device. These operations are relevant for SSD. Number of failed replicator changes work.zh-hant: 失敗的複製器會變更工作佇列的數量。

Number of failed replicator workers..zh: 失败的复制器工作线程数。
Number of failed replicator workers..zh-hant: 失敗的複製器工作執行緒數。

Number of failed streaming HTTP response.en: Number of failed streaming HTTP responses received by the replicator.
Number of failed streaming HTTP response.id: Jumlah respons HTTP streaming gagal yang diterima oleh replikator.
Number of failed streaming HTTP response.zh: 复制器收到的失败的流式 HTTP 响应数。
Number of failed streaming HTTP response.zh-hant: 複製器收到的失敗的串流 HTTP 回應數。

Number of failed transaction ID resoluti.en: Number of failed transaction ID resolution attempts.
Number of failed transaction ID resoluti.id: Jumlah upaya penyelesaian ID transaksi yang gagal.
Number of failed transaction ID resoluti.zh: 失败的事务 ID 解析尝试次数。
Number of failed transaction ID resoluti.zh-hant: 失敗的交易 ID 解析嘗試次數。

Number of failover operations that compl.en: Number of failover operations that completed for this Couchbase node.
Number of failover operations that compl.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang diselesaikan untuk node Couchbase ini.
Number of failover operations that compl.zh: 此 Couchbase 节点完成的故障转移操作数。
Number of failover operations that compl.zh-hant: 此 Couchbase 節點完成的故障轉移操作數。

Number of failover operations that did n.en: Number of failover operations that did not complete for this Couchbase node.
Number of failover operations that did n.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang tidak selesai untuk node Couchbase ini.
Number of failover operations that did n.zh: 此 Couchbase 节点未完成的故障转移操作数。
Number of failover operations that did n.zh-hant: 此 Couchbase 節點未完成的故障轉移操作數。

Number of failover operations triggered.en: Number of failover operations triggered for this Couchbase node.
Number of failover operations triggered.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang dipicu untuk node Couchbase ini.
Number of failover operations triggered.zh: 为此 Couchbase 节点触发的故障转移操作数。
Number of failover operations triggered.zh-hant: 為此 Couchbase 節點觸發的故障轉移操作數。

Number of fatal level log events.en: Number of fatal level log events
Number of fatal level log events.zh: 致命级别日志事件的数量
Number of fatal level log events.zh-hant: 致命等級日誌事件的數量

Number of fetch operations currently run.en: Number of fetch operations currently running.
Number of fetch operations currently run.id: Jumlah operasi pengambilan yang sedang berjalan.
Number of fetch operations currently run.zh: 当前正在运行的获取操作数。
Number of fetch operations currently run.zh-hant: 目前正在運行的獲取操作數。

Number of fetch operations currently run.en: Number of fetch operations currently running. Only for the primary shards.
Number of fetch operations currently run.id: Jumlah operasi pengambilan yang sedang berjalan. Hanya untuk pecahan utama.
Number of fetch operations currently run.zh: 当前正在运行的获取操作数。仅适用于主分片。
Number of fetch operations currently run.zh-hant: 目前正在運行的獲取操作數。僅適用於主分片。

Number of file descriptors CouchDB has o.en: Number of file descriptors CouchDB has open.
Number of file descriptors CouchDB has o.id: Jumlah deskriptor file yang dibuka CouchDB.
Number of file descriptors CouchDB has o.zh: CouchDB 已打开的文件描述符数量。
Number of file descriptors CouchDB has o.zh-hant: CouchDB 已開啟的檔案描述符數量。

Number of file descriptors used as socke.en: Number of file descriptors used as sockets
Number of file descriptors used as socke.id: Jumlah deskriptor file yang digunakan sebagai soket
Number of file descriptors used as socke.zh: 用作套接字的文件描述符的数量
Number of file descriptors used as socke.zh-hant: 用作套接字的文件描述符的數量

Number of file descriptors used by the s.en: Number of file descriptors used by the system resource group.
Number of file descriptors used by the s.id: Jumlah deskriptor file yang digunakan oleh grup sumber daya sistem.
Number of file descriptors used by the s.zh: 系统资源组使用的文件描述符的数量。
Number of file descriptors used by the s.zh-hant: 系統資源組使用的檔案描述符的數量。

Number of files for asynchronous inserti.en: Number of files for asynchronous insertion into Distributed tables that has been marked as broken. This metric will starts from 0 on start. Number of files for every shard is summed.
Number of files for asynchronous inserti.id: Jumlah file untuk penyisipan asinkron ke dalam tabel terdistribusi yang telah ditandai sebagai rusak. Metrik ini akan dimulai dari 0 pada awalnya. Jumlah file untuk setiap pecahan dijumlahkan.
Number of files for asynchronous inserti.zh: 用于异步插入已标记为损坏的分布式表的文件数。该指标将从 0 开始。每个分片的文件数量相加。
Number of files for asynchronous inserti.zh-hant: 用於非同步插入已標記為損壞的分散式表的檔案數。該指標將從 0 開始。每個分片的檔案數量相加。

Number of files open for reading.en: Number of files open for reading
Number of files open for reading.id: Jumlah file yang terbuka untuk dibaca

Number of files open for writing.en: Number of files open for writing
Number of files open for writing.id: Jumlah file yang dibuka untuk ditulis
Number of files open for writing.zh: 打开用于写入的文件数
Number of files open for writing.zh-hant: 開啟用於寫入的檔案數

Number of files used by external process.en: Number of files used by external processing (sorting/aggravating/joining)
Number of files used by external process.id: Jumlah file yang digunakan oleh pemrosesan eksternal (penyortiran/memperparah/penggabungan)
Number of files used by external process.zh: 外部处理使用的文件数（排序/加重/合并）
Number of files used by external process.zh-hant: 外部處理使用的文件數（排序/加重/合併）

Number of finalized transaction cleanup.en: Number of finalized transaction cleanup failures. Transaction cleanup refers to the process of resolving all of a transactions intents and then garbage collecting its transaction record.
Number of finalized transaction cleanup.id: Jumlah kegagalan pembersihan transaksi yang diselesaikan. Pembersihan transaksi mengacu pada proses penyelesaian semua maksud transaksi dan kemudian pengumpulan sampah catatan transaksinya.
Number of finalized transaction cleanup.zh: 最终事务清理失败的数量。事务清理是指解析所有事务意图，然后对其事务记录进行垃圾收集的过程。
Number of finalized transaction cleanup.zh-hant: 最終事務清理失敗的數量。事務清理是指解析所有事務意圖，然後對其事務記錄進行垃圾收集的過程。

Number of fingerprint statistics being d.en: Number of fingerprint statistics being discarded.
Number of fingerprint statistics being d.id: Jumlah statistik sidik jari yang dibuang.
Number of fingerprint statistics being d.zh: 被丢弃的指纹统计数量。
Number of fingerprint statistics being d.zh-hant: 被丟棄的指紋統計數量。

Number of flow token dispatches dropped.en: Number of flow token dispatches dropped by the Raft Transport.
Number of flow token dispatches dropped.id: Jumlah pengiriman token aliran yang dijatuhkan oleh Raft Transport.
Number of flow token dispatches dropped.zh: Raft 传输丢弃的流令牌调度数量。
Number of flow token dispatches dropped.zh-hant: Raft 傳輸丟棄的串流令牌調度數量。

Number of flush elements added to the bu.en: Number of flush elements added to the buffer.
Number of flush elements added to the bu.id: Jumlah elemen flush yang ditambahkan ke buffer.
Number of flush elements added to the bu.zh: 添加到缓冲区的刷新元素数。
Number of flush elements added to the bu.zh-hant: 加到緩衝區的刷新元素數。

Number of flush of dirty data for this `.en: Number of flush of dirty data for this `SLRU` (simple least-recently-used) cache.
Number of flush of dirty data for this `.id: Jumlah pembersihan data kotor untuk cache `SLRU` (yang paling jarang digunakan) ini.
Number of flush of dirty data for this `.zh: 此“SLRU”（简单最近最少使用）缓存的脏数据刷新次数。
Number of flush of dirty data for this `.zh-hant: 此「SLRU」（簡單最近最少使用）快取的髒資料刷新次數。

Number of flush operations. Only for the.en: Number of flush operations. Only for the primary shards.
Number of flush operations. Only for the.id: Jumlah operasi pembilasan. Hanya untuk pecahan utama.
Number of flush operations. Only for the.zh: 冲洗操作的数量。仅适用于主分片。
Number of flush operations. Only for the.zh-hant: 沖洗操作的數量。僅適用於主分片。

Number of followers (i.e. Replicas) to w.en: Number of followers (i.e. Replicas) to which replication is currently paused to help them recover from I/O overload.Such Replicas will be ignored for the purposes of proposal quota, and will not receive replication traffic. They are essentially treated as offline for the purpose of replication. This serves as a crude form of admission control.The count is emitted by the leaseholder of each range.
Number of followers (i.e. Replicas) to w.id: Jumlah pengikut (yaitu Replika) yang replikasinya saat ini dijeda untuk membantu mereka pulih dari kelebihan beban I/O. Replika tersebut akan diabaikan untuk keperluan kuota proposal, dan tidak akan menerima lalu lintas replikasi. Mereka pada dasarnya diperlakukan sebagai offline untuk tujuan replikasi. Ini berfungsi sebagai bentuk kasar dari pengendalian penerimaan. Hitungannya dikeluarkan oleh penyewa setiap rentang.
Number of followers (i.e. Replicas) to w.zh: 当前暂停复制以帮助它们从 I/O 过载中恢复的关注者（即副本）数量。出于提案配额的目的，此类副本将被忽略，并且不会接收复制流量。为了复制的目的，它们本质上被视为离线。这是一种粗略的准入控制形式。计数由每个范围的租用者发出。
Number of followers (i.e. Replicas) to w.zh-hant: 目前暫停複製以幫助它們從 I/O 過載中恢復的追蹤者（即副本）數量。出於提案配額的目的，此類副本將被忽略，並且不會接收複製流量。為了複製的目的，它們本質上被視為離線。這是一種粗略的准入控制形式。計數由每個範圍的租用者發出。

Number of fragment endpoints by executio.en: Number of fragment endpoints by execution status on the BE.
Number of fragment endpoints by executio.id: Jumlah titik akhir fragmen berdasarkan status eksekusi di BE.
Number of fragment endpoints by executio.zh: BE 上按执行状态划分的片段端点数量。
Number of fragment endpoints by executio.zh-hant: BE 上依執行狀態劃分的片段端點數量。

Number of frames with unknown protocol r.en: Number of frames with unknown protocol received.
Number of frames with unknown protocol r.id: Jumlah frame dengan protokol tidak diketahui yang diterima.
Number of frames with unknown protocol r.zh: 收到的未知协议的帧数。
Number of frames with unknown protocol r.zh-hant: 收到的未知協定的幀數。

Number of free bytes in the central cach.en: Number of free bytes in the central cache that have been assigned to size classes. They always count towards virtual memory usage, and unless the underlying memory is swapped.
Number of free bytes in the central cach.id: Jumlah byte gratis di cache pusat yang telah ditetapkan ke kelas ukuran. Mereka selalu memperhitungkan penggunaan memori virtual, dan kecuali memori yang mendasarinya ditukar.
Number of free bytes in the central cach.zh: 中央缓存中已分配给大小类别的可用字节数。它们始终计入虚拟内存使用量，除非交换底层内存。
Number of free bytes in the central cach.zh-hant: 中央快取中已指派給大小類別的可用位元組數。它們始終計入虛擬記憶體使用量，除非交換底層記憶體。

Number of free chunks at the end of the.en: Number of free chunks at the end of the last allocated page
Number of free chunks at the end of the.id: Jumlah potongan gratis di akhir halaman yang terakhir dialokasikan
Number of free chunks at the end of the.zh: 最后分配页末尾的空闲块数
Number of free chunks at the end of the.zh-hant: 最後分配頁末的空閒區塊數

Number of free inodes available on the f.en: Number of free inodes available on the filesystem that contains the monitored directory.
Number of free inodes available on the f.id: Jumlah inode gratis yang tersedia di sistem file yang berisi direktori yang dipantau.
Number of free inodes available on the f.zh: 包含受监视目录的文件系统上可用的空闲 inode 数量。
Number of free inodes available on the f.zh-hant: 包含受監視目錄的檔案系統上可用的空閒 inode 數量。

Number of fsync calls. These are only tr.en: Number of fsync calls. These are only tracked in context normal.
Number of fsync calls. These are only tr.id: Jumlah panggilan fsync. Ini hanya dilacak dalam konteks normal.
Number of fsync calls. These are only tr.zh: fsync 调用次数。这些仅在正常上下文中进行跟踪。
Number of fsync calls. These are only tr.zh-hant: fsync 呼叫次數。這些僅在正常上下文中進行追蹤。

Number of fsync pending jobs in backgrou.en: Number of fsync pending jobs in background I/O queue.
Number of fsync pending jobs in backgrou.id: Jumlah pekerjaan fsync yang tertunda di antrian I/O latar belakang.
Number of fsync pending jobs in backgrou.zh: 后台 I/O 队列中的 fsync 挂起作业数。
Number of fsync pending jobs in backgrou.zh-hant: 後台 I/O 佇列中的 fsync 掛起作業數。

Number of fts queries rejected by the FT.en: Number of fts queries rejected by the FTS throttler due to high memory consumption.
Number of fts queries rejected by the FT.id: Jumlah kueri fts yang ditolak oleh throttle FTS karena konsumsi memori yang tinggi.
Number of fts queries rejected by the FT.zh: 由于内存消耗过高而被 FTS 节流器拒绝的 fts 查询数。
Number of fts queries rejected by the FT.zh-hant: 由於記憶體消耗過高而被 FTS 節流器拒絕的 fts 查詢數。

Number of full table or index scans (int.en: Number of full table or index scans (internal queries).
Number of full table or index scans (int.id: Jumlah pemindaian tabel atau indeks lengkap (kueri internal).
Number of full table or index scans (int.zh: 全表或索引扫描（内部查询）的数量。
Number of full table or index scans (int.zh-hant: 全表或索引掃描（內部查詢）的數量。

Number of full table or index scans that.en: Number of full table or index scans that have been rejected because of disallow_full_table_scans guardrail (internal queries).
Number of full table or index scans that.id: Jumlah pemindaian tabel atau indeks lengkap yang ditolak karena pagar pembatas disallow_full_table_scans (kueri internal).
Number of full table or index scans that.zh: 由于 disallow_full_table_scans 防护栏（内部查询）而被拒绝的全表或索引扫描的数量。
Number of full table or index scans that.zh-hant: 由於 disallow_full_table_scans 防護欄（內部查詢）而被拒絕的全表或索引掃描的數量。

Number of full table or index scans that.en: Number of full table or index scans that have been rejected because of disallow_full_table_scans guardrail.
Number of full table or index scans that.id: Jumlah pemindaian tabel atau indeks lengkap yang ditolak karena pagar pembatas disallow_full_table_scans.
Number of full table or index scans that.zh: 由于 disallow_full_table_scans 防护栏而被拒绝的全表或索引扫描的数量。
Number of full table or index scans that.zh-hant: 由於 disallow_full_table_scans 防護欄而被拒絕的全表或索引掃描的數量。

Number of garbage collections by the Erl.en: Number of garbage collections by the Erlang emulator.
Number of garbage collections by the Erl.id: Jumlah pengumpulan sampah oleh emulator Erlang.
Number of garbage collections by the Erl.zh: Erlang 模拟器的垃圾回收次数。
Number of garbage collections by the Erl.zh-hant: Erlang 模擬器的垃圾回收次數。

Number of get operations per second for.en: Number of get operations per second for data that this bucket contains. (measured from get_hits).
Number of get operations per second for.id: Jumlah operasi pengambilan per detik untuk data yang terdapat dalam bucket ini. (diukur dari get_hits).
Number of get operations per second for.zh: 此存储桶包含的数据每秒的获取操作数。 （根据 get_hits 测量）。
Number of get operations per second for.zh-hant: 此儲存桶包含的資料每秒的取得操作數。 （根據 get_hits 測量）。

Number of global changes updates pending.en: Number of global changes updates pending writes in global_changes_listener.
Number of global changes updates pending.id: Jumlah pembaruan perubahan global yang tertunda ditulis di global_changes_listener.
Number of global changes updates pending.zh: global_changes_listener 中待写入的全局更改更新数量。
Number of global changes updates pending.zh-hant: global_changes_listener 中待寫入的全域變更更新數量。

Number of global changes updates pending.en: Number of global changes updates pending writes in global_changes_server.
Number of global changes updates pending.id: Jumlah pembaruan perubahan global yang tertunda ditulis di global_changes_server.
Number of global changes updates pending.zh: global_changes_server 中待写入的全局更改更新数量。
Number of global changes updates pending.zh-hant: global_changes_server 中待寫入的全域變更更新數量。

Number of goroutines that currently exis.en: Number of goroutines that currently exist.
Number of goroutines that currently exis.id: Jumlah goroutine yang ada saat ini.
Number of goroutines that currently exis.zh: 当前存在的 goroutine 数量。
Number of goroutines that currently exis.zh-hant: 目前存在的 goroutine 數量。

Number of graceful failover operations s.en: Number of graceful failover operations started on this Couchbase node.
Number of graceful failover operations s.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang lancar dimulai pada node Couchbase ini.
Number of graceful failover operations s.zh: 在此 Couchbase 节点上启动的正常故障转移操作的数量。
Number of graceful failover operations s.zh-hant: 在此 Couchbase 節點上啟動的正常故障轉移操作的數量。

Number of graceful failover operations t.en: Number of graceful failover operations that completed successfully on this Couchbase node.
Number of graceful failover operations t.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang berhasil diselesaikan pada node Couchbase ini.
Number of graceful failover operations t.zh: 在此 Couchbase 节点上成功完成的正常故障转移操作的数量。
Number of graceful failover operations t.zh-hant: 在此 Couchbase 節點上成功完成的正常故障轉移操作的數量。

Number of graceful failover operations t.en: Number of graceful failover operations that failed on this Couchbase node.
Number of graceful failover operations t.id: Jumlah operasi failover yang gagal pada node Couchbase ini.
Number of graceful failover operations t.zh: 在此 Couchbase 节点上失败的正常故障转移操作的数量。
Number of graceful failover operations t.zh-hant: 在此 Couchbase 節點上失敗的正常故障轉移操作的數量。

Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.en: Number of hash slots mapping to a node in FAIL state. If this number is not zero the node is not able to serve queries unless cluster-require-full-coverage is set to no in the configuration.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.id: Jumlah pemetaan slot hash ke node dalam status FAIL. Jika angka ini bukan nol, maka node tidak dapat melayani kueri kecuali cluster-require-full-coverage diatur ke no dalam konfigurasi.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.zh: 映射到处于 FAIL 状态的节点的哈希槽数。如果此数字不为零，则节点无法提供查询服务，除非在配置中将 cluster-require-full-coverage 设置为 no。
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.zh-hant: 映射到處於 FAIL 狀態的節點的哈希槽數。如果此數字不為零，則節點無法提供查詢服務，除非在組態中將 cluster-require-full-coverage 設為 no。

Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.en: Number of hash slots mapping to a node in `PFAIL` state. Note that those hash slots still work correctly, as long as the `PFAIL` state is not promoted to FAIL by the failure detection algorithm. `PFAIL` only means that we are currently not able to talk with the node, but may be just a transient error.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.id: Jumlah pemetaan slot hash ke node dalam status `PFAIL`. Perhatikan bahwa slot hash tersebut masih berfungsi dengan benar, selama status `PFAIL` tidak dipromosikan menjadi FAIL oleh algoritma deteksi kegagalan. `PFAIL` hanya berarti bahwa saat ini kami tidak dapat berbicara dengan node, tetapi mungkin hanya kesalahan sementara.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.zh: 映射到处于“PFAIL”状态的节点的哈希槽数量。请注意，只要故障检测算法没有将“PFAIL”状态提升为 FAIL，这些哈希槽仍然可以正常工作。 “PFAIL”仅意味着我们当前无法与节点通信，但可能只是暂时性错误。
Number of hash slots mapping to a node i.zh-hant: 映射到處於“PFAIL”狀態的節點的哈希槽數量。請注意，只要故障偵測演算法沒有將「PFAIL」狀態提升為 FAIL，這些雜湊槽仍然可以正常運作。 「PFAIL」僅意味著我們目前無法與節點通信，但可能只是暫時性錯誤。

Number of hash slots mapping to a node n.en: Number of hash slots mapping to a node not in `FAIL` or `PFAIL` state.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node n.id: Jumlah pemetaan slot hash ke node yang tidak dalam status `FAIL` atau `PFAIL`.
Number of hash slots mapping to a node n.zh: 映射到不处于“FAIL”或“PFAIL”状态的节点的哈希槽数量。
Number of hash slots mapping to a node n.zh-hant: 對應到不處於“FAIL”或“PFAIL”狀態的節點的雜湊槽數量。

Number of heap bytes allocated and still.en: Number of heap bytes allocated and still in use.
Number of heap bytes allocated and still.id: Jumlah byte heap yang dialokasikan dan masih digunakan.
Number of heap bytes allocated and still.zh: 已分配且仍在使用的堆字节数。
Number of heap bytes allocated and still.zh-hant: 已分配且仍在使用的堆字節數。

Number of heap bytes obtained from syste.en: Number of heap bytes obtained from system.
Number of heap bytes obtained from syste.id: Jumlah byte heap yang diperoleh dari sistem.
Number of heap bytes obtained from syste.zh: 从系统获取的堆字节数。
Number of heap bytes obtained from syste.zh-hant: 從系統取得的堆字節數。

Number of heap bytes released to OS..en: Number of heap bytes released to OS.
Number of heap bytes released to OS..id: Jumlah byte heap yang dirilis ke OS.
Number of heap bytes released to OS..zh: 释放给操作系统的堆字节数。
Number of heap bytes released to OS..zh-hant: 釋放給作業系統的堆字節數。

Number of heap bytes that are in use..en: Number of heap bytes that are in use.
Number of heap bytes that are in use..id: Jumlah byte heap yang sedang digunakan.

Number of heap bytes waiting to be used..en: Number of heap bytes waiting to be used.

Number of host and datastore change oper.en: Number of host and datastore change operations for powered-on and suspended virtual machines.
Number of host and datastore change oper.id: Jumlah operasi perubahan host dan penyimpanan data untuk mesin virtual yang dihidupkan dan ditangguhkan.
Number of host and datastore change oper.zh: 已启动和挂起的虚拟机的主机和数据存储更改操作的数量。
Number of host and datastore change oper.zh-hant: 已啟動和掛起的虛擬機器的主機和資料儲存更改操作的數量。

Number of host change operations for pow.zh-hant: 已關閉和掛起的虛擬機器的主機更改操作數。

Number of huge pages in the pool that ar.en: Number of huge pages in the pool that are not allocated. Linux only.
Number of huge pages in the pool that ar.id: Jumlah halaman besar di kumpulan yang tidak dialokasikan. Hanya Linux.
Number of huge pages in the pool that ar.zh: 池中未分配的大页数。仅限 Linux。
Number of huge pages in the pool that ar.zh-hant: 池中未分配的大頁數。僅限 Linux。

Number of idle connections in the databa.en: Number of idle connections in the database.

Number of import jobs currently consider.en: Number of import jobs currently considered Idle and can be freely shut down.

Number of import jobs currently consider.zh-hant: 目前被視為暫停的導入作業數量。

Number of import jobs currently running.en: Number of import jobs currently running in Resume or OnFailOrCancel state.

Number of import jobs which failed with.zh: 因失败或取消过程中出现不可重试错误而失败的导入作业数量。
Number of import jobs which failed with.zh-hant: 因失敗或取消過程中出現不可重試錯誤而失敗的匯入作業數量。

Number of import jobs which failed with.en: Number of import jobs which failed with a non-retry able error.
Number of import jobs which failed with.id: Jumlah pekerjaan impor yang gagal dengan kesalahan yang tidak dapat dicoba lagi.
Number of import jobs which failed with.zh: 由于不可重试错误而失败的导入作业数。
Number of import jobs which failed with.zh-hant: 由於不可重試錯誤而失敗的匯入作業數。

Number of import jobs which failed with.en: Number of import jobs which failed with a retry able error on their failure or cancellation process.
Number of import jobs which failed with.id: Jumlah pekerjaan impor yang gagal dengan kesalahan percobaan ulang pada proses kegagalan atau pembatalannya.
Number of import jobs which failed with.zh: 因失败或取消过程中出现可重试错误而失败的导入作业数量。

Number of import jobs which successfully.en: Number of import jobs which successfully completed their failure or cancellation process.

Number of import jobs which successfully.zh: 成功完成失败或取消过程的导入作业数量。
Number of import jobs which successfully.zh-hant: 成功完成失敗或取消程序的匯入作業數量。

Number of import jobs which successfully.en: Number of import jobs which successfully resumed to completion.

Number of import jobs which successfully.zh-hant: 成功恢復完成的導入作業數量。

Number of in-flight liveness heartbeats.en: Number of in-flight liveness heartbeats from this node.
Number of in-flight liveness heartbeats.id: Jumlah detak jantung dalam penerbangan dari node ini.

Number of in-flight liveness heartbeats.zh-hant: 來自該節點的正在進行的活動心跳數。

Number of in-progress transactions strea.en: Number of in-progress transactions streamed to the decoding output plugin after the memory used by logical decoding to decode changes from WAL for this slot has exceeded `logical_decoding_work_mem`. Streaming only works with top-level transactions (subtransactions can't be streamed independently), so the counter is not incremented for subtransactions. Only available with PostgreSQL 14 and newer.
Number of in-progress transactions strea.id: Jumlah transaksi yang sedang berlangsung yang dialirkan ke plugin keluaran decoding setelah memori yang digunakan oleh decoding logis untuk mendekode perubahan dari WAL untuk slot ini telah melampaui `logical_decoding_work_mem`. Streaming hanya berfungsi dengan transaksi tingkat atas (subtransaksi tidak dapat dialirkan secara independen), sehingga penghitung tidak bertambah untuk subtransaksi. Hanya tersedia dengan PostgreSQL 14 dan yang lebih baru.
Number of in-progress transactions strea.zh: 在逻辑解码使用的内存来解码此槽的 WAL 更改之后，流式传输到解码输出插件的进行中事务数已超过“逻辑解码工作内存”。流式传输仅适用于顶级事务（子事务不能独立流式传输），因此子事务的计数器不会增加。仅适用于 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。
Number of in-progress transactions strea.zh-hant: 在邏輯解碼使用的記憶體來解碼此插槽的 WAL 變更之後，串流傳輸到解碼輸出插件的進行中事務數已超過「邏輯解碼工作記憶體」。串流傳輸僅適用於頂級事務（子事務不能獨立串流），因此子事務的計數器不會增加。僅適用於 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。

Number of increments of the total KV slo.en: Number of increments of the total KV slots.

Number of index scans. When `pg_index` i.en: Number of index scans. When `pg_index` is present the metric comes from per-index statistics; otherwise it comes from table-level statistics.
Number of index scans. When `pg_index` i.id: Jumlah pemindaian indeks. Jika `pg_index` ada, metriknya berasal dari statistik per indeks; jika tidak, ini berasal dari statistik tingkat tabel.
Number of index scans. When `pg_index` i.zh: 索引扫描次数。当“pg_index”存在时，指标来自每个索引的统计信息；否则来自表级统计。
Number of index scans. When `pg_index` i.zh-hant: 索引掃描次數。當「pg_index」存在時，指標來自每個索引的統計資料；否則來自表級統計。

Number of indexer DCP items sent from th.en: Number of indexer DCP items sent from this bucket.
Number of indexer DCP items sent from th.id: Jumlah item DCP pengindeks yang dikirim dari bucket ini.
Number of indexer DCP items sent from th.zh: 从此存储桶发送的索引器 DCP 项目数。
Number of indexer DCP items sent from th.zh-hant: 從此儲存桶發送的索引器 DCP 項目數。

Number of indexes items remaining to be.zh: 剩余要发送的索引项数。

Number of indexing operations currently.en: Number of indexing operations currently running.
Number of indexing operations currently.id: Jumlah operasi pengindeksan yang sedang berjalan.
Number of indexing operations currently.zh: 当前正在运行的索引操作数。
Number of indexing operations currently.zh-hant: 目前正在運行的索引操作數。

Number of indexing operations currently.en: Number of indexing operations currently running. Only for the primary shards.
Number of indexing operations currently.id: Jumlah operasi pengindeksan yang sedang berjalan. Hanya untuk pecahan utama.
Number of indexing operations currently.zh: 当前正在运行的索引操作数。仅适用于主分片。
Number of indexing operations currently.zh-hant: 目前正在運行的索引操作數。僅適用於主分片。

Number of inodes currently used by files.en: Number of inodes currently used by files and subdirectories under the monitored directory.
Number of inodes currently used by files.id: Jumlah inode yang saat ini digunakan oleh file dan subdirektori di bawah direktori yang dipantau.
Number of inodes currently used by files.zh: 监控目录下的文件和子目录当前使用的inode数量。
Number of inodes currently used by files.zh-hant: 監控目錄下的檔案和子目錄目前使用的inode數量。

Number of insert merged operations disca.en: Number of insert merged operations discarded
Number of insert merged operations disca.id: Jumlah operasi penggabungan sisipan yang dibuang
Number of insert merged operations disca.zh: 丢弃的插入合并操作数
Number of insert merged operations disca.zh-hant: 丟棄的插入合併操作數

Number of insert queries received per dn.en: Number of insert queries received per dnode divided by monitor interval
Number of insert queries received per dn.id: Jumlah kueri penyisipan yang diterima per dnode dibagi dengan interval monitor
Number of insert queries received per dn.zh: 每个 dnode 收到的插入查询数除以监视间隔
Number of insert queries received per dn.zh-hant: 每個 dnode 收到的插入查詢數除以監視間隔

Number of inserted records merged by cha.en: Number of inserted records merged by change buffering
Number of inserted records merged by cha.id: Jumlah rekaman yang disisipkan digabungkan dengan buffering perubahan
Number of inserted records merged by cha.zh: 通过更改缓冲合并的插入记录数
Number of inserted records merged by cha.zh-hant: 透過變更緩衝合併的插入記錄數

Number of inserts into the cache..en: Number of inserts into the cache.
Number of inserts into the cache..id: Jumlah yang dimasukkan ke dalam cache.

Number of instances of disk operations t.en: Number of instances of disk operations taking longer than 10s.
Number of instances of disk operations t.id: Jumlah contoh operasi disk yang memakan waktu lebih dari 10 detik.
Number of instances of disk operations t.zh: 磁盘操作时间超过10秒的实例数。
Number of instances of disk operations t.zh-hant: 磁碟操作時間超過10秒的實例數。

Number of instances of disk operations t.en: Number of instances of disk operations taking longer than 20s.

Number of instances of disk operations t.zh-hant: 磁碟操作時間超過20秒的實例數。

Number of instances of intentional write.en: Number of instances of intentional write stalls to back pressure incoming writes.

Number of instances of intentional write.zh-hant: 故意寫入停頓以對傳入寫入施加背壓的實例數。

Number of intent cleanup failures for lo.en: Number of intent cleanup failures for local transactions during GC.
Number of intent cleanup failures for lo.id: Jumlah kegagalan pembersihan niat untuk transaksi lokal selama GC.
Number of intent cleanup failures for lo.zh: GC 期间本地事务意图清理失败的次数。
Number of intent cleanup failures for lo.zh-hant: GC 期間本地事務意圖清理失敗的次數。

Number of intent resolution attempts not.en: Number of intent resolution attempts not run asynchronously due to throttling.
Number of intent resolution attempts not.id: Jumlah upaya penyelesaian maksud tidak berjalan secara asinkron karena pembatasan.
Number of intent resolution attempts not.zh: 由于限制而未异步运行的意图解析尝试的数量。
Number of intent resolution attempts not.zh-hant: 由於限製而未非同步運行的意圖解析嘗試的數量。

Number of intent resolution failures. Th.en: Number of intent resolution failures. The unit of measurement is a single intent, so if a batch of intent resolution requests fails, the metric will be incremented for each request in the batch.
Number of intent resolution failures. Th.id: Jumlah kegagalan resolusi niat. Unit pengukurannya adalah satu maksud, jadi jika sekumpulan permintaan resolusi maksud gagal, metrik akan bertambah untuk setiap permintaan dalam kumpulan tersebut.
Number of intent resolution failures. Th.zh: 意图解析失败的数量。度量单位是单个意图，因此如果一批意图解析请求失败，则该批中的每个请求的度量都会递增。
Number of intent resolution failures. Th.zh-hant: 意圖解析失敗的數量。度量單位是單一意圖，因此如果一批意圖解析請求失敗，則該批次中的每個請求的度量都會遞增。

Number of internal `XDCR` DCP connection.en: Number of internal `XDCR` DCP connections in this bucket.
Number of internal `XDCR` DCP connection.id: Jumlah koneksi DCP `XDCR` internal dalam bucket ini.

Number of internal analytics DCP connect.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中的內部分析 DCP 連線數（根據 ep_dcp_cbas_count 測量）。

Number of internal full-text-search DCP.en: Number of internal full-text-search DCP connections in this bucket.
Number of internal full-text-search DCP.id: Jumlah koneksi DCP penelusuran teks lengkap internal dalam bucket ini.
Number of internal full-text-search DCP.zh: 该存储桶中的内部全文搜索 DCP 连接数。
Number of internal full-text-search DCP.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中的內部全文搜尋 DCP 連線數。

Number of internal non-atomic SQL COPY o.en: Number of internal non-atomic SQL COPY operations.

Number of internal non-atomic SQL COPY o.zh-hant: 內部非原子 SQL COPY 運算的數量。

Number of internal replication DCP conne.en: Number of internal replication DCP connections in this bucket.

Number of internal replication DCP conne.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中的內部複製 DCP 連線數。

Number of invalid N1QL query requests re.en: Number of invalid N1QL query requests rejected by the service.

Number of invalid N1QL query requests re.zh: 被服务拒绝的无效 N1QL 查询请求数。
Number of invalid N1QL query requests re.zh-hant: 被服務拒絕的無效 N1QL 查詢請求數。

Number of invocations of `emit` in map f.en: Number of invocations of `emit` in map functions in the view server.

Number of invocations of `emit` in map f.zh: 视图服务器中的地图函数中“emit”的调用次数。
Number of invocations of `emit` in map f.zh-hant: 视图服务器中的地图函数中“emit”的调用次数。

Number of io_uring SQEs in flight.en: Number of io_uring SQEs in flight
Number of io_uring SQEs in flight.zh: 正在运行的 io_uring SQE 数量
Number of io_uring SQEs in flight.zh-hant: 正在運行的 io_uring SQE 數量

Number of io_uring SQEs waiting to be su.en: Number of io_uring SQEs waiting to be submitted
Number of io_uring SQEs waiting to be su.id: Jumlah SQE io_uring yang menunggu untuk dikirimkan
Number of io_uring SQEs waiting to be su.zh: 等待提交的 io_uring SQE 数量
Number of io_uring SQEs waiting to be su.zh-hant: 等待提交的 io_uring SQE 數量

Number of items currently being written..en: Number of items currently being written.
Number of items currently being written..zh: 当前正在写入的项目数。
Number of items currently being written..zh-hant: 目前正在寫入的項目數。

Number of items in active vBuckets in th.en: Number of items in active vBuckets in this bucket.
Number of items in active vBuckets in th.id: Jumlah item di vBuckets aktif di bucket ini.
Number of items in active vBuckets in th.zh: 此存储桶中活动 vBuckets 中的项目数。
Number of items in active vBuckets in th.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中活動 vBuckets 中的項目數。

Number of items in pending vBuckets in t.en: Number of items in pending vBuckets in this bucket and should be transient during rebalancing.

Number of items in pending vBuckets in t.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中待處理的 vBuckets 中的項目數在重新平衡期間應該是暫時的。

Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.en: Number of items in replica vBuckets in this bucket.
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.id: Jumlah item dalam replika vBuckets di bucket ini.
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.zh: 此存储桶中的副本 vBuckets 中的项目数。
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.zh-hant: 此存储桶中的副本 vBuckets 中的项目数。

Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.en: Number of items in replica vBuckets in this bucket. (measured from vb_replica_curr_items).
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.id: Jumlah item dalam replika vBuckets di bucket ini. (diukur dari vb_replica_curr_items).
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.zh: 此存储桶中的副本 vBuckets 中的项目数。 （从 vb_replica_curr_items 测量）。
Number of items in replica vBuckets in t.zh-hant: 此儲存桶中的副本 vBuckets 中的項目數。 （從 vb_replica_curr_items 測量）。

Number of items per second being ejected.en: Number of items per second being ejected to disk from active vBuckets in this bucket.

Number of items per second being ejected.zh-hant: 每秒从此存储桶中的活动 vBuckets 弹出到磁盘的项目数。

Number of kv elements added to the buffe.zh-hant: 加到緩衝區的 kv 元素數量。

Number of kv-level requests received per.en: Number of kv-level requests received per second by the store, averaged over a large time period as used in rebalancing decisions.
Number of kv-level requests received per.id: Jumlah permintaan tingkat kv yang diterima per detik oleh toko, dirata-ratakan selama jangka waktu yang lama seperti yang digunakan dalam menyeimbangkan kembali keputusan.
Number of kv-level requests received per.zh: 存储每秒收到的 kv 级请求数，在重新平衡决策中使用的较长时间段内的平均值。
Number of kv-level requests received per.zh-hant: 儲存每秒收到的 kv 等級請求數，在重新平衡決策中使用的較長時間段內的平均值。

Number of latch requests that could not.en: Number of latch requests that could not be granted immediately.
Number of latch requests that could not.id: Jumlah permintaan kait yang tidak dapat segera dikabulkan.
Number of latch requests that could not.zh: 无法立即授予的锁存请求数。
Number of latch requests that could not.zh-hant: 無法立即授予的鎖存請求數。

Number of launched background merges..id: Jumlah penggabungan latar belakang yang diluncurkan.

Number of launched background merges..zh-hant: 已啟動的後台合併數量。

Number of learner replica removals attem.en: Number of learner replica removals attempted by the replicate queue (typically due to internal race conditions).
Number of learner replica removals attem.id: Jumlah penghapusan replika pelajar yang dicoba oleh antrean replikasi (biasanya karena kondisi balapan internal).
Number of learner replica removals attem.zh: 复制队列尝试删除学习者副本的次数（通常是由于内部竞争条件）。
Number of learner replica removals attem.zh-hant: 複製隊列嘗試刪除學習者副本的次數（通常是由於內部競爭條件）。

Number of lease transfers motivated by s.en: Number of lease transfers motivated by store-level load imbalances.
Number of lease transfers motivated by s.id: Jumlah transfer sewa dilatarbelakangi oleh ketidakseimbangan beban di tingkat toko.
Number of lease transfers motivated by s.zh: 因商店级负载不平衡而引发的租赁转移数量。
Number of lease transfers motivated by s.zh-hant: 因商店級負載不平衡而引發的租賃轉移數量。

Number of legacy checksums found in couc.en: Number of legacy checksums found in couch_file instances.

Number of legacy checksums found in couc.zh-hant: 在 couch_file 實例中找到的舊版校驗和的數量。

Number of live (in use) SSTables..zh-hant: 活動（正在使用）的 SSTable 數量。

Number of live rows fetched by index sca.en: Number of live rows fetched by index scans. When `pg_index` is present the metric comes from per-index statistics; otherwise it comes from table-level statistics.
Number of live rows fetched by index sca.id: Jumlah baris aktif yang diambil berdasarkan pemindaian indeks. Jika `pg_index` ada, metriknya berasal dari statistik per indeks; jika tidak, ini berasal dari statistik tingkat tabel.
Number of live rows fetched by index sca.zh: 通过索引扫描获取的活动行数。当“pg_index”存在时，指标来自每个索引的统计信息；否则来自表级统计。
Number of live rows fetched by index sca.zh-hant: 透過索引掃描取得的活動行數。當「pg_index」存在時，指標來自每個索引的統計資料；否則來自表級統計。

Number of local elastic flow token dispa.en: Number of local elastic flow token dispatches.
Number of local elastic flow token dispa.id: Jumlah pengiriman token aliran elastis lokal.
Number of local elastic flow token dispa.zh: 本地弹性流令牌调度数量。
Number of local elastic flow token dispa.zh-hant: 本地彈性流令牌調度數量。

Number of log messages with level Fatal.zh-hant: 致命等級的日誌訊息數

Number of log messages with level Info.en: Number of log messages with level Info
Number of log messages with level Info.id: Jumlah pesan log dengan Info level
Number of log messages with level Info.zh: 具有信息级别的日志消息数
Number of log messages with level Info.zh-hant: 具有資訊等級的日誌訊息數

Number of log messages with level Test.en: Number of log messages with level Test
Number of log messages with level Test.id: Jumlah pesan log dengan level Test
Number of log messages with level Test.zh: 测试级别的日志消息数
Number of log messages with level Test.zh-hant: 測試等級的日誌訊息數

Number of log messages with level Trace.en: Number of log messages with level Trace
Number of log messages with level Trace.id: Jumlah pesan log dengan level Trace

Number of log messages with level Trace.zh-hant: Trace 等級的日誌訊息數

Number of log messages with level Warnin.id: Jumlah pesan log dengan level Peringatan

Number of log messages with level Warnin.zh-hant: 等級為「警告」的日誌訊息數

Number of log waits due to small log buf.en: Number of log waits due to small log buffer (innodb_log_waits)
Number of log waits due to small log buf.id: Jumlah log menunggu karena buffer log kecil (innodb_log_waits)

Number of mango queries that could not u.en: Number of mango queries that could not use an index.

Number of mango queries that generated a.id: Jumlah kueri mangga yang menghasilkan peringatan indeks tidak valid.

Number of mango queries that generated a.zh-hant: 產生無效索引警告的 mango 查詢數。

Number of mapped buffers in the pool..zh: 池中映射缓冲区的数量。

Number of marks (index granules) selecte.en: Number of marks (index granules) selected to read from a MergeTree table.
Number of marks (index granules) selecte.id: Jumlah tanda (butiran indeks) yang dipilih untuk dibaca dari tabel MergeTree.
Number of marks (index granules) selecte.zh: 选择从 MergeTree 表中读取的标记（索引颗粒）数量。
Number of marks (index granules) selecte.zh-hant: 選擇從 MergeTree 表中讀取的標記（索引顆粒）數量。

Number of messages dropped instead of be.id: Jumlah pesan yang dihapus alih-alih dikirim ke replika yang dijeda. Pesan-pesan tersebut dihapus untuk membantu replika ini pulih dari kelebihan beban I/O.

Number of messages dropped instead of be.zh-hant: 刪除而不是發送到暫停副本的訊息數。刪除訊息是為了幫助這些副本從 I/O 過載中恢復。

Number of messages during the sending pr.en: Number of messages during the sending process or client processing that have not been sent FIN, REQ (requeued), or timed out.
Number of messages during the sending pr.id: Jumlah pesan selama proses pengiriman atau pemrosesan klien yang belum terkirim FIN, REQ (requeued), atau waktu habis.
