Number of messages during the sending pr.zh-hant: 發送過程或用戶端處理期間尚未發送 FIN、REQ（重新排隊）或逾時的訊息數。

Number of messages for which an attempt.en: Number of messages for which an attempt to retry them within an aggregator node was made.

Number of pending outgoing messages in t.en: Number of pending outgoing messages in the Raft Transport queue.The queue is composed of multiple bounded channels associated with different peers. The overall size of tens of thousands could indicate issues streaming messages to at least one peer. Use this metric in conjunction with send-queue-bytes.

Number of pending outgoing messages in t.zh-hant: Raft 傳輸佇列中待處理的傳出訊息的數量。此佇列由與不同對等點關聯的多個有界通道組成。數萬的總體規模可能表示向至少一個對等點傳輸訊息存在問題。將此指標與發送隊列位元組結合使用。

A slow latch acquisition attempt is often caused by another request holding and not releasing its latches in a timely manner.

Mengunci akses moderat ke ruang kunci KV untuk tujuan mengevaluasi dan mereplikasi perintah. Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.id: Jumlah pekerjaan skema_perubahan_gc yang gagal dengan kesalahan percobaan ulang pada proses kegagalan atau pembatalannya.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.zh: 因失败或取消过程中出现可重试错误而失败的 schema_change_gc 作业数量。
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.zh-hant: 因失敗或取消過程中出現可重試錯誤而失敗的 schema_change_gc 作業數量。

Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.en: Number of schema_change_gc jobs which failed with a retry able error.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.id: Jumlah pekerjaan skema_perubahan_gc yang gagal dengan kesalahan yang dapat dicoba lagi.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.zh: 因可重试错误而失败的 schema_change_gc 作业数。
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which fa.zh-hant: 因可重試錯誤而失敗的 schema_change_gc 作業數。

Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.en: Number of schema_change_gc jobs which successfully completed their failure or cancellation process.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.id: Jumlah pekerjaan skema_perubahan_gc yang berhasil menyelesaikan proses kegagalan atau pembatalannya.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.zh: 成功完成其失败或取消过程的 schema_change_gc 作业数。
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.zh-hant: 成功完成其失敗或取消程序的 schema_change_gc 作業數。

Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.en: Number of schema_change_gc jobs which successfully resumed to completion.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.id: Jumlah pekerjaan skema_perubahan_gc yang berhasil dilanjutkan hingga selesai.
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.zh: 成功恢复完成的 schema_change_gc 作业数。
Number of schema_change_gc jobs which su.zh-hant: 成功恢復完成的 schema_change_gc 作業數。

Number of searches using B-tree on an in.en: Number of searches using B-tree on an index search
Number of searches using B-tree on an in.id: Jumlah pencarian menggunakan B-tree pada pencarian indeks
Number of searches using B-tree on an in.zh: 在索引搜索中使用 B 树的搜索次数
Number of searches using B-tree on an in.zh-hant: 在索引搜尋中使用 B 樹的搜尋次數

Number of seconds since 1970 of last gar.en: Number of seconds since 1970 of last garbage collection.
Number of seconds since 1970 of last gar.id: Jumlah detik sejak pengumpulan sampah terakhir tahun 1970.
Number of seconds since 1970 of last gar.zh: 自 1970 年以来上次垃圾回收的秒数。
Number of seconds since 1970 of last gar.zh-hant: 自 1970 年以來上次垃圾回收的秒數。

Number of seconds since Redis server sta.en: Number of seconds since Redis server start.
Number of seconds since Redis server sta.id: Jumlah detik sejak server Redis dimulai.
Number of seconds since Redis server sta.zh: 自 Redis 服务器启动以来的秒数。
Number of seconds since Redis server sta.zh-hant: 自 Redis 伺服器啟動以來的秒數。

Number of seconds since last transfer I/.en: Number of seconds since last transfer I/O during a SYNC operation.
Number of seconds since last transfer I/.id: Jumlah detik sejak transfer I/O terakhir selama operasi SYNC.
Number of seconds since last transfer I/.zh: SYNC 操作期间自上次传输 I/O 以来的秒数。
Number of seconds since last transfer I/.zh-hant: SYNC 作業期間自上次傳輸 I/O 以來的秒數。

Number of seconds since the last interac.en: Number of seconds since the last interaction with master.
Number of seconds since the last interac.id: Jumlah detik sejak interaksi terakhir dengan master.
Number of seconds since the last interac.zh: 自上次与 master 交互以来的秒数。
Number of seconds since the last interac.zh-hant: 自上次與 master 互動以來的秒數。

Number of seconds since the link is down.en: Number of seconds since the link is down.
Number of seconds since the link is down.id: Jumlah detik sejak tautan tidak aktif.
Number of seconds since the link is down.zh: 自链接断开以来的秒数。
Number of seconds since the link is down.zh-hant: 自連結斷開以來的秒數。

Number of seeks during the interval that.en: Number of seeks during the interval that were between 64 and 8192 LBNs apart.
Number of seeks during the interval that.id: Jumlah pencarian selama interval antara 64 dan 8192 LBN.
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh: 间隔期间间隔介于 64 到 8192 LBN 之间的查找次数。
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh-hant: 間隔期間間隔介於 64 到 8192 LBN 之間的查找次數。

Number of seeks during the interval that.en: Number of seeks during the interval that were greater than 8192 LBNs apart.
Number of seeks during the interval that.id: Jumlah pencarian selama interval yang jaraknya lebih dari 8192 LBN.
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh: 间隔期间间隔大于 8192 LBN 的查找次数。
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh-hant: 間隔期間間隔大於 8192 LBN 的查找次數。

Number of seeks during the interval that.en: Number of seeks during the interval that were less than 64 LBNs apart.
Number of seeks during the interval that.id: Jumlah pencarian selama interval yang jaraknya kurang dari 64 LBN.
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh: 间隔期间小于 64 LBN 的查找次数。
Number of seeks during the interval that.zh-hant: 間隔期間小於 64 LBN 的查找次數。

Number of seeks which lead to a new conn.en: Number of seeks which lead to a new connection
Number of seeks which lead to a new conn.id: Jumlah pencarian yang mengarah pada koneksi baru
Number of seeks which lead to a new conn.zh: 导致新连接的搜索次数
Number of seeks which lead to a new conn.zh-hant: 導致新連線的搜尋次數

Number of seeks which lead to new connec.en: Number of seeks which lead to new connection (s3, http)
Number of seeks which lead to new connec.id: Jumlah pencarian yang menghasilkan koneksi baru (s3, http)
Number of seeks which lead to new connec.zh: 导致新连接的搜索次数（s3、http）
Number of seeks which lead to new connec.zh-hant: 導致新連線的搜尋次數（s3、http）

Number of select queries received per dn.en: Number of select queries received per dnode
Number of select queries received per dn.id: Jumlah kueri pemilihan yang diterima per dnode
Number of select queries received per dn.zh: 每个 dnode 收到的选择查询数
Number of select queries received per dn.zh-hant: 每個 dnode 收到的選擇查詢數

Number of select queries received per dn.en: Number of select queries received per dnode divided by monitor interval
Number of select queries received per dn.id: Jumlah kueri pemilihan yang diterima per dnode dibagi dengan interval monitor
Number of select queries received per dn.zh: 每个 dnode 收到的选择查询数除以监控间隔
Number of select queries received per dn.zh-hant: 每個 dnode 收到的選擇查詢數除以監控間隔

Number of services registered in the Con.en: Number of services registered in the Consul catalog.
Number of services registered in the Con.id: Jumlah layanan yang terdaftar di katalog Konsul.
Number of services registered in the Con.zh: Consul 目录中注册的服务数量。
Number of services registered in the Con.zh-hant: Consul 目錄中註冊的服務數量。

Number of sessions (connections) to ZooK.en: Number of sessions (connections) to ZooKeeper. Should be no more than one, because using more than one connection to ZooKeeper may lead to bugs due to lack of `linearizability` (stale reads) that ZooKeeper consistency model allows.
Number of sessions (connections) to ZooK.id: Jumlah sesi (koneksi) ke ZooKeeper. Tidak boleh lebih dari satu, karena menggunakan lebih dari satu koneksi ke ZooKeeper dapat menyebabkan bug karena kurangnya `linearizability` (pembacaan basi) yang dimungkinkan oleh model konsistensi ZooKeeper.
Number of sessions (connections) to ZooK.zh: ZooKeeper 的会话（连接）数量。不应超过 1 个，因为使用多个到 ZooKeeper 的连接可能会由于缺乏 ZooKeeper 一致性模型允许的“线性化”（陈旧读取）而导致错误。
Number of sessions (connections) to ZooK.zh-hant: ZooKeeper 的會話（連結）數量。不應超過 1 個，因為使用多個到 ZooKeeper 的連接可能會因為缺乏 ZooKeeper 一致性模型允許的「線性化」（陳舊讀取）而導致錯誤。

Number of sessions in a specific state o.en: Number of sessions in a specific state or wait event.
Number of sessions in a specific state o.id: Jumlah sesi dalam keadaan tertentu atau peristiwa tunggu.
Number of sessions in a specific state o.zh: 处于特定状态或等待事件的会话数。
Number of sessions in a specific state o.zh-hant: 處於特定狀態或等待事件的會話數。

Number of sessions in this dimension gro.en: Number of sessions in this dimension group
Number of sessions in this dimension gro.id: Jumlah sesi dalam grup dimensi ini

Number of sessions in this dimension gro.en: Number of sessions in this dimension group.
Number of sessions in this dimension gro.id: Jumlah sesi dalam grup dimensi ini.

Number of sessions that are being blocke.en: Number of sessions that are being blocked

Number of sessions that are blocking oth.en: Number of sessions that are blocking other sessions
Number of sessions that are blocking oth.id: Jumlah sesi yang memblokir sesi lainnya
Number of sessions that are blocking oth.zh: 阻止其他会话的会话数
Number of sessions that are blocking oth.zh-hant: 阻止其他會話的會話數

Number of set operations per second for.en: Number of set operations per second for this bucket as the target for `XDCR`.
Number of set operations per second for.id: Jumlah operasi yang ditetapkan per detik untuk bucket ini sebagai target `XDCR`.
Number of set operations per second for.zh: 每秒将此存储桶作为“XDCR”目标的设置操作数。
Number of set operations per second for.zh-hant: 每秒將此儲存桶作為「XDCR」目標的設定運算元。

Number of setRetMeta operations per seco.en: Number of setRetMeta operations per second for this bucket as the target for `XDCR`.
Number of setRetMeta operations per seco.id: Jumlah operasi setRetMeta per detik untuk bucket ini sebagai target untuk `XDCR`.
Number of setRetMeta operations per seco.zh: 此存储桶作为“XDCR”目标的每秒 setRetMeta 操作数。
Number of setRetMeta operations per seco.zh-hant: 此儲存桶作為「XDCR」目標的每秒 setRetMeta 運算元。

Number of shared buffer blocks hit..en: Number of shared buffer blocks hit.
Number of shared buffer blocks hit..id: Jumlah blok buffer bersama yang tercapai.
Number of shared buffer blocks hit..zh: 命中的共享缓冲区块数。
Number of shared buffer blocks hit..zh-hant: 命中的共享緩衝區塊數。

Number of shared buffer blocks read..en: Number of shared buffer blocks read.
Number of shared buffer blocks read..id: Jumlah blok buffer bersama yang dibaca.
Number of shared buffer blocks read..zh: 读取的共享缓冲区块数。
Number of shared buffer blocks read..zh-hant: 讀取的共享緩衝區塊數。

Number of slots which are associated to.en: Number of slots which are associated to some node (not unbound). This number should be 16384 for the node to work properly, which means that each hash slot should be mapped to a node.
Number of slots which are associated to.id: Jumlah slot yang terkait dengan beberapa node (tidak terikat). Nomor ini harus 16384 agar node berfungsi dengan baik, yang berarti setiap slot hash harus dipetakan ke sebuah node.
Number of slots which are associated to.zh: 与某个节点关联的槽数（未绑定）。为了让节点正常工作，这个数字应该是16384，这意味着每个哈希槽都应该映射到一个节点。
Number of slots which are associated to.zh-hant: 與某個節點關聯的槽數（未綁定）。為了讓節點正常運作，這個數字應該是16384，這意味著每個哈希槽都應該映射到一個節點。

Number of snapshot bytes received cross.en: Number of snapshot bytes received cross region.
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.id: Jumlah byte snapshot yang diterima lintas wilayah.
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.zh: 跨区域接收的快照字节数。
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.zh-hant: 跨區域接收的快照位元組數。

Number of snapshot bytes received cross.en: Number of snapshot bytes received cross zone within same region or if region tiers are not configured. This count increases for each snapshot received between different zones within the same region. However, if the region tiers are not configured, this count may also include snapshot data received between different regions.
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.id: Jumlah byte snapshot yang diterima lintas zona dalam wilayah yang sama atau jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi. Jumlah ini meningkat untuk setiap snapshot yang diterima antar zona berbeda dalam wilayah yang sama. Namun, jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi, penghitungan ini mungkin juga mencakup data snapshot yang diterima antar wilayah berbeda.
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.zh: 同一区域内或未配置区域层时跨区域接收的快照字节数。对于同一区域内不同区域之间收到的每个快照，此计数会增加。然而，如果未配置区域层，则该计数还可以包括在不同区域之间接收的快照数据。
Number of snapshot bytes received cross.zh-hant: 同一區域內或未配置區域層時跨區域接收的快照位元組數。對於同一區域內不同區域之間收到的每個快照，此計數會增加。然而，如果未配置區域層，則該計數還可以包括在不同區域之間接收的快照資料。

Number of snapshot bytes sent cross regi.en: Number of snapshot bytes sent cross region.
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross regi.id: Jumlah byte snapshot yang dikirim lintas wilayah.
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross regi.zh: 跨区域发送的快照字节数。
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross regi.zh-hant: 跨區域發送的快照位元組數。

Number of snapshot bytes sent cross zone.en: Number of snapshot bytes sent cross zone within same region or if region tiers are not configured. This count increases for each snapshot sent between different zones within the same region. However, if the region tiers are not configured, this count may also include snapshot data sent between different regions.
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross zone.id: Jumlah byte snapshot yang dikirim lintas zona dalam wilayah yang sama atau jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi. Jumlah ini meningkat untuk setiap snapshot yang dikirim antar zona berbeda dalam wilayah yang sama. Namun, jika tingkat wilayah tidak dikonfigurasi, penghitungan ini mungkin juga mencakup data snapshot yang dikirim antar wilayah berbeda.
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross zone.zh: 在同一区域内或未配置区域层的情况下跨区域发送的快照字节数。对于同一区域内不同区域之间发送的每个快照，此计数会增加。但是，如果未配置区域层，则此计数还可能包括不同区域之间发送的快照数据。
Number of snapshot bytes sent cross zone.zh-hant: 在同一區域內或未配置區域層的情況下跨區域發送的快照位元組數。對於同一區域內不同區域之間發送的每個快照，此計數會增加。但是，如果未配置區域層，則此計數還可能包括在不同區域之間發送的快照資料。

Number of snapshots applied by non-voter.en: Number of snapshots applied by non-voter replicas.
Number of snapshots applied by non-voter.id: Jumlah snapshot yang diterapkan oleh replika non-pemilih.
Number of snapshots applied by non-voter.zh: 非投票者副本应用的快照数量。
Number of snapshots applied by non-voter.zh-hant: 非投票者副本應用的快照數量。

Number of snapshots applied by voter rep.en: Number of snapshots applied by voter replicas.
Number of snapshots applied by voter rep.id: Jumlah snapshot yang diterapkan oleh replika pemilih.
Number of snapshots applied by voter rep.zh: 投票者副本应用的快照数量。
Number of snapshots applied by voter rep.zh-hant: 投票者副本應用的快照數量。

Number of snapshots applied for initial.en: Number of snapshots applied for initial up replication.
Number of snapshots applied for initial.id: Jumlah snapshot yang diterapkan untuk replikasi awal.
Number of snapshots applied for initial.zh: 应用于初始复制的快照数量。
Number of snapshots applied for initial.zh-hant: 應用於初始複製的快照數量。

Number of snapshots queued to receive..en: Number of snapshots queued to receive.
Number of snapshots queued to receive..id: Jumlah snapshot yang diantri untuk diterima.

Number of snapshots queued to send..en: Number of snapshots queued to send.
Number of snapshots queued to send..id: Jumlah snapshot yang diantri untuk dikirim.

Number of snapshots that were delegated.en: Number of snapshots that were delegated to a different node and resulted in failure on that delegate. There are numerous reasons a failure can occur on a delegate such as timeout, the delegate Raft log being too far behind the delegate being too busy to send.
Number of snapshots that were delegated.id: Jumlah snapshot yang didelegasikan ke node berbeda dan mengakibatkan kegagalan pada delegasi tersebut. Ada banyak alasan kegagalan dapat terjadi pada delegasi seperti waktu habis, log Raft delegasi terlalu jauh di belakang delegasi karena terlalu sibuk untuk dikirim.
Number of snapshots that were delegated.zh: 委托给不同节点并导致该委托失败的快照数量。委托发生故障的原因有很多，例如超时、委托 Raft 日志落后于委托太远而无法发送。
Number of snapshots that were delegated.zh-hant: 委託給不同節點並導致該委託失敗的快照數量。委託發生故障的原因有很多，例如逾時、委託 Raft 日誌落後於委託太遠而無法發送。

Number of snapshots that were delegated.en: Number of snapshots that were delegated to a different node and resulted in success on that delegate. This does not count self delegated snapshots.
Number of snapshots that were delegated.id: Jumlah snapshot yang didelegasikan ke node berbeda dan menghasilkan keberhasilan pada delegasi tersebut. Ini tidak termasuk snapshot yang didelegasikan sendiri.
Number of snapshots that were delegated.zh: 委托给不同节点并在该委托上取得成功的快照数量。这不计算自委托快照。
Number of snapshots that were delegated.zh-hant: 委託給不同節點並在該委託上取得成功的快照數量。這不計算自委託快照。

Number of spans created by the traced ap.en: Number of spans created by the traced application as reported by DDTrace telemetry.
Number of spans created by the traced ap.id: Jumlah bentang yang dibuat oleh aplikasi yang dilacak seperti yang dilaporkan oleh telemetri DDTrace.
Number of spans created by the traced ap.zh: DDTrace 遥测报告的跟踪应用程序创建的跨度数。
Number of spans created by the traced ap.zh-hant: DDTrace 遙測報告的追蹤應用程式所建立的跨度數。

Number of spans finished by the traced a.en: Number of spans finished by the traced application as reported by DDTrace telemetry.
Number of spans finished by the traced a.id: Jumlah bentang yang diselesaikan oleh aplikasi yang dilacak seperti yang dilaporkan oleh telemetri DDTrace.
Number of spans finished by the traced a.zh: DDTrace 遥测报告的跟踪应用程序完成的跨度数。
Number of spans finished by the traced a.zh-hant: DDTrace 遙測報告的追蹤應用程式完成的跨度數。

Number of stack traces dropped by query.en: Number of stack traces dropped by query profiler or signal handler because pipe is full or cannot write to pipe.
Number of stack traces dropped by query.id: Jumlah pelacakan tumpukan yang dihilangkan oleh profiler kueri atau pengendali sinyal karena pipa penuh atau tidak dapat menulis ke pipa.
Number of stack traces dropped by query.zh: 由于管道已满或无法写入管道而被查询分析器或信号处理程序删除的堆栈跟踪数。
Number of stack traces dropped by query.zh-hant: 由於管道已滿或無法寫入管道而被查詢分析器或訊號處理程序刪除的堆疊追蹤數。

Number of stale statistics rows that are.en: Number of stale statistics rows that are removed.
Number of stale statistics rows that are.id: Jumlah baris statistik usang yang dihapus.

Number of statements resulting in a plan.en: Number of statements resulting in a planning or runtime error (internal queries).
Number of statements resulting in a plan.id: Jumlah pernyataan yang mengakibatkan kesalahan perencanaan atau runtime (kueri internal).
Number of statements resulting in a plan.zh: 导致计划或运行时错误的语句数（内部查询）。
Number of statements resulting in a plan.zh-hant: 導致計劃或執行時期錯誤的語句數（內部查詢）。

Number of statements which the cost-base.en: Number of statements which the cost-based optimizer was unable to plan (internal queries).
Number of statements which the cost-base.id: Jumlah pernyataan yang tidak dapat direncanakan oleh pengoptimal berbasis biaya (kueri internal).
Number of statements which the cost-base.zh: 基于成本的优化器无法计划的语句数（内部查询）。
Number of statements which the cost-base.zh-hant: 基於成本的最佳化器無法規劃的語句數（內部查詢）。

Number of statements which the cost-base.en: Number of statements which the cost-based optimizer was unable to plan.
Number of statements which the cost-base.id: Jumlah pernyataan yang tidak dapat direncanakan oleh pengoptimal berbasis biaya.
Number of statements which the cost-base.zh: 基于成本的优化器无法计划的语句数。
Number of statements which the cost-base.zh-hant: 基於成本的優化器無法規劃的語句數。

Number of stream load tasks currently ru.en: Number of stream load tasks currently running.
Number of stream load tasks currently ru.id: Jumlah tugas pemuatan aliran yang sedang berjalan.
Number of stream load tasks currently ru.zh: 当前正在运行的流加载任务数。
Number of stream load tasks currently ru.zh-hant: 目前正在運行的流加載任務數。

Number of streaming requests on port 809.en: Number of streaming requests on port 8091 now idle.
Number of streaming requests on port 809.id: Jumlah permintaan streaming pada port 8091 kini menganggur.
Number of streaming requests on port 809.zh: 端口 8091 上的流请求数量现在处于空闲状态。
Number of streaming requests on port 809.zh-hant: 連接埠 8091 上的串流請求數量現在處於空閒狀態。

Number of successful ClearRange operatio.en: Number of successful ClearRange operations during GC.
Number of successful ClearRange operatio.id: Jumlah operasi ClearRange yang berhasil selama GC.
Number of successful ClearRange operatio.zh: GC 期间成功的 ClearRange 操作数。
Number of successful ClearRange operatio.zh-hant: GC 期間成功的 ClearRange 運算元。

Number of successful HTTP responses rece.en: Number of successful HTTP responses received by the replicator.
Number of successful HTTP responses rece.id: Jumlah respons HTTP berhasil yang diterima oleh replikator.
Number of successful HTTP responses rece.zh: 复制器收到的成功 HTTP 响应的数量。
Number of successful HTTP responses rece.zh-hant: 複製器收到的成功 HTTP 回應的數量。

Number of successful client-side transac.en: Number of successful client-side transaction refreshes. A refresh may be preemptive or reactive. A reactive refresh is performed after a request throws an error because a refresh is needed for it to succeed. In these cases, the request will be re-issued as an auto-retry (see txn.refresh.auto_retries) after the refresh succeeds.
Number of successful client-side transac.id: Jumlah penyegaran transaksi sisi klien yang berhasil. Penyegaran mungkin bersifat preemptif atau reaktif. Penyegaran reaktif dilakukan setelah permintaan menimbulkan kesalahan karena penyegaran diperlukan agar permintaan berhasil. Dalam kasus ini, permintaan akan dikeluarkan kembali sebagai percobaan ulang otomatis (lihat txn.refresh.auto_retries) setelah penyegaran berhasil.
Number of successful client-side transac.zh: 成功的客户端事务刷新次数。刷新可以是抢占式的或反应性的。响应式刷新是在请求引发错误后执行的，因为需要刷新才能成功。在这些情况下，刷新成功后，请求将作为自动重试重新发出（请参阅 txn.refresh.auto_retries）。
Number of successful client-side transac.zh-hant: 成功的客戶端事務刷新次數。刷新可以是搶佔式的或反應性的。響應式刷新是在請求引發錯誤後執行的，因為需要刷新才能成功。在這些情況下，刷新成功後，請求將作為自動重試重新發出（請參閱 txn.refresh.auto_retries）。

Number of threads sending data to networ.zh-hant: 向網路發送資料的線程數。僅包含 ClickHouse 相關的網路交互，不包含 3rd 方庫。

Number of threads used for INSERT into D.en: Number of threads used for INSERT into Distributed running a task.
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.id: Jumlah thread yang digunakan untuk INSERT ke dalam Distributed menjalankan tugas.
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.zh: 用于 INSERT 到运行任务的分布式的线程数。
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.zh-hant: 用於 INSERT 到執行任務的分散式的執行緒數。

Number of threads used for INSERT into D.en: Number of threads used for INSERT into Distributed.
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.id: Jumlah thread yang digunakan untuk INSERT ke dalam Distributed.
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.zh: 用于 INSERT 到分布式的线程数。
Number of threads used for INSERT into D.zh-hant: 用於 INSERT 到分散式的執行緒數。

Number of threads waiting for asynchrono.en: Number of threads waiting for asynchronous read.
Number of threads waiting for asynchrono.id: Jumlah thread yang menunggu pembacaan asinkron.
Number of threads waiting for asynchrono.zh: 等待异步读取的线程数。
Number of threads waiting for asynchrono.zh-hant: 等待非同步讀取的執行緒數。

Number of threads waiting for lock in Co.en: Number of threads waiting for lock in Context. This is global lock.
Number of threads waiting for lock in Co.id: Jumlah thread yang menunggu untuk dikunci dalam Konteks. Ini adalah kunci global.
Number of threads waiting for lock in Co.zh: 上下文中等待锁定的线程数。这是全局锁。
Number of threads waiting for lock in Co.zh-hant: 上下文中等待鎖定的執行緒數。這是全域鎖。

Number of threads waiting for read on a.en: Number of threads waiting for read on a table RWLock.
Number of threads waiting for read on a.id: Jumlah thread yang menunggu untuk dibaca pada tabel RWLock.
Number of threads waiting for read on a.zh: 等待表 RWLock 读取的线程数。
Number of threads waiting for read on a.zh-hant: 等待表 RWLock 讀取的執行緒數。

Number of threads waiting for write on a.en: Number of threads waiting for write on a table RWLock.
Number of threads waiting for write on a.id: Jumlah thread yang menunggu untuk ditulis pada tabel RWLock.
Number of threads waiting for write on a.zh: 等待在表 RWLock 上写入的线程数。
Number of threads waiting for write on a.zh-hant: 等待在表 RWLock 上寫入的執行緒數。

Number of times QueryProfiler had been r.en: Number of times QueryProfiler had been run.

Number of times RangeFeed failed because.en: Number of times RangeFeed failed because memory budget was exceeded.
Number of times RangeFeed failed because.id: Berapa kali RangeFeed gagal karena anggaran memori terlampaui.
Number of times RangeFeed failed because.zh: RangeFeed 由于超出内存预算而失败的次数。
Number of times RangeFeed failed because.zh-hant: RangeFeed 因超出記憶體預算而失敗的次數。

Number of times RangeFeed waited for bud.en: Number of times RangeFeed waited for budget availability.
Number of times RangeFeed waited for bud.id: Berapa kali RangeFeed menunggu ketersediaan anggaran.
Number of times RangeFeed waited for bud.zh: RangeFeed 等待可用预算的次数。
Number of times RangeFeed waited for bud.zh-hant: RangeFeed 等待可用預算的次數。

Number of times SQL Stats are flushed to.en: Number of times SQL Stats are flushed to persistent storage.
Number of times SQL Stats are flushed to.id: Berapa kali Statistik SQL dipindahkan ke penyimpanan persisten.
Number of times SQL Stats are flushed to.zh: SQL 统计信息刷新到持久存储的次数。
Number of times SQL Stats are flushed to.zh-hant: SQL 統計資訊刷新到持久性儲存的次數。

Number of times a Job has been Pending i.en: Number of times a Job has been Pending in a Queue
Number of times a Job has been Pending i.id: Berapa kali Pekerjaan Tertunda dalam Antrean
Number of times a Job has been Pending i.zh: 作业在队列中待处理的次数
Number of times a Job has been Pending i.zh-hant: 作業在佇列中待處理的次數

Number of times a block has been written.en: Number of times a block has been written out from a shared or local buffer in order to make it available for another use.
Number of times a block has been written.id: Berapa kali sebuah blok ditulis dari buffer bersama atau lokal agar tersedia untuk penggunaan lain.
Number of times a block has been written.zh: 为了使其可供其他用途而从共享或本地缓冲区中写出块的次数。
Number of times a block has been written.zh-hant: 為了使其可供其他用途而從共用或本機緩衝區寫出區塊的次數。

Number of times a block of data has been.en: Number of times a block of data has been found in the uncompressed cache (and decompression was avoided).
Number of times a block of data has been.id: Berapa kali blok data ditemukan dalam cache yang tidak terkompresi (dan dekompresi dihindari).
Number of times a block of data has been.zh: 在未压缩的缓存中找到数据块的次数（并且避免了解压缩）。
Number of times a block of data has been.zh-hant: 在未壓縮的快取中找到資料塊的次數（並且避免了解壓縮）。

Number of times a block of data has not.en: Number of times a block of data has not been found in the uncompressed cache (and required decompression).
Number of times a block of data has not.id: Berapa kali blok data tidak ditemukan dalam cache yang tidak dikompresi (dan memerlukan dekompresi).
Number of times a block of data has not.zh: 在未压缩的缓存中未找到数据块（且需要解压缩）的次数。
Number of times a block of data has not.zh-hant: 在未壓縮的快取中未找到資料塊（且需要解壓縮）的次數。

Number of times a buffer in a 'Buffer' t.en: Number of times a buffer in a 'Buffer' table was flushed.
Number of times a buffer in a 'Buffer' t.id: Berapa kali buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer' dikosongkan.
Number of times a buffer in a 'Buffer' t.zh: “Buffer”表中的缓冲区被刷新的次数。
Number of times a buffer in a 'Buffer' t.zh-hant: 「Buffer」表中的緩衝區被刷新的次數。

Number of times a buffer in the 'Buffer'.en: Number of times a buffer in the 'Buffer' table has not been able to flush due to error writing in the destination table.
Number of times a buffer in the 'Buffer'.id: Berapa kali buffer di tabel 'Buffer' tidak dapat di-flush karena kesalahan penulisan di tabel tujuan.
Number of times a buffer in the 'Buffer'.zh: 由于目标表中写入错误而导致“Buffer”表中的缓冲区无法刷新的次数。
Number of times a buffer in the 'Buffer'.zh-hant: 由於目標表中寫入錯誤而導致「Buffer」表中的緩衝區無法刷新的次數。

Number of times a change feed aggregator.en: Number of times a change feed aggregator node attempted to reduce the size of message batches it emitted to the Sink.
Number of times a change feed aggregator.id: Berapa kali node agregator umpan perubahan mencoba mengurangi ukuran kumpulan pesan yang dikirimkan ke Sink.
Number of times a change feed aggregator.zh: 更改提要聚合器节点尝试减少其发送到接收器的消息批次大小的次数。
Number of times a change feed aggregator.zh-hant: 更改提要聚合器節點嘗試減少其傳送至接收器的訊息批次大小的次數。

Number of times a compilation of generat.en: Number of times a compilation of generated LLVM code (to create fused function for complex expressions) was initiated.
Number of times a compilation of generat.id: Berapa kali kompilasi kode LLVM yang dihasilkan (untuk membuat fungsi gabungan untuk ekspresi kompleks) dimulai.
Number of times a compilation of generat.zh: 启动生成的 LLVM 代码编译（为复杂表达式创建融合函数）的次数。
Number of times a compilation of generat.zh-hant: 啟動產生的 LLVM 程式碼編譯（為複雜表達式建立融合函數）的次數。

Number of times a compiled function was.en: Number of times a compiled function was executed.
Number of times a compiled function was.id: Berapa kali fungsi yang dikompilasi dijalankan.
Number of times a compiled function was.zh: 执行已编译函数的次数。
Number of times a compiled function was.zh-hant: 執行已編譯函數的次數。

Number of times a connection owner crash.en: Number of times a connection owner crashes while owning at least one connection.
Number of times a connection owner crash.id: Berapa kali pemilik koneksi mengalami error saat memiliki setidaknya satu koneksi.
Number of times a connection owner crash.zh: 连接所有者在拥有至少一个连接时崩溃的次数。
Number of times a connection owner crash.zh-hant: 連接所有者在擁有至少一個連接時崩潰的次數。

Number of times a criteria on max bytes.en: Number of times a criteria on max bytes threshold has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table.
Number of times a criteria on max bytes.id: Berapa kali kriteria ambang batas byte maksimum tercapai untuk menghapus buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'.
Number of times a criteria on max bytes.zh: 达到最大字节阈值标准以刷新“缓冲区”表中缓冲区的次数。
Number of times a criteria on max bytes.zh-hant: 達到最大位元組閾值標準以刷新“緩衝區”表中緩衝區的次數。

Number of times a criteria on max rows t.en: Number of times a criteria on max rows threshold has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table.
Number of times a criteria on max rows t.id: Berapa kali kriteria pada ambang batas baris maksimal telah tercapai untuk menghapus buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'.
Number of times a criteria on max rows t.zh: 达到最大行阈值标准以刷新“缓冲区”表中缓冲区的次数。
Number of times a criteria on max rows t.zh-hant: 達到最大行閾值標準以刷新「緩衝區」表中緩衝區的次數。

Number of times a criteria on max time t.en: Number of times a criteria on max time threshold has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table.
Number of times a criteria on max time t.id: Berapa kali kriteria ambang waktu maksimum tercapai untuk menghapus buffer di tabel 'Buffer'.
Number of times a criteria on max time t.zh: 达到最大时间阈值标准以刷新“缓冲区”表中缓冲区的次数。
Number of times a criteria on max time t.zh-hant: 達到最大時間閾值標準以刷新「緩衝區」表中緩衝區的次數。

Number of times a criteria on min thresh.en: Number of times a criteria on min thresholds has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table.
Number of times a criteria on min thresh.id: Berapa kali kriteria ambang minimum tercapai untuk menghapus buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'.
Number of times a criteria on min thresh.zh: 达到最小阈值标准以刷新“缓冲区”表中缓冲区的次数。
Number of times a criteria on min thresh.zh-hant: 達到最小閾值標準以刷新「緩衝區」表中緩衝區的次數。

Number of times a data part that we want.en: Number of times a data part that we wanted does not exist on any replica (even on replicas that are offline right now). That data parts are definitely lost. This is normal due to asynchronous replication (if quorum inserts were not enabled), when the replica on which the data part was written was failed and when it became online after fail it does not contain that data part.
Number of times a data part that we want.id: Berapa kali bagian data yang kita inginkan tidak ada pada replika mana pun (bahkan pada replika yang sedang offline saat ini). Bagian data itu pasti hilang. Hal ini normal karena replikasi asinkron (jika penyisipan kuorum tidak diaktifkan), ketika replika tempat bagian data ditulis gagal dan ketika menjadi online setelah gagal, replika tersebut tidak berisi bagian data tersebut.
Number of times a data part that we want.zh: 我们想要的数据部分在任何副本上都不存在的次数（即使在现在离线的副本上）。该数据部分肯定会丢失。这是正常的，因为异步复制（如果未启用仲裁插入），当写入数据部分的副本发生故障并且当它在故障后联机时，它不包含该数据部分。
Number of times a data part that we want.zh-hant: 我們想要的資料部分在任何副本上都不存在的次數（即使在現在離線的副本上）。該數據部分肯定會遺失。這是正常的，因為非同步複製（如果未啟用仲裁插入），當寫入資料部分的副本發生故障並且當它在故障後聯機時，它不包含該資料部分。

Number of times a data part was covered.en: Number of times a data part was covered by another data part that has been fetched from a replica (so, we have marked a covered data part as obsolete and no longer needed).
Number of times a data part was covered.id: Berapa kali suatu bagian data dicakup oleh bagian data lain yang telah diambil dari replika (jadi, kami telah menandai bagian data yang dicakup sebagai usang dan tidak diperlukan lagi).
Number of times a data part was covered.zh: 一个数据部分被从副本中获取的另一个数据部分覆盖的次数（因此，我们已将覆盖的数据部分标记为已过时且不再需要）。
Number of times a data part was covered.zh-hant: 一個資料部分被從副本中獲取的另一個資料部分覆蓋的次數（因此，我們已將覆蓋的資料部分標記為已過時且不再需要）。

Number of times a data part was download.en: Number of times a data part was downloaded from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table.
Number of times a data part was download.id: Berapa kali bagian data diunduh dari replika tabel ReplicationdMergeTree.
Number of times a data part was download.zh: 从 ReplicatedMergeTree 表的副本下载数据部分的次数。
Number of times a data part was download.zh-hant: 從 ReplicatedMergeTree 表的副本下載資料部分的次數。

Number of times a data part was failed t.en: Number of times a data part was failed to download from replica of a ReplicatedMergeTree table.
Number of times a data part was failed t.id: Berapa kali bagian data gagal diunduh dari replika tabel ReplicationdMergeTree.
Number of times a data part was failed t.zh: 从 ReplicatedMergeTree 表的副本下载数据部分失败的次数。
Number of times a data part was failed t.zh-hant: 從 ReplicatedMergeTree 表的副本下載資料部分失敗的次數。

Number of times a database was changed..en: Number of times a database was changed.

Number of times a database was purged..en: Number of times a database was purged.

Number of times a directory lookup has o.en: Number of times a directory lookup has occurred.

Number of times a document was read from.en: Number of times a document was read from a database.
Number of times a document was read from.id: Berapa kali dokumen dibaca dari database.
Number of times a document was read from.zh: 从数据库读取文档的次数。
Number of times a document was read from.zh-hant: 從資料庫讀取文檔的次數。

Number of times a duplicate hash id has.en: Number of times a duplicate hash id has been found in asynchronous INSERT hash id cache.
Number of times a duplicate hash id has.id: Berapa kali id hash duplikat ditemukan di cache id hash INSERT asinkron.
Number of times a duplicate hash id has.zh: 在异步 INSERT 哈希 ID 缓存中发现重复哈希 ID 的次数。
Number of times a duplicate hash id has.zh-hant: 在非同步 INSERT 哈希 ID 快取中發現重複哈希 ID 的次數。

Number of times a file has been found in.en: Number of times a file has been found in the MMap cache (for the `mmap` read_method), so we didn't have to `mmap` it again.
Number of times a file has been found in.id: Berapa kali file ditemukan di cache MMap (untuk metode_baca `mmap`), jadi kami tidak perlu `mmap` lagi.
Number of times a file has been found in.zh: 在 MMap 缓存中找到文件的次数（对于“mmap”read_method），因此我们不必再次“mmap”它。
Number of times a file has been found in.zh-hant: 在 MMap 快取中找到檔案的次數（對於「mmap」read_method），因此我們不必再次「mmap」它。

Number of times a file has been found in.en: Number of times a file has been found in the opened file cache, so we didn't have to open it again.
Number of times a file has been found in.id: Berapa kali suatu file ditemukan dalam cache file yang dibuka, sehingga kami tidak perlu membukanya lagi.
Number of times a file has been found in.zh: 在打开的文件缓存中找到文件的次数，因此我们不必再次打开它。
Number of times a file has been found in.zh-hant: 在開啟的檔案快取中找到檔案的次數，因此我們不必再次開啟它。

Number of times a file has been found in.en: Number of times a file has been found in the opened file cache, so we had to open it again.
Number of times a file has been found in.id: Berapa kali suatu file ditemukan dalam cache file yang dibuka, sehingga kami harus membukanya lagi.
Number of times a file has been found in.zh: 在打开的文件缓存中找到文件，因此我们必须再次打开它的次数。
Number of times a file has been found in.zh-hant: 在開啟的文件快取中找到文件，因此我們必須再次開啟它的次數。

Number of times a file has been grown du.en: Number of times a file has been grown due to writes beyond its existing end.
Number of times a file has been grown du.id: Berapa kali suatu file dikembangkan karena penulisan di luar tujuan yang ada.
Number of times a file has been grown du.zh: 由于写入超出其现有末尾而导致文件增长的次数。
Number of times a file has been grown du.zh-hant: 由於寫入超出其現有末尾而導致文件增長的次數。

Number of times a file has not been foun.en: Number of times a file has not been found in the MMap cache (for the `mmap` read_method), so we had to `mmap` it again.
Number of times a file has not been foun.id: Berapa kali file tidak ditemukan di cache MMap (untuk metode_baca `mmap`), jadi kami harus `mmap` lagi.
Number of times a file has not been foun.zh: 在 MMap 缓存中未找到文件的次数（对于“mmap”read_method），因此我们必须再次“mmap”它。
Number of times a file has not been foun.zh-hant: 在 MMap 快取中找不到檔案的次數（對於「mmap」read_method），因此我們必須再次「mmap」它。

Number of times a file was removed while.en: Number of times a file was removed while still open by another process.
Number of times a file was removed while.id: Berapa kali file dihapus saat masih dibuka oleh proses lain.
Number of times a file was removed while.zh: 文件在仍被另一个进程打开时被删除的次数。
Number of times a file was removed while.zh-hant: 檔案在仍被另一個進程開啟時被刪除的次數。

Number of times a group of pages have be.en: Number of times a group of pages have been read.
Number of times a group of pages have be.id: Berapa kali sekelompok halaman telah dibaca.
Number of times a group of pages have be.zh: 一组页面已被读取的次数。
Number of times a group of pages have be.zh-hant: 一組頁面已被讀取的次數。

Number of times a group of pages have be.en: Number of times a group of pages have been written.
Number of times a group of pages have be.id: Berapa kali sekelompok halaman telah ditulis.
Number of times a group of pages have be.zh: 一组页面被写入的次数。
Number of times a group of pages have be.zh-hant: 一組頁面被寫入的次數。

Number of times a packed was dropped whi.en: Number of times a packed was dropped while sending via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times a packed was dropped whi.id: Berapa kali paket dijatuhkan saat mengirim melalui antarmuka jaringan. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times a packed was dropped whi.zh: 通过网络接口发送数据包时丢失的次数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
Number of times a packed was dropped whi.zh-hant: 透過網路介面發送資料包時遺失的次數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

Number of times a query result has been.en: Number of times a query result has been found in the query cache (and query computation was avoided).
Number of times a query result has been.id: Berapa kali hasil kueri ditemukan di cache kueri (dan penghitungan kueri dihindari).
Number of times a query result has been.zh: 在查询缓存中找到查询结果的次数（并且避免了查询计算）。
Number of times a query result has been.zh-hant: 在查詢快取中找到查詢結果的次數（並且避免了查詢計算）。

Number of times a query result has not b.en: Number of times a query result has not been found in the query cache (and required query computation).
Number of times a query result has not b.id: Berapa kali hasil kueri tidak ditemukan dalam cache kueri (dan diperlukan komputasi kueri).
Number of times a query result has not b.zh: 在查询缓存中未找到查询结果（以及所需的查询计算）的次数。
Number of times a query result has not b.zh-hant: 在查詢快取中未找到查詢結果（以及所需的查詢計算）的次數。

Number of times a read buffer using `mma.en: Number of times a read buffer using `mmap` was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods).
Number of times a read buffer using `mma.id: Berapa kali buffer baca menggunakan `mmap` dibuat untuk membaca data (sambil memilih di antara metode baca lainnya).
Number of times a read buffer using `mma.zh: 使用“mmap”创建读取缓冲区以读取数据的次数（同时在其他读取方法中进行选择）。
Number of times a read buffer using `mma.zh-hant: 使用“mmap”建立讀取緩衝區以讀取資料的次數（同時在其他讀取方法中進行選擇）。

Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.en: Number of times a read buffer with O_DIRECT was attempted to be created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods), but the OS did not allow it (due to lack of filesystem support or other reasons) and we fallen back to the ordinary reading method.
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.id: Berapa kali buffer baca dengan O_DIRECT dicoba dibuat untuk membaca data (sambil memilih di antara metode baca lainnya), namun OS tidak mengizinkannya (karena kurangnya dukungan sistem file atau alasan lain) dan kami kembali ke metode membaca biasa.
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.zh: 尝试创建 O_DIRECT 读缓冲区来读取数据（同时选择其他读取方法）的次数，但操作系统不允许（由于缺乏文件系统支持或其他原因），我们又回到了普通的读取方法。
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.zh-hant: 嘗試建立 O_DIRECT 讀取緩衝區來讀取資料（同時選擇其他讀取方法）的次數，但作業系統不允許（由於缺乏檔案系統支援或其他原因），我們又回到了普通的讀取方法。

Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.en: Number of times a read buffer with O_DIRECT was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods).
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.id: Berapa kali buffer baca dengan O_DIRECT dibuat untuk membaca data (sambil memilih di antara metode baca lainnya).
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.zh: 创建具有 O_DIRECT 的读取缓冲区用于读取数据的次数（同时在其他读取方法中进行选择）。
Number of times a read buffer with O_DIR.zh-hant: 建立具有 O_DIRECT 的讀取緩衝區用於讀取資料的次數（同時在其他讀取方法中進行選擇）。

Number of times a read buffer with `mmap.en: Number of times a read buffer with `mmap` was attempted to be created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods), but the OS did not allow it (due to lack of filesystem support or other reasons) and we fallen back to the ordinary reading method.
Number of times a read buffer with `mmap.id: Berapa kali buffer baca dengan `mmap` dicoba dibuat untuk membaca data (sambil memilih di antara metode baca lainnya), namun OS tidak mengizinkannya (karena kurangnya dukungan sistem file atau alasan lain) dan kami kembali ke metode membaca biasa.
Number of times a read buffer with `mmap.zh: 尝试创建带有“mmap”的读取缓冲区来读取数据（同时在其他读取方法中进行选择）的次数，但操作系统不允许（由于缺乏文件系统支持或其他原因），我们又回到了普通的读取方法。
Number of times a read buffer with `mmap.zh-hant: 嘗試建立具有「mmap」的讀取緩衝區來讀取資料（同時在其他讀取方法中進行選擇）的次數，但作業系統不允許（由於缺乏檔案系統支援或其他原因），我們又回到了普通的讀取方法。

Number of times a read from a scalar sub.en: Number of times a read from a scalar sub query was done using the global cache
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.id: Berapa kali pembacaan dari subkueri skalar dilakukan menggunakan cache global
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh: 使用全局缓存从标量子查询读取的次数
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh-hant: 使用全域快取從標量子查詢讀取的次數

Number of times a read from a scalar sub.en: Number of times a read from a scalar sub query was done using the local cache
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.id: Berapa kali pembacaan dari subkueri skalar dilakukan menggunakan cache lokal
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh: 使用本地缓存从标量子查询读取的次数
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh-hant: 使用本地快取從標量子查詢讀取的次數

Number of times a read from a scalar sub.en: Number of times a read from a scalar sub query was not cached and had to be calculated completely
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.id: Berapa kali pembacaan dari subkueri skalar tidak di-cache dan harus dihitung sepenuhnya
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh: 从标量子查询读取未缓存且必须完全计算的次数
Number of times a read from a scalar sub.zh-hant: 從標量子查詢讀取未快取且必須完全計算的次數

Number of times a read lock was acquired.en: Number of times a read lock was acquired (in a heavy RWLock).
Number of times a read lock was acquired.id: Berapa kali kunci baca diperoleh (dalam RWLock yang berat).
Number of times a read lock was acquired.zh: 获取读锁的次数（在重型 RWLock 中）。
Number of times a read lock was acquired.zh-hant: 取得讀鎖的次數（在重型 RWLock 中）。

Number of times a request has had a majo.en: Number of times a request has had a major timeout for a given operation.
Number of times a request has had a majo.id: Berapa kali permintaan mengalami waktu tunggu yang lama untuk operasi tertentu.
Number of times a request has had a majo.zh: 请求对于给定操作发生严重超时的次数。
Number of times a request has had a majo.zh-hant: 請求對於給定操作發生嚴重超時的次數。

Number of times a row lock had to be wai.en: Number of times a row lock had to be waited for (innodb_row_lock_waits)
Number of times a row lock had to be wai.id: Berapa kali kunci baris harus ditunggu (innodb_row_lock_waits)

Number of times a schema from cache was.en: Number of times a schema from cache was evicted due to overflow
Number of times a schema from cache was.id: Berapa kali skema dari cache dikeluarkan karena meluap
Number of times a schema from cache was.zh: 由于溢出而从缓存中逐出模式的次数
Number of times a schema from cache was.zh-hant: 由於溢位而從快取中逐出模式的次數

Number of times a schema from cache was.en: Number of times a schema from cache was used for schema inference
Number of times a schema from cache was.id: Berapa kali skema dari cache digunakan untuk inferensi skema
Number of times a schema from cache was.zh: 使用缓存中的模式进行模式推断的次数
Number of times a schema from cache was.zh-hant: 使用快取中的模式進行模式推斷的次數

Number of times a schema in cache became.en: Number of times a schema in cache became invalid due to changes in data
Number of times a schema in cache became.id: Berapa kali skema dalam cache menjadi tidak valid karena perubahan data
Number of times a schema in cache became.zh: 缓存中的架构因数据更改而无效的次数
Number of times a schema in cache became.zh-hant: 快取中的架構因資料變更而無效的次數

Number of times a schema is not in cache.en: Number of times a schema is not in cache while schema inference
Number of times a schema is not in cache.id: Berapa kali skema tidak ada dalam cache saat inferensi skema
Number of times a schema is not in cache.zh: 模式推理时模式不在缓存中的次数
Number of times a schema is not in cache.zh-hant: 模式推理時模式不在快取中的次數

Number of times a sleep function (sleep,.en: Number of times a sleep function (sleep, sleepEachRow) has been called.
Number of times a sleep function (sleep,.id: Berapa kali fungsi tidur (sleep, sleepEachRow) dipanggil.

Number of times a temporary file was wri.en: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for JOIN in external memory.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.id: Berapa kali file sementara ditulis ke disk untuk GABUNG di memori eksternal.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh: 将临时文件写入磁盘以进行外部内存中的 JOIN 的次数。
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh-hant: 將臨時檔案寫入磁碟以進行外部記憶體中的 JOIN 的次數。

Number of times a temporary file was wri.en: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for aggregation in external memory.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.id: Berapa kali file sementara ditulis ke disk untuk diagregasi di memori eksternal.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh: 将临时文件写入磁盘以在外部内存中进行聚合的次数。
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh-hant: 將臨時檔案寫入磁碟以在外部記憶體中進行聚合的次數。

Number of times a temporary file was wri.en: Number of times a temporary file was written to disk for sorting in external memory.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.id: Berapa kali file sementara ditulis ke disk untuk disortir di memori eksternal.
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh: 将临时文件写入磁盘以便在外部存储器中排序的次数。
Number of times a temporary file was wri.zh-hant: 將臨時檔案寫入磁碟以便在外部記憶體中排序的次數。

Number of times a transaction failed to.en: Number of times a transaction failed to commit due to storage errors.
Number of times a transaction failed to.id: Berapa kali transaksi gagal dilakukan karena kesalahan penyimpanan.
Number of times a transaction failed to.zh: 由于存储错误而导致事务未能提交的次数。
Number of times a transaction failed to.zh-hant: 因儲存錯誤而導致交易未能提交的次數。

Number of times a worker is gracefully s.en: Number of times a worker is gracefully shut down.
Number of times a worker is gracefully s.id: Berapa kali seorang pekerja ditutup dengan baik.
Number of times a worker is gracefully s.zh: 工作线程正常关闭的次数。
Number of times a worker is gracefully s.zh-hant: 工作執行緒正常關閉的次數。

Number of times a worker unexpectedly te.en: Number of times a worker unexpectedly terminates.
Number of times a worker unexpectedly te.id: Berapa kali seorang pekerja diberhentikan secara tidak terduga.
Number of times a worker unexpectedly te.zh: 工作人员意外终止的次数。
Number of times a worker unexpectedly te.zh-hant: 工作人員意外終止的次數。

Number of times a write lock was acquire.en: Number of times a write lock was acquired (in a heavy RWLock).
Number of times a write lock was acquire.id: Berapa kali kunci tulis diperoleh (dalam RWLock yang berat).
Number of times a write lock was acquire.zh: 获取写锁的次数（在重型 RWLock 中）。
Number of times a write lock was acquire.zh-hant: 取得寫鎖的次數（在重型 RWLock 中）。

Number of times an actual RPC request ha.en: Number of times an actual RPC request has been transmitted for a given operation.
Number of times an actual RPC request ha.id: Berapa kali permintaan RPC aktual dikirimkan untuk operasi tertentu.
Number of times an actual RPC request ha.zh: 针对给定操作传输实际 RPC 请求的次数。
Number of times an actual RPC request ha.zh-hant: 針對給定操作傳輸實際 RPC 請求的次數。

Number of times an entry has been found.en: Number of times an entry has been found in the mark cache, so we didn't have to load a mark file.
Number of times an entry has been found.id: Berapa kali entri ditemukan di cache tanda, jadi kami tidak perlu memuat file tanda.
Number of times an entry has been found.zh: 在标记缓存中找到条目的次数，因此我们不必加载标记文件。
Number of times an entry has been found.zh-hant: 在標記快取中找到條目的次數，因此我們不必載入標記檔案。

Number of times an entry has not been fo.en: Number of times an entry has not been found in the mark cache, so we had to load a mark file in memory, which is a costly operation, adding to query latency.
Number of times an entry has not been fo.id: Berapa kali entri tidak ditemukan di cache tanda, jadi kami harus memuat file tanda di memori, yang merupakan operasi mahal, sehingga menambah latensi kueri.
Number of times an entry has not been fo.zh: 在标记缓存中未找到条目的次数，因此我们必须在内存中加载标记文件，这是一项成本高昂的操作，会增加查询延迟。
Number of times an entry has not been fo.zh-hant: 在標記快取中未找到條目的次數，因此我們必須在記憶體中載入標記文件，這是一項成本高昂的操作，會增加查詢延遲。

Number of times an error happened while.en: Number of times an error happened while trying to remove ephemeral node. This is not an issue, because our implementation of ZooKeeper library guarantee that the session will expire and the node will be removed.
Number of times an error happened while.id: Berapa kali kesalahan terjadi saat mencoba menghapus simpul sementara. Ini bukan masalah, karena implementasi perpustakaan ZooKeeper kami menjamin bahwa sesi akan berakhir dan node akan dihapus.
Number of times an error happened while.zh: 尝试删除临时节点时发生错误的次数。这不是问题，因为我们的 ZooKeeper 库的实现保证会话将过期并且节点将被删除。
Number of times an error happened while.zh-hant: 嘗試刪除臨時節點時發生錯誤的次數。這不是問題，因為我們的 ZooKeeper 函式庫的實作保證會話將過期並且節點將被刪除。

Number of times an inode cache is cleare.en: Number of times an inode cache is cleared.
Number of times an inode cache is cleare.zh: 清除 inode 缓存的次数。
Number of times an inode cache is cleare.zh-hant: 清除 inode 快取的次數。

Number of times approximate GROUP BY was.en: Number of times approximate GROUP BY was in effect: when aggregation was performed only on top of first 'max_rows_to_group_by' unique keys and other keys were ignored due to 'group_by_overflow_mode' = 'any'.
Number of times approximate GROUP BY was.id: Berapa kali perkiraan GROUP BY berlaku: ketika agregasi dilakukan hanya di atas kunci unik 'max_rows_to_group_by' pertama dan kunci lainnya diabaikan karena 'group_by_overflow_mode' = 'any'.
Number of times approximate GROUP BY was.zh: 近似 GROUP BY 生效的次数：仅在第一个“max_rows_to_group_by”唯一键之上执行聚合时，由于“group_by_overflow_mode”=“any”而忽略其他键。
Number of times approximate GROUP BY was.zh-hant: 近似 GROUP BY 生效的次數：僅在第一個「max_rows_to_group_by」唯一鍵之上執行聚合時，由於「group_by_overflow_mode」=「any」而忽略其他按鍵。

Number of times backed off due to NotLea.en: Number of times backed off due to NotLeaseHolderErrors during lease transfer.
Number of times backed off due to NotLea.id: Berapa kali mundur karena NotLeaseHolderErrors selama transfer sewa.
Number of times backed off due to NotLea.zh: 在租约转移期间由于 NotLeaseHolderErrors 导致的回退次数。
Number of times backed off due to NotLea.zh-hant: 在租約轉移期間由於 NotLeaseHolderErrors 而導致的回退次數。

Number of times background-only flush th.en: Number of times background-only flush threshold on bytes has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table. This is expert-only metric. If you read this and you are not an expert, stop reading.
Number of times background-only flush th.id: Berapa kali ambang batas pembilasan khusus latar belakang pada byte telah tercapai untuk mengosongkan buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'. Ini adalah metrik khusus pakar. Jika Anda membaca ini dan Anda bukan ahlinya, berhentilah membaca.
Number of times background-only flush th.zh: 达到仅后台刷新字节阈值以刷新“缓冲区”表中的缓冲区的次数。这是仅供专家使用的指标。如果您阅读本文并且您不是专家，请停止阅读。
Number of times background-only flush th.zh-hant: 達到僅後台刷新位元組閾值以刷新“緩衝區”表中的緩衝區的次數。這是僅供專家使用的指標。如果您閱讀本文並且您不是專家，請停止閱讀。

Number of times background-only flush th.en: Number of times background-only flush threshold on rows has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table. This is expert-only metric. If you read this and you are not an expert, stop reading.
Number of times background-only flush th.id: Berapa kali ambang batas pembilasan khusus latar belakang pada baris telah tercapai untuk mengosongkan buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'. Ini adalah metrik khusus pakar. Jika Anda membaca ini dan Anda bukan ahlinya, berhentilah membaca.
Number of times background-only flush th.zh: 达到行上仅后台刷新阈值以刷新“缓冲区”表中的缓冲区的次数。这是仅供专家使用的指标。如果您阅读本文并且您不是专家，请停止阅读。
Number of times background-only flush th.zh-hant: 達到行上僅後台刷新閾值以刷新“緩衝區”表中的緩衝區的次數。這是僅供專家使用的指標。如果您閱讀本文並且您不是專家，請停止閱讀。

Number of times background-only flush th.en: Number of times background-only flush threshold on time has been reached to flush a buffer in a 'Buffer' table. This is expert-only metric. If you read this and you are not an expert, stop reading.
Number of times background-only flush th.id: Berapa kali batas waktu pembilasan khusus latar belakang telah tercapai untuk melakukan pengosongan buffer dalam tabel 'Buffer'. Ini adalah metrik khusus pakar. Jika Anda membaca ini dan Anda bukan ahlinya, berhentilah membaca.
Number of times background-only flush th.zh: 达到刷新“缓冲区”表中缓冲区的仅后台刷新阈值的次数。这是仅供专家使用的指标。如果您阅读本文并且您不是专家，请停止阅读。
Number of times background-only flush th.zh-hant: 達到刷新「緩衝區」表中緩衝區的僅後台刷新閾值的次數。這是僅供專家使用的指標。如果您閱讀本文並且您不是專家，請停止閱讀。

Number of times cached dentry nodes are.en: Number of times cached dentry nodes are re-validated from the server.
Number of times cached dentry nodes are.id: Berapa kali node dentry yang di-cache divalidasi ulang dari server.
Number of times cached dentry nodes are.zh: 从服务器重新验证缓存的 dentry 节点的次数。
Number of times cached dentry nodes are.zh-hant: 從伺服器重新驗證快取的 dentry 節點的次數。

Number of times cached inode attributes.en: Number of times cached inode attributes are invalidated.
Number of times cached inode attributes.id: Berapa kali atribut inode yang di-cache tidak valid.
Number of times cached inode attributes.zh: 缓存的 inode 属性失效的次数。
Number of times cached inode attributes.zh-hant: 快取的 inode 屬性失效的次數。

Number of times cached inode attributes.en: Number of times cached inode attributes are re-validated from the server.
Number of times cached inode attributes.id: Berapa kali atribut inode yang di-cache divalidasi ulang dari server.
Number of times cached inode attributes.zh: 从服务器重新验证缓存的 inode 属性的次数。
Number of times cached inode attributes.zh-hant: 從伺服器重新驗證快取的 inode 屬性的次數。

Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.en: Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been closed voluntary.
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.id: Berapa kali koneksi dengan ZooKeeper ditutup secara sukarela.
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.zh: 与 ZooKeeper 的连接自愿关闭的次数。
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.zh-hant: 與 ZooKeeper 的連結自願關閉的次數。

Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.en: Number of times connection with ZooKeeper has been established.
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.id: Berapa kali koneksi dengan ZooKeeper telah terjalin.
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.zh: 与 ZooKeeper 建立连接的次数。
Number of times connection with ZooKeepe.zh-hant: 與 ZooKeeper 建立連線的次數。

Number of times connections are shared..en: Number of times connections are shared.

Number of times data after merge is not.en: Number of times data after merge is not byte-identical to the data on another replicas. There could be several reasons
Number of times data after merge is not.id: Berapa kali data setelah penggabungan tidak identik dengan byte data pada replika lain. Mungkin ada beberapa alasan
Number of times data after merge is not.zh: 合并后的数据与另一个副本上的数据字节不同的次数。可能有几个原因
Number of times data after merge is not.zh-hant: 合併後的資料與另一個副本上的資料位元組不同的次數。可能有幾個原因

Number of times data after mutation is n.en: Number of times data after mutation is not byte-identical to the data on another replicas. In addition to the reasons described in 'DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica', it is also possible due to non-deterministic mutation.
Number of times data after mutation is n.id: Berapa kali data setelah mutasi tidak identik dengan byte data pada replika lain. Selain alasan yang dijelaskan dalam 'DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica', hal ini juga mungkin terjadi karena mutasi non-deterministik.
Number of times data after mutation is n.zh: 突变后的数据与另一个副本上的数据字节不同的次数。除了“DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica”中描述的原因外，也有可能是由于非确定性突变。
Number of times data after mutation is n.zh-hant: 突變後的資料與另一個副本上的資料位元組不同的次數。除了「DataAfterMergeDiffersFromReplica」中所描述的原因外，也有可能是由於非確定性突變。

Number of times data parts of Replicated.en: Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully merged.
Number of times data parts of Replicated.id: Frekuensi bagian data tabel ReplicationdMergeTree berhasil digabungkan.
Number of times data parts of Replicated.zh: ReplicatedMergeTree 表的数据部分成功合并的次数。
Number of times data parts of Replicated.zh-hant: ReplicatedMergeTree 表的資料部分成功合併的次數。

Number of times data parts of Replicated.en: Number of times data parts of ReplicatedMergeTree tables were successfully mutated.
Number of times data parts of Replicated.id: Berapa kali bagian data tabel ReplicationMergeTree berhasil dimutasi.
Number of times data parts of Replicated.zh: ReplicatedMergeTree 表的数据部分成功变异的次数。
Number of times data parts of Replicated.zh-hant: ReplicatedMergeTree 表的資料部分成功變異的次數。

Number of times directory entries have b.en: Number of times directory entries have been read with getdents().
Number of times directory entries have b.id: Berapa kali entri direktori dibaca dengan getdents().
Number of times directory entries have b.zh: 使用 getdents() 读取目录条目的次数。
Number of times directory entries have b.zh-hant: 使用 getdents() 讀取目錄條目的次數。

Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransm.en: Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransmit) happened while sending via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransm.id: Berapa kali kesalahan (misalnya pengiriman ulang TCP) terjadi saat mengirim melalui antarmuka jaringan. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransm.zh: 通过网络接口发送时发生错误（例如 TCP 重传）的次数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
Number of times error (e.g. TCP retransm.zh-hant: 透過網路介面發送時發生錯誤（例如 TCP 重傳）的次數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

Number of times error happened receiving.en: Number of times error happened receiving via the network interface. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times error happened receiving.id: Berapa kali terjadi kesalahan penerimaan melalui antarmuka jaringan. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
Number of times error happened receiving.zh: 通过网络接口接收时发生错误的次数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
Number of times error happened receiving.zh-hant: 透過網路介面接收時發生錯誤的次數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

Number of times files have been closed a.en: Number of times files have been closed and released.
Number of times files have been closed a.id: Berapa kali file ditutup dan dirilis.
Number of times files have been closed a.zh: 文件被关闭和释放的次数。
Number of times files have been closed a.zh-hant: 文件被關閉和釋放的次數。

Number of times files have been truncate.en: Number of times files have been truncated.

Number of times flow-control initiated i.en: Number of times flow-control initiated in the last second. Flow Control Time (ms/sec) divided by Flow Control/sec is the average time per wait.
Number of times flow-control initiated i.id: Berapa kali kontrol aliran dimulai pada detik terakhir. Waktu Kontrol Aliran (mdtk/dtk) dibagi Kontrol Aliran/dtk adalah waktu rata-rata per tunggu.
Number of times flow-control initiated i.zh: 上一秒发起流控的次数。流量控制时间（毫秒/秒）除以流量控制/秒就是每次等待的平均时间。
Number of times flow-control initiated i.zh-hant: 上一秒發動流控的次數。流量控制時間（毫秒/秒）除以流量控制/秒就是每次等待的平均時間。

Number of times fsync() has been called.en: Number of times fsync() has been called on directories and files.
Number of times fsync() has been called.id: Berapa kali fsync() dipanggil pada direktori dan file.
Number of times fsync() has been called.zh: 对目录和文件调用 fsync() 的次数。
Number of times fsync() has been called.zh-hant: 對目錄和檔案呼叫 fsync() 的次數。

Number of times in-progress transactions.en: Number of times in-progress transactions were streamed to the decoding output plugin while decoding changes from WAL for this slot. This counter is incremented each time a transaction is streamed, and the same transaction may be streamed multiple times. Only available with PostgreSQL 14 and newer.
Number of times in-progress transactions.id: Berapa kali transaksi yang sedang berlangsung dialirkan ke plugin keluaran decoding saat mendekode perubahan dari WAL untuk slot ini. Penghitung ini bertambah setiap kali transaksi dialirkan, dan transaksi yang sama dapat dialirkan beberapa kali. Hanya tersedia dengan PostgreSQL 14 dan yang lebih baru.
Number of times in-progress transactions.zh: 在解码此槽的 WAL 更改时，将进行中的事务流式传输到解码输出插件的次数。每次传输事务时，该计数器都会递增，并且同一事务可能会传输多次。仅适用于 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。
Number of times in-progress transactions.zh-hant: 在解碼此插槽的 WAL 變更時，將進行中的事務串流傳輸到解碼輸出插件的次數。每次傳輸交易時，該計數器都會遞增，並且相同交易可能會傳輸多次。僅適用於 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。

Number of times locking has been attempt.en: Number of times locking has been attempted on a file.
Number of times locking has been attempt.id: Berapa kali penguncian telah dicoba pada suatu file.

Number of times ordinary read buffer was.en: Number of times ordinary read buffer was created for reading data (while choosing among other read methods).
Number of times ordinary read buffer was.id: Berapa kali buffer baca biasa dibuat untuk membaca data (sambil memilih di antara metode baca lainnya).
Number of times ordinary read buffer was.zh: 创建普通读取缓冲区用于读取数据的次数（同时在其他读取方法中进行选择）。
Number of times ordinary read buffer was.zh-hant: 建立普通讀取緩衝區用於讀取資料的次數（同時在其他讀取方法中進行選擇）。

Number of times ownership of a connectio.en: Number of times ownership of a connection is released.
Number of times ownership of a connectio.zh: 连接所有权被释放的次数。
Number of times ownership of a connectio.zh-hant: 連結所有權被釋放的次數。

Number of times permissions have been ch.en: Number of times permissions have been checked.

Number of times query masking rules was.en: Number of times query masking rules was successfully matched.
Number of times query masking rules was.id: Frekuensi aturan penyembunyian kueri berhasil dicocokkan.
Number of times query masking rules was.zh: 成功匹配查询屏蔽规则的次数。
Number of times query masking rules was.zh-hant: 成功配對查詢屏蔽規則的次數。

Number of times read-only batches droppe.en: Number of times read-only batches dropped latches before evaluation.
Number of times read-only batches droppe.id: Berapa kali batch read-only melepaskan kait sebelum evaluasi.
Number of times read-only batches droppe.zh: 评估之前只读批次丢弃锁存器的次数。
Number of times read-only batches droppe.zh-hant: 評估之前只讀批次丟棄鎖存器的次數。

Number of times replicator db scans have.en: Number of times replicator db scans have been started.
Number of times replicator db scans have.id: Berapa kali pemindaian replikator db telah dimulai.
Number of times replicator db scans have.zh: 复制器数据库扫描已启动的次数。
Number of times replicator db scans have.zh-hant: 複製器資料庫掃描已啟動的次數。

Number of times scavaged flush pages..en: Number of times scavaged flush pages.

Number of times temporary files were mer.en: Number of times temporary files were merged for JOIN in external memory.
Number of times temporary files were mer.id: Berapa kali file sementara digabungkan untuk GABUNG di memori eksternal.
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh: 在外部存储器中为 JOIN 合并临时文件的次数。
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh-hant: 在外部記憶體中為 JOIN 合併暫存檔案的次數。

Number of times temporary files were mer.en: Number of times temporary files were merged for aggregation in external memory.
Number of times temporary files were mer.id: Berapa kali file sementara digabungkan untuk diagregasi di memori eksternal.
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh: 合并临时文件以在外部存储器中聚合的次数。
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh-hant: 合併臨時檔案以在外部記憶體中聚合的次數。

Number of times temporary files were mer.en: Number of times temporary files were merged for sorting in external memory.
Number of times temporary files were mer.id: Berapa kali file sementara digabungkan untuk disortir di memori eksternal.
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh: 合并临时文件以便在外部存储器中排序的次数。
Number of times temporary files were mer.zh-hant: 合併臨時檔案以便在外部記憶體中排序的次數。

Number of times that the plan has been e.en: Number of times that the plan has been executed since it was last compiled
Number of times that the plan has been e.id: Berapa kali rencana tersebut telah dilaksanakan sejak terakhir kali disusun
Number of times that the plan has been e.zh: 自上次编译以来计划已执行的次数
Number of times that the plan has been e.zh-hant: 自上次編譯以來計劃已執行的次數

Number of times that workers on this sch.en: Number of times that workers on this scheduler have switched to the preemptive mode
Number of times that workers on this sch.id: Berapa kali pekerja pada penjadwal ini beralih ke mode preemptif
Number of times that workers on this sch.zh: 该调度程序上的工作线程切换到抢占模式的次数
Number of times that workers on this sch.zh-hant: 此調度程式上的工作執行緒切換到搶佔模式的次數

Number of times the 'lseek' function was.en: Number of times the 'lseek' function was called.

Number of times the INSERT of a block to.en: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was rejected with 'Too many bytes' exception due to high number of pending bytes.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.id: Berapa kali INSERT blok ke tabel Terdistribusi ditolak dengan pengecualian 'Terlalu banyak byte' karena tingginya jumlah byte yang tertunda.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh: 由于待处理字节数过多，向分布式表插入块被拒绝并出现“字节过多”异常的次数。
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh-hant: 由於待處理位元組數過多，向分佈式表插入區塊被拒絕並出現「位元組過多」異常的次數。

Number of times the INSERT of a block to.en: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a Distributed table was throttled due to high number of pending bytes.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.id: Berapa kali INSERT blok ke tabel Terdistribusi dibatasi karena tingginya jumlah byte yang tertunda.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh: 由于待处理字节数过多而导致将块插入分布式表而受到限制的次数。
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh-hant: 由於待處理位元組數過多而導致將區塊插入分佈式表而受到限制的次數。

Number of times the INSERT of a block to.en: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was rejected with 'Too many parts' exception due to high number of active data parts for partition.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.id: Berapa kali INSERT blok ke tabel MergeTree ditolak dengan pengecualian 'Terlalu banyak bagian' karena tingginya jumlah bagian data aktif untuk partisi.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh: 由于分区的活动数据部分数量较多，将块插入到 MergeTree 表时因“部分过多”异常而被拒绝的次数。
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh-hant: 由於分區的活動資料部分數量較多，將區塊插入 MergeTree 表時因「部分過多」異常而被拒絕的次數。

Number of times the INSERT of a block to.en: Number of times the INSERT of a block to a MergeTree table was throttled due to high number of active data parts for partition.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.id: Berapa kali INSERT blok ke tabel MergeTree dibatasi karena tingginya jumlah bagian data aktif untuk partisi.
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh: 由于分区的活动数据部分数量较多，将块插入 MergeTree 表而受到限制的次数。
Number of times the INSERT of a block to.zh-hant: 由於分區的活動資料部分數量較多，將區塊插入 MergeTree 表而受到限制的次數。

Number of times the INSERTed block to a.en: Number of times the INSERTed block to a ReplicatedMergeTree table was deduplicated.
Number of times the INSERTed block to a.id: Berapa kali blok INSERTed ke tabel ReplicationdMergeTree dihapus duplikatnya.
Number of times the INSERTed block to a.zh: 将 INSERTed 块插入到 ReplicatedMergeTree 表中进行重复数据删除的次数。
Number of times the INSERTed block to a.zh-hant: 將 INSERTed 區塊插入到 ReplicatedMergeTree 表中進行重複資料刪除的次數。

Number of times the NFS server gave less.en: Number of times the NFS server gave less data than expected while reading.
Number of times the NFS server gave less.id: Berapa kali server NFS memberikan data lebih sedikit dari yang diharapkan saat membaca.
Number of times the NFS server gave less.zh: NFS 服务器在读取时提供的数据少于预期的次数。
Number of times the NFS server gave less.zh-hant: NFS 伺服器在讀取時提供的資料少於預期的次數。

Number of times the NFS server indicated.en: Number of times the NFS server indicated EJUKEBOX; retrieving data from offline storage.
Number of times the NFS server indicated.id: Berapa kali server NFS menunjukkan EJUKEBOX; mengambil data dari penyimpanan offline.
Number of times the NFS server indicated.zh: NFS服务器指示EJUKEBOX的次数；从离线存储中检索数据。
Number of times the NFS server indicated.zh-hant: NFS伺服器指示EJUKEBOX的次數；從離線儲存中擷取資料。

Number of times the NFS server sent a re.en: Number of times the NFS server sent a response with a transaction ID unknown to this client.
Number of times the NFS server sent a re.id: Berapa kali server NFS mengirimkan respons dengan ID transaksi yang tidak diketahui klien ini.
Number of times the NFS server sent a re.zh: NFS 服务器发送此客户端未知的事务 ID 的响应的次数。
Number of times the NFS server sent a re.zh-hant: NFS 伺服器會傳送此用戶端未知的交易 ID 的回應的次數。

Number of times the NFS server wrote les.en: Number of times the NFS server wrote less data than expected while writing.
Number of times the NFS server wrote les.id: Berapa kali server NFS menulis data lebih sedikit dari yang diharapkan saat menulis.
Number of times the NFS server wrote les.zh: NFS 服务器在写入时写入的数据少于预期的次数。
Number of times the NFS server wrote les.zh-hant: NFS 伺服器在寫入時寫入的資料少於預期的次數。

Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.en: Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync` function was called for directories.

Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.zh: 为目录调用“F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync”函数的次数。
Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.zh-hant: 為目錄呼叫「F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync」函數的次數。

Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.en: Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync` function was called for files.
Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.id: Berapa kali fungsi `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync` dipanggil untuk file.
Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.zh: 为文件调用“F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync”函数的次数。
Number of times the `F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/f.zh-hant: 為檔案呼叫「F_FULLFSYNC/fsync/fdatasync」函數的次數。

Number of times the advanced search for.en: Number of times the advanced search for a data part on replicas did not give result or when unexpected part has been found and moved away.
Number of times the advanced search for.id: Berapa kali pencarian lanjutan untuk bagian data pada replika tidak memberikan hasil atau ketika bagian yang tidak diharapkan ditemukan dan dipindahkan.
Number of times the advanced search for.zh: 在副本上对数据部分进行高级搜索未给出结果或发现意外部分并将其移走的次数。
Number of times the advanced search for.zh-hant: 在副本上對資料部分進行進階搜尋未給出結果或發現意外部分並將其移除的次數。

Number of times the bloom filter helped.en: Number of times the bloom filter helped avoid iterator creation.

Number of times the bloom filter helped.zh: 布隆过滤器帮助避免迭代器创建的次数。
Number of times the bloom filter helped.zh-hant: 布隆過濾器可幫助避免迭代器建立的次數。

Number of times the bloom filter was che.en: Number of times the bloom filter was checked.

Number of times the bloom filter was che.zh-hant: 檢查布隆過濾器的次數。

Number of times the client has had to es.en: Number of times the client has had to establish a connection from scratch to the NFS server.

Number of times the client has had to es.zh-hant: 客戶端必須從頭開始建立與 NFS 伺服器的連線的次數。

Number of times the client has made a TC.en: Number of times the client has made a TCP connection to the NFS server.
Number of times the client has made a TC.id: Berapa kali klien membuat koneksi TCP ke server NFS.
Number of times the client has made a TC.zh: 客户端与 NFS 服务器建立 TCP 连接的次数。
Number of times the client has made a TC.zh-hant: 客戶端與 NFS 伺服器建立 TCP 連線的次數。

Number of times the current Raft leader.zh-hant: 目前 Raft 領導者從範圍中移除的次數。

Number of times the deadlock has occurre.en: Number of times the deadlock has occurred.

Number of times the lock of Context was.zh-hant: 取得或嘗試取得 Context 鎖定的次數。這是全域鎖。

Number of times the main configuration w.zh: 重新加载主配置的次数。
Number of times the main configuration w.zh-hant: 重新載入主配置的次數。

Number of times the per-Replica circuit.zh-hant: 自進程啟動以來每個副本斷路器跳脫的次數。

Number of times the process has migrated.zh-hant: 行程遷移到新 CPU 的次數

Number of times the read (`read`/`pread`.zh-hant: 從檔案描述符讀取（`read`/`pread`）失敗的次數。

Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.en: Number of times the read inside ThreadPoolReader was done from page cache.
Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.id: Berapa kali pembacaan di dalam ThreadPoolReader dilakukan dari cache halaman.
Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.zh: 从页面缓存完成 ThreadPoolReader 内部读取的次数。
Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.zh-hant: 從頁面快取完成 ThreadPoolReader 內部讀取的次數。

Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.en: Number of times the read inside ThreadPoolReader was not done from page cache and was hand off to thread pool.
Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.id: Berapa kali pembacaan di dalam ThreadPoolReader tidak dilakukan dari cache halaman dan diserahkan ke kumpulan thread.

Number of times the read inside ThreadPo.zh-hant: ThreadPoolReader 內的讀取未從頁面快取完成並移交給執行緒池的次數。

Number of times the read of meta file wa.en: Number of times the read of meta file was done from MergeTree metadata cache
Number of times the read of meta file wa.id: Berapa kali pembacaan file meta dilakukan dari cache metadata MergeTree

Number of times the read of meta file wa.zh-hant: 從 MergeTree 元資料快取讀取元檔案的次數

Number of times the read of meta file wa.en: Number of times the read of meta file was not done from MergeTree metadata cache

Number of times transaction id resolutio.zh-hant: 重試交易 ID 解析的次數。

Number of times transactions were spille.en: Number of times transactions were spilled to disk while decoding changes from WAL for this slot. This counter is incremented each time a transaction is spilled, and the same transaction may be spilled multiple times. Only available with PostgreSQL 14 and newer.
Number of times transactions were spille.id: Berapa kali transaksi ditumpahkan ke disk saat mendekode perubahan dari WAL untuk slot ini. Penghitung ini bertambah setiap kali transaksi tumpah, dan transaksi yang sama mungkin tumpah beberapa kali. Hanya tersedia dengan PostgreSQL 14 dan yang lebih baru.
Number of times transactions were spille.zh: 解码此槽的 WAL 更改时事务溢出到磁盘的次数。每次事务溢出时，该计数器都会递增，并且同一事务可能会溢出多次。仅适用于 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。
Number of times transactions were spille.zh-hant: 解碼此插槽的 WAL 變更時事務溢位到磁碟的次數。每次事務溢出時，該計數器都會遞增，並且相同交易可能會溢出多次。僅適用於 PostgreSQL 14 及更高版本。

Number of times unrecoverable OOMs happe.en: Number of times unrecoverable OOMs happened while processing operations.
