The current size, in bytes, of the segme.zh-hant: 段磁碟的目前大小（以位元組為單位）。

The current status code of the applicati.en: The current status code of the application pool (1 - Uninitialized, 2 - Initialized, 3 - Running, 4 - Disabling, 5 - Disabled, 6 - Shutdown Pending, 7 - Delete Pending).
The current status code of the applicati.id: Kode status kumpulan aplikasi saat ini (1 - Tidak Diinisialisasi, 2 - Diinisialisasi, 3 - Berjalan, 4 - Menonaktifkan, 5 - Dinonaktifkan, 6 - Shutdown Pending, 7 - Hapus Tertunda).
The current status code of the applicati.zh: 应用程序池的当前状态代码（1 - 未初始化、2 - 已初始化、3 - 正在运行、4 - 禁用、5 - 已禁用、6 - 关闭待处理、7 - 删除待处理）。
The current status code of the applicati.zh-hant: 應用程式集區的目前狀態碼（1 - 未初始化、2 - 已初始化、3 - 正在執行、4 - 停用、5 - 已停用、6 - 關閉待處理、7 - 刪除待處理）。

The current value of the sql_slave_skip_.en: The current value of the sql_slave_skip_counter system variable.
The current value of the sql_slave_skip_.id: Nilai saat ini dari variabel sistem sql_slave_skip_counter.
The current value of the sql_slave_skip_.zh: sql_slave_skip_counter 系统变量的当前值。
The current value of the sql_slave_skip_.zh-hant: sql_slave_skip_counter 系統變數的目前值。

The currently allocated number of bytes.en: The currently allocated number of bytes of heap objects.
The currently allocated number of bytes.id: Jumlah byte objek heap yang dialokasikan saat ini.
The currently allocated number of bytes.zh: 当前分配的堆对象的字节数。
The currently allocated number of bytes.zh-hant: 目前分配的堆對象的位元組數。

The datastore name when the event belong.en: The datastore name when the event belongs to a datastore
The datastore name when the event belong.id: Nama penyimpanan data saat peristiwa tersebut termasuk dalam penyimpanan data
The datastore name when the event belong.zh: 当事件属于数据存储时的数据存储名称
The datastore name when the event belong.zh-hant: 當事件屬於資料儲存時的資料儲存名稱

The deadlock priority for the session..en: The deadlock priority for the session.

The default database for the statement,.en: The default database for the statement, NULL if there is none
The default database for the statement,.id: Basis data default untuk pernyataan tersebut, NULL jika tidak ada
The default database for the statement,.zh: 语句的默认数据库，如果没有则为NULL
The default database for the statement,.zh-hant: 語句的預設資料庫，如果沒有則為NULL

The default database for the thread, or.en: The default database for the thread, or NULL if none has been selected
The default database for the thread, or.id: Basis data default untuk thread, atau NULL jika tidak ada yang dipilih
The default database for the thread, or.zh: 线程的默认数据库，如果未选择任何数据库，则为 NULL
The default database for the thread, or.zh-hant: 線程的預設資料庫，如果未選擇任何資料庫，則為 NULL

The default database from processlist..id: Basis data default dari daftar proses.
The default database from processlist..zh: 来自进程列表的默认数据库。
The default database from processlist..zh-hant: 來自進程列表的預設資料庫。

The degree of parallelism used during th.en: The degree of parallelism used during the collection interval (delta value).
The degree of parallelism used during th.id: Derajat paralelisme yang digunakan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The degree of parallelism used during th.zh: 收集间隔期间使用的并行度（增量值）。
The degree of parallelism used during th.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間使用的平行度（增量值）。

The desired number of replicas of the gi.en: The desired number of replicas of the given Template.
The desired number of replicas of the gi.id: Jumlah replika Templat yang diberikan yang diinginkan.
The desired number of replicas of the gi.zh: 给定模板的所需副本数。
The desired number of replicas of the gi.zh-hant: 給定模板的所需副本數。

The desired state of the interface..en: The desired state of the interface.

The dfpv name, consists of pvc name and.en: The dfpv name, consists of pvc name and pod name
The dfpv name, consists of pvc name and.id: Nama dfpv, terdiri dari nama pvc dan nama pod
The dfpv name, consists of pvc name and.zh: dfpv 名称，由 pvc 名称和 pod 名称组成
The dfpv name, consists of pvc name and.zh-hant: dfpv 名稱，由 pvc 名稱和 pod 名稱組成

The difference in time the thread for ca.en: The difference in time the thread for calculation of the asynchronous metrics was scheduled to wake up and the time it was in fact, woken up. A proxy-indicator of overall system latency and responsiveness.
The difference in time the thread for ca.id: Perbedaan waktu antara thread untuk penghitungan metrik asinkron yang dijadwalkan untuk aktif dan waktu sebenarnya untuk diaktifkan. Indikator proksi latensi dan daya tanggap sistem secara keseluruhan.
The difference in time the thread for ca.zh: 用于计算异步指标的线程计划唤醒的时间与实际唤醒的时间之间的差异。整体系统延迟和响应能力的代理指标。
The difference in time the thread for ca.zh-hant: 用於計算非同步指標的執行緒計畫喚醒的時間與實際喚醒的時間之間的差異。整體系統延遲和響應能力的代理指標。

The digest hash value computed from the.en: The digest hash value computed from the original normalized statement.
The digest hash value computed from the.id: Nilai hash intisari dihitung dari pernyataan asli yang dinormalisasi.
The digest hash value computed from the.zh: 根据原始规范化语句计算出的摘要哈希值。
The digest hash value computed from the.zh-hant: 根據原始規範化語句計算出的摘要雜湊值。

The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.en: The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active log space currently used in the database.
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.id: Blok disk (masing-masing 4 KiB) dari ruang log aktif yang saat ini digunakan dalam database.
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.zh: 数据库中当前使用的活动日志空间的磁盘块（每个 4 KiB）。
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.zh-hant: 資料庫中目前使用的活動日誌空間的磁碟區塊（每個 4 KiB）。

The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.en: The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active log space in the database that is not being used by uncommitted transactions.
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.id: Disk memblokir (masing-masing 4 KiB) ruang log aktif dalam database yang tidak digunakan oleh transaksi yang tidak dikomit.
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.zh: 数据库中未被未提交事务使用的活动日志空间的磁盘块（每个 4 KiB）。
The disk blocks (4 KiB each) of active l.zh-hant: 資料庫中未被未提交交易使用的活動日誌空間的磁碟區塊（每個 4 KiB）。

The disk space truly used by snapshots..en: The disk space truly used by snapshots.
The disk space truly used by snapshots..id: Ruang disk benar-benar digunakan oleh snapshot.
The disk space truly used by snapshots..zh: 快照真正使用的磁盘空间。
The disk space truly used by snapshots..zh-hant: 快照真正使用的磁碟空間。

The disk space used by live SSTables (on.en: The disk space used by live SSTables (only counts in use files).
The disk space used by live SSTables (on.id: Ruang disk yang digunakan oleh SSTable langsung (hanya dihitung dalam file yang digunakan).
The disk space used by live SSTables (on.zh: 实时 SSTable 使用的磁盘空间（仅计入使用文件）。
The disk space used by live SSTables (on.zh-hant: 即時 SSTable 使用的磁碟空間（僅計入使用檔案）。

The disk space used by live data on a no.en: The disk space used by live data on a node.
The disk space used by live data on a no.id: Ruang disk yang digunakan oleh data langsung pada sebuah node.
The disk space used by live data on a no.zh: 节点上实时数据使用的磁盘空间。
The disk space used by live data on a no.zh-hant: 節點上即時資料使用的磁碟空間。

The disk space used by this database..en: The disk space used by this database.
The disk space used by this database..id: Ruang disk yang digunakan oleh database ini.
The disk space used by this database..zh: 该数据库使用的磁盘空间。
The disk space used by this database..zh-hant: 該資料庫使用的磁碟空間。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, of write requests served using the /write HTTP endpoint.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, permintaan tulis yang disajikan menggunakan titik akhir HTTP /write.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: 使用 /write HTTP 端点提供的写入请求的持续时间（挂起时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: 使用 /write HTTP 端點提供的寫入請求的持續時間（掛起時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent during TSM optimize compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan selama TSM mengoptimalkan pemadatan.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: TSM 优化压缩期间花费的持续时间（墙时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: TSM 優化壓縮期間花費的持續時間（牆時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent in TSM level 1 compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam pemadatan TSM level 1.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: TSM 1 级压缩所花费的持续时间（墙时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: TSM 1 級壓縮所花費的持續時間（牆時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent in TSM level 2 compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam pemadatan TSM level 2.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: TSM 2 级压缩所花费的持续时间（墙时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: TSM 2 級壓縮所花費的持續時間（牆時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent in TSM level 3 compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam pemadatan TSM level 3.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: TSM 3 级压缩所花费的持续时间（墙时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: TSM 3 級壓縮所花費的持續時間（牆時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent in cache compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam pemadatan cache.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: 缓存压缩所花费的持续时间（挂起时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: 快取壓縮所花費的持續時間（掛起時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent in full compactions.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam pemadatan penuh.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: 完全压缩所花费的持续时间（壁时间），以纳秒为单位。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: 完全壓縮所花費的持續時間（壁時間），以奈秒為單位。

The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds, spent inside HTTP requests.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan dalam permintaan HTTP.
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh: HTTP 请求内所花费的持续时间（挂起时间）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: HTTP 請求內所花費的持續時間（掛起時間）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration (wall-time), in nanoseconds.en: The duration (wall-time), in nanoseconds, spent executing Flux query requests.
The duration (wall-time), in nanoseconds.id: Durasi (waktu dinding), dalam nanodetik, yang dihabiskan untuk mengeksekusi permintaan kueri Flux.
The duration (wall-time), in nanoseconds.zh: 执行 Flux 查询请求所花费的持续时间（wall-time）（以纳秒为单位）。
The duration (wall-time), in nanoseconds.zh-hant: 執行 Flux 查詢請求所花費的持續時間（wall-time）（以奈秒為單位）。

The duration elapsed between having eval.en: The duration elapsed between having evaluated a BatchRequest and it being reflected in the proposer's state machine (i.e. having applied fully).This encompasses time spent in the quota pool, in replication (including re_proposals), and application, but notably not sequencing latency (i.e.contention and latch acquisition).
The duration elapsed between having eval.id: Durasi yang berlalu antara mengevaluasi BatchRequest dan tercermin dalam mesin negara pengusul (yaitu telah diterapkan sepenuhnya). Ini mencakup waktu yang dihabiskan dalam kumpulan kuota, dalam replikasi (termasuk proposal_ulang), dan penerapan, namun terutama tidak mengurutkan latensi (yaitu pertikaian dan akuisisi latch).
The duration elapsed between having eval.zh: 从评估 BatchRequest 到反映在提议者的状态机中（即完全应用）之间经过的持续时间。这包括在配额池、复制（包括 re_proposals）和应用程序中花费的时间，但值得注意的是不包括排序延迟（即争用和闩锁获取）。
The duration elapsed between having eval.zh-hant: 從評估 BatchRequest 到反映在提議者的狀態機（即完全應用）之間經過的持續時間。這包括在配額池、複製（包括 re_proposals）和應用程式中花費的時間，但值得注意的是不包括排序延遲（即爭用和閂鎖獲取）。

The duration in microseconds of the requ.en: The duration in microseconds of the requests.
The duration in microseconds of the requ.zh: 请求的持续时间（以微秒为单位）。
The duration in microseconds of the requ.zh-hant: 請求的持續時間（以微秒為單位）。

The duration of the inbound HTTP request.en: The duration of the inbound HTTP request
The duration of the inbound HTTP request.zh: 入站 HTTP 请求的持续时间
The duration of the inbound HTTP request.zh-hant: 入站 HTTP 請求的持續時間

The duration that the oldest range in th.en: The duration that the oldest range in the write quarantine pool has remained.
The duration that the oldest range in th.id: Durasi rentang terlama dalam kumpulan karantina tulis.
The duration that the oldest range in th.zh: 写入隔离池中最旧范围的保留时间。
The duration that the oldest range in th.zh-hant: 寫入隔離池中最舊範圍的保留時間。

The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.en: The duration, in milliseconds, of the last checkpoint event. Checkpoints should generally take several seconds to several minutes. Long checkpoints can be an issue, as these are invoked when the database stops, when a hot backup is taken, and periodically as well. Values over `30` minutes or so should be cause for some investigation.
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.id: Durasi, dalam milidetik, peristiwa pos pemeriksaan terakhir. Pos pemeriksaan biasanya memakan waktu beberapa detik hingga beberapa menit. Pos pemeriksaan yang panjang bisa menjadi masalah, karena pos pemeriksaan ini dipanggil ketika database berhenti, ketika cadangan panas diambil, dan juga secara berkala. Nilai lebih dari `30` menit atau lebih harus menjadi alasan untuk melakukan penyelidikan.
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.zh: 最后一个检查点事件的持续时间（以毫秒为单位）。检查点通常需要几秒钟到几分钟的时间。长检查点可能是一个问题，因为这些检查点会在数据库停止时、进行热备份时以及定期调用。超过“30”分钟左右的值应该引起一些调查。
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.zh-hant: 最後一個檢查點事件的持續時間（以毫秒為單位）。檢查點通常需要幾秒鐘到幾分鐘的時間。長檢查點可能是一個問題，因為這些檢查點會在資料庫停止時、進行熱備份時以及定期呼叫。超過“30”分鐘左右的數值應該會引起一些調查。

The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.en: The duration, in milliseconds, of the last log rotation event.
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.id: Durasi, dalam milidetik, peristiwa rotasi log terakhir.
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.zh: 上次日志轮换事件的持续时间（以毫秒为单位）。
The duration, in milliseconds, of the la.zh-hant: 上次日誌輪換事件的持續時間（以毫秒為單位）。

The duration, in milliseconds, since the.en: The duration, in milliseconds, since the cache was last snapshotted at sample time.
The duration, in milliseconds, since the.id: Durasi, dalam milidetik, sejak cache terakhir kali diambil snapshotnya pada waktu sampel.
The duration, in milliseconds, since the.zh: 自上次在采样时间对缓存进行快照以来的持续时间（以毫秒为单位）。
The duration, in milliseconds, since the.zh-hant: 自上次在採樣時間對快取進行快照以來的持續時間（以毫秒為單位）。

The duration, in milliseconds, that the.en: The duration, in milliseconds, that the commit lock is held while compacting snapshots.
The duration, in milliseconds, that the.id: Durasi, dalam milidetik, saat kunci penerapan ditahan saat memadatkan snapshot.
The duration, in milliseconds, that the.zh: 压缩快照时保持提交锁的持续时间（以毫秒为单位）。
The duration, in milliseconds, that the.zh-hant: 壓縮快照時保持提交鎖定的持續時間（以毫秒為單位）。

The earliest timestamp of any change fee.en: The earliest timestamp of any change feed's persisted checkpoint (values prior to this timestamp will never need to be re-emitted).
The earliest timestamp of any change fee.id: Stempel waktu paling awal dari pos pemeriksaan yang ada pada feed perubahan (nilai sebelum stempel waktu ini tidak perlu dikirim ulang).
The earliest timestamp of any change fee.zh: 任何更改源的持久检查点的最早时间戳（此时间戳之前的值永远不需要重新发出）。
The earliest timestamp of any change fee.zh-hant: 任何更改來源的持久檢查點的最早時間戳記（此時間戳之前的值永遠不需要重新發出）。

The earliest timestamp of the last check.en: The earliest timestamp of the last checkpoint forwarded by an ingestion data processor.
The earliest timestamp of the last check.id: Stempel waktu paling awal dari pos pemeriksaan terakhir yang diteruskan oleh pemroses data penyerapan.
The earliest timestamp of the last check.zh: 摄取数据处理器转发的最后一个检查点的最早时间戳。
The earliest timestamp of the last check.zh-hant: 攝取資料處理器轉送的最後一個檢查點的最早時間戳記。

The earliest timestamp up to which any a.en: The earliest timestamp up to which any aggregator is guaranteed to have emitted all values for.

The number of checkpoint directories fou.en: The number of checkpoint directories found in storage.This is the number of directories found in the auxiliary/checkpoints directory.Each represents an immutable point-in-time storage engine checkpoint. They are cheap (consisting mostly of hard links), but over time they effectively become a full copy of the old state, which increases their relative cost.
The number of checkpoint directories fou.id: Jumlah direktori pos pemeriksaan yang ditemukan di penyimpanan. Ini adalah jumlah direktori yang ditemukan di direktori bantu/pos pemeriksaan. Masing-masing mewakili pos pemeriksaan mesin penyimpanan point-in-time yang tidak dapat diubah. Mereka murah (sebagian besar terdiri dari hard link), namun seiring berjalannya waktu mereka secara efektif menjadi salinan lengkap dari keadaan lama, yang meningkatkan biaya relatifnya.
The number of checkpoint directories fou.zh: 在存储中找到的检查点目录的数量。这是在辅助/检查点目录中找到的目录的数量。每个目录代表一个不可变的时间点存储引擎检查点。它们很便宜（主要由硬链接组成），但随着时间的推移，它们实际上成为旧状态的完整副本，这增加了它们的相对成本。
The number of checkpoint directories fou.zh-hant: 在儲存中找到的檢查點目錄的數量。這是在輔助/檢查點目錄中找到的目錄的數量。每個目錄代表一個不可變的時間點儲存引擎檢查點。它們很便宜（主要由硬連結組成），但隨著時間的推移，它們實際上成為舊狀態的完整副本，這增加了它們的相對成本。

The number of cursors that MongoDB is ma.en: The number of cursors that MongoDB is maintaining for clients. Because MongoDB exhausts unused cursors, typically this value small or zero. However, if there is a queue, stale *tailable* cursors, or a large number of operations this value may rise.
The number of cursors that MongoDB is ma.id: Jumlah kursor yang dikelola MongoDB untuk klien. Karena MongoDB menghabiskan kursor yang tidak digunakan, biasanya nilainya kecil atau nol. Namun, jika ada antrean, kursor *berekor* yang basi, atau sejumlah besar operasi, nilai ini mungkin naik.
The number of cursors that MongoDB is ma.zh: MongoDB 为客户端维护的游标数量。由于 MongoDB 会耗尽未使用的游标，因此该值通常很小或为零。但是，如果存在队列、陈旧的 *tailable* 游标或大量操作，则该值可能会上升。
The number of cursors that MongoDB is ma.zh-hant: MongoDB 為客戶端維護的遊標數量。由於 MongoDB 會耗盡未使用的遊標，因此該值通常很小或為零。但是，如果存在佇列、陳舊的 *tailable* 遊標或大量操作，則該值可能會上升。

The number of files opened with `mmap` (.en: The number of files opened with `mmap` (mapped in memory). This is used for queries with the setting `local_filesystem_read_method` set to  `mmap`. The files opened with `mmap` are kept in the cache to avoid costly TLB flushes.

The number of files opened with `mmap` (.zh: 使用“mmap”打开的文件数量（映射到内存中）。这用于将“local_filesystem_read_method”设置为“mmap”的查询。使用 mmap 打开的文件将保存在缓存中，以避免代价高昂的 TLB 刷新。
The number of files opened with `mmap` (.zh-hant: 使用“mmap”開啟的檔案數量（映射到記憶體中）。這用於將“local_filesystem_read_method”設定為“mmap”的查詢。使用 mmap 開啟的檔案將保存在快取中，以避免代價高昂的 TLB 刷新。

The number of hard page faults in query.en: The number of hard page faults in query execution threads. High values indicate either that you forgot to turn off swap on your server, or eviction of memory pages of the ClickHouse binary during very high memory pressure, or successful usage of the `mmap` read method for the tables data.
The number of hard page faults in query.id: Jumlah kesalahan halaman keras di thread eksekusi kueri. The number of hard page faults in query.zh-hant: 查詢執行緒中硬頁面錯誤的數量。高值表示您忘記關閉伺服器上的交換，或在非常高的記憶體壓力期間驅逐 ClickHouse 二進位檔案的記憶體頁面，或成功使用了表格資料的「mmap」讀取方法。

The number of internal PREPARE statement.zh-hant: 內部 PREPARE 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_FIRST statem.en: The number of internal READ_FIRST statements.
The number of internal READ_FIRST statem.zh: 内部 READ_FIRST 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_FIRST statem.zh-hant: 內部 READ_FIRST 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_KEY statemen.en: The number of internal READ_KEY statements.
The number of internal READ_KEY statemen.zh: 内部 READ_KEY 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_KEY statemen.zh-hant: 內部 READ_KEY 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_NEXT stateme.en: The number of internal READ_NEXT statements.
The number of internal READ_NEXT stateme.zh: 内部 READ_NEXT 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_NEXT stateme.zh-hant: 內部 READ_NEXT 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_PREV stateme.en: The number of internal READ_PREV statements.
The number of internal READ_PREV stateme.zh: 内部 READ_PREV 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_PREV stateme.zh-hant: 內部 READ_PREV 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_RND statemen.en: The number of internal READ_RND statements.
The number of internal READ_RND statemen.zh: 内部 READ_RND 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_RND statemen.zh-hant: 內部 READ_RND 語句的數量。

The number of internal READ_RND_NEXT sta.en: The number of internal READ_RND_NEXT statements.
The number of internal READ_RND_NEXT sta.zh: 内部 READ_RND_NEXT 语句的数量。
The number of internal READ_RND_NEXT sta.zh-hant: 內部 READ_RND_NEXT 語句的數量。

The number of internal ROLLBACK statemen.en: The number of internal ROLLBACK statements.
The number of internal ROLLBACK statemen.zh: 内部 ROLLBACK 语句的数量。
The number of internal ROLLBACK statemen.zh-hant: 內部 ROLLBACK 語句的數量。

The number of internal UPDATE statements.en: The number of internal UPDATE statements.
The number of internal UPDATE statements.zh: 内部 UPDATE 语句的数量。
The number of internal UPDATE statements.zh-hant: 內部 UPDATE 語句的數量。

The number of internal WRITE statements..en: The number of internal WRITE statements.
The number of internal WRITE statements..zh: 内部 WRITE 语句的数量。
The number of internal WRITE statements..zh-hant: 內部 WRITE 語句的數量。

The number of internal pages evicted fro.en: The number of internal pages evicted from the WiredTiger cache.
The number of internal pages evicted fro.id: Jumlah halaman internal yang dikeluarkan dari cache WiredTiger.
The number of internal pages evicted fro.zh: 从 WiredTiger 缓存中逐出的内部页面数量。
The number of internal pages evicted fro.zh-hant: 從 WiredTiger 快取中逐出的內部頁面數量。

The number of interrupts on the host mac.en: The number of interrupts on the host machine. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
The number of interrupts on the host mac.id: Jumlah interupsi pada mesin host. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
The number of interrupts on the host mac.zh: 主机上的中断数量。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
The number of interrupts on the host mac.zh-hant: 主機上的中斷數量。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

The number of invalidations during the c.en: The number of invalidations during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of invalidations during the c.id: Jumlah pembatalan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of invalidations during the c.zh: 收集间隔期间的失效次数（增量值）。
The number of invalidations during the c.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間的失效次數（增量值）。

The number of items currently indexed..en: The number of items currently indexed.
The number of items currently indexed..id: Jumlah item yang saat ini diindeks.

The number of jobs in Jenkins.en: The number of jobs in Jenkins

The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.en: The number of jobs that are in the Jenkins build queue and currently in the blocked state.
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.id: Jumlah pekerjaan yang berada dalam antrean pembangunan Jenkins dan saat ini dalam keadaan diblokir.
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.zh: Jenkins 构建队列中当前处于阻塞状态的作业数量。
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.zh-hant: Jenkins 建置佇列中目前處於阻塞狀態的作業數量。

The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.en: The number of jobs that are in the Jenkins build queue.
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.id: Jumlah pekerjaan yang ada dalam antrean pembuatan Jenkins.
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.zh: Jenkins 构建队列中的作业数量。
The number of jobs that are in the Jenki.zh-hant: Jenkins 建置佇列中的作業數量。

The number of joins that did a full scan.en: The number of joins that did a full scan of the first table.
The number of joins that did a full scan.id: Jumlah gabungan yang melakukan pemindaian penuh pada tabel pertama.
The number of joins that did a full scan.zh: 对第一个表进行完整扫描的联接数。
The number of joins that did a full scan.zh-hant: 對第一個表進行完整掃描的聯接數。

The number of joins that perform table s.en: The number of joins that perform table scans because they do not use indexes. If this value is not 0, you should carefully check the indexes of your tables.
The number of joins that perform table s.id: Jumlah gabungan yang melakukan pemindaian tabel karena tidak menggunakan indeks. Jika nilai ini bukan 0, Anda harus memeriksa indeks tabel Anda dengan cermat.
The number of joins that perform table s.zh: 由于不使用索引而执行表扫描的连接数。如果该值不为 0，则应仔细检查表的索引。
The number of joins that perform table s.zh-hant: 由於不使用索引而執行表格掃描的連接數。如果該值不為 0，則應仔細檢查表的索引。

The number of joins that used a range se.en: The number of joins that used a range search on a reference table.
The number of joins that used a range se.id: Jumlah gabungan yang menggunakan pencarian rentang pada tabel referensi.
The number of joins that used a range se.zh: 在引用表上使用范围搜索的联接数。
The number of joins that used a range se.zh-hant: 在引用表上使用範圍搜尋的聯接數。

The number of joins that used ranges on.en: The number of joins that used ranges on the first table. This is normally not a critical issue even if the value is quite large.
The number of joins that used ranges on.id: Jumlah gabungan yang digunakan berkisar pada tabel pertama. Hal ini biasanya bukan masalah kritis meskipun nilainya cukup besar.
The number of joins that used ranges on.zh: 在第一个表上使用范围的联接数。即使该值相当大，这通常也不是一个关键问题。
The number of joins that used ranges on.zh-hant: 在第一個表上使用範圍的聯接數。即使該值相當大，這通常也不是一個關鍵問題。

The number of joins without keys that ch.en: The number of joins without keys that check for key usage after each row. If this is not 0, you should carefully check the indexes of your tables.
The number of joins without keys that ch.id: Jumlah gabungan tanpa kunci yang memeriksa penggunaan kunci setelah setiap baris. Jika ini bukan 0, Anda harus hati-hati memeriksa indeks tabel Anda.
The number of joins without keys that ch.zh: 没有键的连接数，用于在每行之后检查键的使用情况。如果它不为 0，您应该仔细检查表的索引。
The number of joins without keys that ch.zh-hant: 沒有鍵的連接數，用於在每行之後檢查鍵的使用情況。如果它不是 0，您應該仔細檢查表的索引。

The number of keys currently inflight as.en: The number of keys currently inflight as IO requests being sent to the Sink.
The number of keys currently inflight as.id: Jumlah kunci yang sedang dalam penerbangan saat permintaan IO dikirim ke Sink.
The number of keys currently inflight as.zh: 当 IO 请求发送到接收器时当前正在进行的键的数量。
The number of keys currently inflight as.zh-hant: 當 IO 請求發送到接收器時目前正在進行的鍵的數量。

The number of keys tracked for expiry pu.en: The number of keys tracked for expiry purposes (applicable only to writable replicas).
The number of keys tracked for expiry pu.id: Jumlah kunci yang dilacak untuk tujuan kedaluwarsa (hanya berlaku untuk replika yang dapat ditulis).
The number of keys tracked for expiry pu.zh: 出于过期目的而跟踪的密钥数量（仅适用于可写副本）。
The number of keys tracked for expiry pu.zh-hant: 出於過期目的而追蹤的密鑰數量（僅適用於可寫入副本）。

The number of leader changes seen..en: The number of leader changes seen.
The number of leader changes seen..zh: 所见领导者变更的数量。
The number of leader changes seen..zh-hant: 所見領導者變更的數量。

The number of live rows fetched by seque.en: The number of live rows fetched by sequential scans.
The number of live rows fetched by seque.id: Jumlah baris aktif yang diambil dengan pemindaian berurutan.
The number of live rows fetched by seque.zh: 通过顺序扫描获取的活动行数。
The number of live rows fetched by seque.zh-hant: 透過順序掃描取得的活動行數。

The number of load channels currently op.en: The number of load channels currently open.
The number of load channels currently op.id: Jumlah saluran beban yang sedang terbuka.
The number of load channels currently op.zh: 当前打开的负载通道数。
The number of load channels currently op.zh-hant: 目前開啟的負載通道數。

The number of loads during the collectio.en: The number of loads during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of loads during the collectio.id: Jumlah muatan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of loads during the collectio.zh: 收集间隔期间的负载数量（增量值）。
The number of loads during the collectio.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間的負載數量（增量值）。

The number of local range requests..en: The number of local range requests.

The number of local read requests..en: The number of local read requests.

The number of local reads for materializ.en: The number of local reads for materialized view updates.
The number of local reads for materializ.id: Jumlah pembacaan lokal untuk pembaruan tampilan terwujud.
The number of local reads for materializ.zh: 物化视图更新的本地读取次数。
The number of local reads for materializ.zh-hant: 物化視圖更新的本地讀取次數。

The number of local write requests..en: The number of local write requests.

The number of locks active for this data.en: The number of locks active for this database.
The number of locks active for this data.id: Jumlah kunci yang aktif untuk database ini.
The number of locks active for this data.zh: 该数据库的活动锁数量。
The number of locks active for this data.zh-hant: 此資料庫的活動鎖數量。

The number of locks currently held..en: The number of locks currently held.
The number of locks currently held..id: Jumlah kunci yang dipegang saat ini.

The number of log pages read from disk b.en: The number of log pages read from disk by the logger.
The number of log pages read from disk b.id: Jumlah halaman log yang dibaca dari disk oleh logger.
The number of log pages read from disk b.zh: 记录器从磁盘读取的日志页数。
The number of log pages read from disk b.zh-hant: 記錄器從磁碟讀取的日誌頁數。

The number of log pages written to disk.en: The number of log pages written to disk by the logger.
The number of log pages written to disk.id: Jumlah halaman log yang ditulis ke disk oleh logger.
The number of log pages written to disk.zh: 由记录器写入磁盘的日志页数。
The number of log pages written to disk.zh-hant: 由記錄器寫入磁碟的日誌頁數。

The number of logical bytes the storage.en: The number of logical bytes the storage engine has written to the WAL.
The number of logical bytes the storage.id: Jumlah byte logis yang ditulis mesin penyimpanan ke WAL.
The number of logical bytes the storage.zh: 存储引擎已写入 WAL 的逻辑字节数。
The number of logical bytes the storage.zh-hant: 儲存引擎已寫入 WAL 的邏輯位元組數。

The number of logical reads performed du.en: The number of logical reads performed during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of logical reads performed du.id: Jumlah pembacaan logis yang dilakukan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of logical reads performed du.zh: 收集间隔期间执行的逻辑读取次数（增量值）。
The number of logical reads performed du.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間執行的邏輯讀取次數（增量值）。

The number of logical writes performed d.en: The number of logical writes performed during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of logical writes performed d.id: Jumlah penulisan logis yang dilakukan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of logical writes performed d.zh: 收集间隔期间执行的逻辑写入次数（增量值）。
The number of logical writes performed d.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間執行的邏輯寫入次數（增量值）。

The number of lookups to the web resourc.en: The number of lookups to the web resource cache per second.
The number of lookups to the web resourc.id: Jumlah pencarian cache sumber daya web per detik.
The number of lookups to the web resourc.zh: 每秒对 Web 资源缓存的查找次数。
The number of lookups to the web resourc.zh-hant: 每秒對 Web 資源快取的查找次數。

The number of master nodes serving at le.en: The number of master nodes serving at least one hash slot in the cluster.
The number of master nodes serving at le.id: Jumlah node master yang melayani setidaknya satu slot hash di cluster.
The number of master nodes serving at le.zh: 集群中至少一个哈希槽服务的主节点数量。
The number of master nodes serving at le.zh-hant: 叢集中至少一個哈希槽服務的主節點數量。

The number of merge passes that the sort.en: The number of merge passes that the sort algorithm has had to do. If this value is large, you should consider increasing the value of the sort_buffer_size system variable.
The number of merge passes that the sort.id: Jumlah penggabungan yang harus dilakukan oleh algoritma pengurutan. Jika nilai ini besar, Anda harus mempertimbangkan untuk meningkatkan nilai variabel sistem sort_buffer_size.
The number of merge passes that the sort.zh: 排序算法必须执行的合并传递次数。如果该值很大，则应考虑增加 sort_buffer_size 系统变量的值。
The number of merge passes that the sort.zh-hant: 排序演算法必須執行的合併傳遞次數。如果該值很大，則應考慮增加 sort_buffer_size 系統變數的值。

The number of message assertions raised.en: The number of message assertions raised since the MongoDB process started. Check the log file for more information about these messages.
The number of message assertions raised.id: Jumlah pernyataan pesan yang muncul sejak proses MongoDB dimulai. Periksa file log untuk informasi lebih lanjut tentang pesan-pesan ini.
The number of message assertions raised.zh: 自 MongoDB 进程启动以来引发的消息断言数量。检查日志文件以获取有关这些消息的更多信息。
The number of message assertions raised.zh-hant: 自 MongoDB 進程啟動以來引發的訊息斷言數量。檢查日誌檔案以獲取有關這些訊息的更多資訊。

The number of messages received by the b.en: The number of messages received by the broker
The number of messages received by the b.id: Jumlah pesan yang diterima oleh broker

The number of misses for open tables cac.en: The number of misses for open tables cache lookups.
The number of misses for open tables cac.id: Jumlah kesalahan untuk pencarian cache tabel terbuka.
The number of misses for open tables cac.zh: 打开表缓存查找的未命中次数。
The number of misses for open tables cac.zh-hant: 開啟表格快取查找的未命中次數。

The number of modified pages evicted fro.en: The number of modified pages evicted from the WiredTiger cache.
The number of modified pages evicted fro.id: Jumlah halaman yang dimodifikasi yang dikeluarkan dari cache WiredTiger.
The number of modified pages evicted fro.zh: 从 WiredTiger 缓存中逐出的修改页数。
The number of modified pages evicted fro.zh-hant: 從 WiredTiger 快取中逐出的修改頁數。

The number of network-related replicatio.en: The number of network-related replication tasks that are currently being processed by the executor queues.
The number of network-related replicatio.id: Jumlah tugas replikasi terkait jaringan yang sedang diproses oleh antrean pelaksana.
The number of network-related replicatio.zh: 执行程序队列当前正在处理的与网络相关的复制任务的数量。
The number of network-related replicatio.zh-hant: 執行程式佇列目前正在處理的與網路相關的複製任務的數量。

The number of nodes that are running at.en: The number of nodes that are running at least one daemon pod and are supposed to run the daemon pod.
The number of nodes that are running at.id: Jumlah node yang menjalankan setidaknya satu pod daemon dan seharusnya menjalankan pod daemon tersebut.
The number of nodes that are running at.zh: 至少运行一个守护程序 pod 且应该运行该守护程序 pod 的节点数量。
The number of nodes that are running at.zh-hant: 至少運行一個守護程序 pod 且應該運行該守護程序 pod 的節點數。

The number of nodes that are running the.en: The number of nodes that are running the daemon pod, but are not supposed to run the daemon pod.
The number of nodes that are running the.id: Jumlah node yang menjalankan pod daemon, namun tidak seharusnya menjalankan pod daemon.
The number of nodes that are running the.zh: 正在运行守护程序 pod 但不应运行守护程序 pod 的节点数量。
The number of nodes that are running the.zh-hant: 正在運行守護程序 pod 但不應運行守護程序 pod 的節點數。

The number of nodes that should be runni.en: The number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod and have none of the daemon pod running and available (ready for at least spec.minReadySeconds).
The number of nodes that should be runni.id: Jumlah node yang seharusnya menjalankan pod daemon dan tidak ada satupun pod daemon yang berjalan dan tersedia (siap untuk setidaknya spec.minReadySeconds).
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh: 应运行守护程序 pod 并且没有任何守护程序 pod 运行且可用的节点数（至少准备spec.minReadySeconds）。
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh-hant: 應執行守護程序 pod 並且沒有任何守護程序 pod 運行且可用的節點數（至少準備spec.minReadySeconds）。

The number of nodes that should be runni.en: The number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod and have one or more of the daemon pod running and available (ready for at least spec.minReadySeconds).
The number of nodes that should be runni.id: Jumlah node yang harus menjalankan pod daemon dan memiliki satu atau lebih pod daemon yang berjalan dan tersedia (siap untuk setidaknya spec.minReadySeconds).
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh: 应运行守护程序 pod 且具有一个或多个守护程序 pod 正在运行且可用的节点数（至少准备spec.minReadySeconds）。
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh-hant: 應執行守護程序 pod 且具有一個或多個守護程序 pod 正在運行且可用的節點數（至少準備spec.minReadySeconds）。

The number of nodes that should be runni.en: The number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod and have one or more of the daemon pod running and ready.
The number of nodes that should be runni.id: Jumlah node yang seharusnya menjalankan daemon pod dan memiliki satu atau lebih daemon pod yang berjalan dan siap.
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh: 应运行守护程序 Pod 且具有一个或多个守护程序 Pod 正在运行并准备就绪的节点数。
The number of nodes that should be runni.zh-hant: 應執行守護程式 Pod 且具有一個或多個守護程式 Pod 正在運作並準備就緒的節點數。

The number of noncached queries (not cac.en: The number of noncached queries (not cacheable, or not cached due to the query_cache_type setting).
The number of noncached queries (not cac.id: Jumlah kueri yang tidak di-cache (tidak dapat di-cache, atau tidak di-cache karena pengaturan query_cache_type).
The number of noncached queries (not cac.zh: 非缓存查询的数量（不可缓存，或由于 query_cache_type 设置而未缓存）。
The number of noncached queries (not cac.zh-hant: 非快取查詢的數量（不可緩存，或由於 query_cache_type 設定而未緩存）。

The number of objects or documents in th.en: The number of objects or documents in this collection.
The number of objects or documents in th.id: Jumlah objek atau dokumen dalam koleksi ini.
The number of objects or documents in th.zh: 此集合中的对象或文档的数量。
The number of objects or documents in th.zh-hant: 此集合中的物件或文件的數量。

The number of objects that have been laz.en: The number of objects that have been lazy freed.
The number of objects that have been laz.id: Jumlah objek yang telah dibebaskan dengan malas.
The number of objects that have been laz.zh: 已延迟释放的对象数量。
The number of objects that have been laz.zh-hant: 已延遲釋放的物件數量。

The number of objects waiting to be free.en: The number of objects waiting to be freed (as a result of calling UNLINK, or `FLUSHDB` and `FLUSHALL` with the ASYNC option).
The number of objects waiting to be free.id: Jumlah objek yang menunggu untuk dibebaskan (akibat pemanggilan UNLINK, atau `FLUSHDB` dan `FLUSHALL` dengan opsi ASYNC).
The number of objects waiting to be free.zh: 等待释放的对象数量（由于调用 UNLINK 或带有 ASYNC 选项的“FLUSHDB”和“FLUSHALL”）。
The number of objects waiting to be free.zh-hant: 等待釋放的物件數量（由於呼叫 UNLINK 或帶有 ASYNC 選項的“FLUSHDB”和“FLUSHALL”）。

The number of of tables that are open..en: The number of of tables that are open.

The number of open cursors with the opti.en: The number of open cursors with the option DBQuery.Option.noTimeout set to prevent timeout after a period of inactivity
The number of open cursors with the opti.id: Jumlah kursor terbuka dengan opsi DBQuery.Option.noTimeout diatur untuk mencegah batas waktu setelah beberapa saat tidak aktif
The number of open cursors with the opti.zh: 使用 DBQuery.Option.noTimeout 设置选项以防止在一段时间不活动后超时的打开游标数
The number of open cursors with the opti.zh-hant: 使用 DBQuery.Option.noTimeout 設定選項以防止在一段時間不活動後逾時的開啟遊標數

The number of open tables for all thread.en: The number of open tables for all threads. Increasing this value increases the number of file descriptors that mysqld requires.
The number of open tables for all thread.id: Jumlah tabel terbuka untuk semua thread. Meningkatkan nilai ini akan meningkatkan jumlah deskriptor file yang dibutuhkan mysqld.
The number of open tables for all thread.zh: 所有线程打开的表的数量。增加该值会增加 mysqld 所需的文件描述符的数量。
The number of open tables for all thread.zh-hant: 所有執行緒打開的表的數量。增加該值會增加 mysqld 所需的檔案描述符的數量。

The number of open transactions for the.en: The number of open transactions for the session.
The number of open transactions for the.id: Jumlah transaksi terbuka untuk sesi tersebut.
The number of open transactions for the.zh: 会话中未完成的交易数量。
The number of open transactions for the.zh-hant: 會話中未完成的交易數量。

The number of operations executed by the.en: The number of operations executed by the database per second.
The number of operations executed by the.id: Jumlah operasi yang dijalankan oleh database per detik.
The number of operations executed by the.zh: 数据库每秒执行的操作数。
The number of operations executed by the.zh-hant: 資料庫每秒執行的操作數。

The number of operations that are curren.en: The number of operations that are currently queued and waiting for the read lock. A consistently small read-queue, particularly of shorter operations, should cause no concern.
The number of operations that are curren.id: Jumlah operasi yang sedang dalam antrian dan menunggu kunci baca. Antrean baca yang selalu kecil, terutama pada operasi yang lebih pendek, seharusnya tidak menimbulkan kekhawatiran.
The number of operations that are curren.zh: 当前排队并等待读锁的操作数。始终较小的读取队列，尤其是较短的操作，不应引起关注。
The number of operations that are curren.zh-hant: 目前排隊並等待讀鎖的操作數。始終較小的讀取佇列，尤其是較短的操作，不應引起關注。

The number of operations that are curren.en: The number of operations that are currently queued and waiting for the write lock. A consistently small write-queue, particularly of shorter operations, is no cause for concern.
The number of operations that are curren.id: Jumlah operasi yang sedang dalam antrian dan menunggu kunci tulis. Antrean penulisan yang selalu kecil, terutama pada operasi yang lebih pendek, tidak perlu dikhawatirkan.
The number of operations that are curren.zh: 当前排队并等待写锁的操作数。始终较小的写入队列，尤其是较短的操作，无需担心。
The number of operations that are curren.zh-hant: 目前排隊並等待寫鎖的操作數。始終較小的寫入佇列，尤其是較短的操作，無需擔心。

The number of outstanding SQL schema lea.en: The number of outstanding SQL schema leases.
The number of outstanding SQL schema lea.id: Jumlah sewa skema SQL yang luar biasa.
The number of outstanding SQL schema lea.zh: 未完成的 SQL 架构租用数量。
The number of outstanding SQL schema lea.zh-hant: 未完成的 SQL 架構租用數量。

The number of overflows for the open tab.en: The number of overflows for the open tables cache. This is the number of times, after a table is opened or closed, a cache instance has an unused entry and the size of the instance is larger than table_open_cache / table_open_cache_instances.
The number of overflows for the open tab.id: Jumlah overflow untuk cache tabel terbuka. Ini adalah berapa kali, setelah tabel dibuka atau ditutup, instance cache memiliki entri yang tidak digunakan dan ukuran instance lebih besar dari table_open_cache / table_open_cache_instances.
The number of overflows for the open tab.zh: 打开表缓存的溢出次数。这是打开或关闭表后，缓存实例具有未使用条目且实例大小大于 table_open_cache / table_open_cache_instances 的次数。
The number of overflows for the open tab.zh-hant: 開啟表格緩存的溢位次數。這是開啟或關閉表格後，快取實例具有未使用條目且實例大小大於 table_open_cache / table_open_cache_instances 的次數。

The number of packets received by the TC.en: The number of packets received by the TCP layer per second. Linux only
The number of packets received by the TC.id: Jumlah paket yang diterima oleh lapisan TCP per detik. Hanya Linux
The number of packets received by the TC.zh: TCP 层每秒接收的数据包数量。仅限Linux
The number of packets received by the TC.zh-hant: TCP 層每秒接收的資料包數量。僅限Linux

The number of packets received by the in.en: The number of packets received by the interface per second.
The number of packets received by the in.id: Jumlah paket yang diterima oleh antarmuka per detik.
The number of packets received by the in.zh: 接口每秒接收的数据包数量。
The number of packets received by the in.zh-hant: 介面每秒接收的資料包數量。

The number of packets received by the ne.en: The number of packets received by the network interface
The number of packets received by the ne.id: Jumlah paket yang diterima oleh antarmuka jaringan
The number of packets received by the ne.zh: 网络接口接收到的数据包数量
The number of packets received by the ne.zh-hant: 網路介面接收到的封包數量

The number of packets sent by the TCP la.en: The number of packets sent by the TCP layer per second. Linux only
The number of packets sent by the TCP la.id: Jumlah paket yang dikirim oleh lapisan TCP per detik. Hanya Linux
The number of packets sent by the TCP la.zh: TCP 层每秒发送的数据包数量。仅限Linux
The number of packets sent by the TCP la.zh-hant: TCP 層每秒發送的資料包數量。僅限Linux

The number of packets sent by the interf.en: The number of packets sent by the interface per second.
The number of packets sent by the interf.id: Jumlah paket yang dikirim oleh antarmuka per detik.
The number of packets sent by the interf.zh: 接口每秒发送的数据包数量。
The number of packets sent by the interf.zh-hant: 介面每秒發送的資料包數量。

The number of packets sent by the networ.en: The number of packets sent by the network interface
The number of packets sent by the networ.id: Jumlah paket yang dikirim oleh antarmuka jaringan
The number of packets sent by the networ.zh: 网络接口发送的数据包数量
The number of packets sent by the networ.zh-hant: 網路介面發送的封包數量

The number of page splits per second..en: The number of page splits per second.

The number of pages being evicted from t.en: The number of pages being evicted from the WiredTiger cache by worker threads.
The number of pages being evicted from t.id: Jumlah halaman yang dikeluarkan dari cache WiredTiger oleh thread pekerja.
The number of pages being evicted from t.zh: 工作线程从 WiredTiger 缓存中逐出的页面数。
The number of pages being evicted from t.zh-hant: 工作執行緒從 WiredTiger 快取中逐出的頁面數。

The number of pages evicted from the Wir.en: The number of pages evicted from the WiredTiger cache by application threads.
The number of pages evicted from the Wir.id: Jumlah halaman yang dikeluarkan dari cache WiredTiger oleh thread aplikasi.
The number of pages evicted from the Wir.zh: 应用程序线程从 WiredTiger 缓存中逐出的页面数。
The number of pages evicted from the Wir.zh-hant: 應用程式執行緒從 WiredTiger 快取中逐出的頁面數。

The number of pages flushed to disk per.en: The number of pages flushed to disk per second by a checkpoint or other operation that require all dirty pages to be flushed.
The number of pages flushed to disk per.id: Jumlah halaman yang dibuang ke disk per detik oleh pos pemeriksaan atau operasi lain yang mengharuskan semua halaman kotor dibersihkan.
The number of pages flushed to disk per.zh: 检查点或其他需要刷新所有脏页的操作每秒刷新到磁盘的页数。
The number of pages flushed to disk per.zh-hant: 檢查點或其他需要刷新所有髒頁的操作每秒刷新到磁碟的頁數。

The number of pages read by application.en: The number of pages read by application threads from the WiredTiger cache.
The number of pages read by application.id: Jumlah halaman yang dibaca oleh thread aplikasi dari cache WiredTiger.
The number of pages read by application.zh: 应用程序线程从 WiredTiger 缓存读取的页数。
The number of pages read by application.zh-hant: 應用程式執行緒從 WiredTiger 快取讀取的頁數。

The number of pages read from the logica.en: The number of pages read from the logical table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The number of pages read from the logica.id: Jumlah halaman yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel logis untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The number of pages read from the logica.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的逻辑表空间容器中读取的页数。
The number of pages read from the logica.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的邏輯表空間容器中讀取的頁數。

The number of pages read from the physic.en: The number of pages read from the physical table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The number of pages read from the physic.id: Jumlah halaman yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel fisik untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The number of pages read from the physic.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的物理表空间容器中读取的页数。
The number of pages read from the physic.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的實體表空間容器中讀取的頁數。

The number of pages spilled to disk duri.en: The number of pages spilled to disk during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of pages spilled to disk duri.id: Jumlah halaman yang tumpah ke disk selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of pages spilled to disk duri.zh: 收集间隔期间溢出到磁盘的页数（增量值）。
The number of pages spilled to disk duri.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間溢出到磁碟的頁數（增量值）。

The number of pages that were flushed du.en: The number of pages that were flushed during the last checkpoint event.
The number of pages that were flushed du.id: Jumlah halaman yang dihapus selama peristiwa pos pemeriksaan terakhir.
The number of pages that were flushed du.zh: 上次检查点事件期间刷新的页数。
The number of pages that were flushed du.zh-hant: 上次檢查點事件期間刷新的頁數。

The number of pages written by applicati.en: The number of pages written by application threads to the WiredTiger cache.
The number of pages written by applicati.id: Jumlah halaman yang ditulis oleh thread aplikasi ke cache WiredTiger.
The number of pages written by applicati.zh: 应用程序线程写入 WiredTiger 缓存的页数。
The number of pages written by applicati.zh-hant: 應用程式執行緒寫入 WiredTiger 快取的頁數。

The number of pages written per second t.en: The number of pages written per second to the `doublewrite` buffer.
The number of pages written per second t.id: Jumlah halaman yang ditulis per detik ke buffer `doublewrite`.
The number of pages written per second t.zh: 每秒写入“doublewrite”缓冲区的页数。
The number of pages written per second t.zh-hant: 每秒寫入「doublewrite」緩衝區的頁數。

The number of panics recovered by the Qu.en: The number of panics recovered by the Query Executor.
The number of panics recovered by the Qu.id: Jumlah kepanikan yang dipulihkan oleh Pelaksana Kueri.
The number of panics recovered by the Qu.zh: 查询执行器恢复的恐慌数量。
The number of panics recovered by the Qu.zh-hant: 查詢執行器恢復的恐慌數量。

The number of parallel server executions.en: The number of parallel server executions during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of parallel server executions.id: Jumlah eksekusi server paralel selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of parallel server executions.zh: 收集间隔期间并行服务器执行的数量（增量值）。
The number of parallel server executions.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間並行伺服器執行的數量（增量值）。

The number of parse calls during the col.en: The number of parse calls during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of parse calls during the col.id: Jumlah panggilan parse selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of parse calls during the col.zh: 收集间隔期间解析调用的数量（增量值）。
The number of parse calls during the col.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間解析呼叫的數量（增量值）。

The number of partitions on the broker.en: The number of partitions on the broker

The number of pending tasks for the thre.en: The number of pending tasks for the thread pool.
The number of pending tasks for the thre.id: Jumlah tugas yang tertunda untuk kumpulan thread.
The number of pending tasks for the thre.zh: 线程池的待处理任务数。
The number of pending tasks for the thre.zh-hant: 線程池的待處理任務數。

The number of physical read bytes during.en: The number of physical read bytes during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of physical read bytes during.id: Jumlah byte baca fisik selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of physical read bytes during.zh: 收集间隔期间物理读取字节数（增量值）。
The number of physical read bytes during.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間物理讀取位元組數（增量值）。

The number of physical read requests dur.en: The number of physical read requests during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of physical read requests dur.id: Jumlah permintaan baca fisik selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of physical read requests dur.zh: 收集间隔期间的物理读取请求数（增量值）。
The number of physical read requests dur.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間的實體讀取請求數（增量值）。

The number of physical reads of a key bl.en: The number of physical reads of a key block from disk into the MyISAM key cache. If Key_reads is large, then your key_buffer_size value is probably too small. The cache miss rate can be calculated as Key_reads/Key_read_requests.
The number of physical reads of a key bl.id: Jumlah pembacaan fisik blok kunci dari disk ke dalam cache kunci MyISAM. Jika Key_reads besar, nilai key_buffer_size Anda mungkin terlalu kecil. Tingkat kehilangan cache dapat dihitung sebagai Key_reads/Key_read_requests.
The number of physical reads of a key bl.zh: 将密钥块从磁盘物理读取到 MyISAM 密钥缓存的次数。如果 Key_reads 很大，那么您的 key_buffer_size 值可能太小。缓存未命中率可以计算为Key_reads/Key_read_requests。
The number of physical reads of a key bl.zh-hant: 將密鑰區塊從磁碟物理讀取到 MyISAM 密鑰快取的次數。如果 Key_reads 很大，那麼您的 key_buffer_size 值可能太小。快取未命中率可以計算為Key_reads/Key_read_requests。

The number of physical reads performed d.en: The number of physical reads performed during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of physical reads performed d.id: Jumlah pembacaan fisik yang dilakukan selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of physical reads performed d.zh: 收集间隔期间执行的物理读取次数（增量值）。
The number of physical reads performed d.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間執行的實體讀取次數（增量值）。

The number of physical write bytes durin.en: The number of physical write bytes during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of physical write bytes durin.id: Jumlah byte tulis fisik selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of physical write bytes durin.zh: 收集间隔期间的物理写入字节数（增量值）。
The number of physical write bytes durin.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間的實體寫入位元組數（增量值）。

The number of physical write requests du.en: The number of physical write requests during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of physical write requests du.id: Jumlah permintaan tulis fisik selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of physical write requests du.zh: 收集间隔期间的物理写入请求数（增量值）。
The number of physical write requests du.zh-hant: 收集間隔期間的實體寫入請求數（增量值）。

The number of physical writes of a key b.en: The number of physical writes of a key block from the MyISAM key cache to disk.
The number of physical writes of a key b.id: Jumlah penulisan fisik blok kunci dari cache kunci MyISAM ke disk.
The number of physical writes of a key b.zh: 密钥块从 MyISAM 密钥缓存到磁盘的物理写入次数。
The number of physical writes of a key b.zh-hant: 密鑰區塊從 MyISAM 密鑰快取到磁碟的實體寫入次數。

The number of plan cache hits..en: The number of plan cache hits.

The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.en: The number of plugins in the Jenkins instance that failed to start.
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.id: Jumlah plugin di instance Jenkins yang gagal dimulai.
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.zh: Jenkins 实例中启动失败的插件数量。
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.zh-hant: Jenkins 實例中啟動失敗的插件數量。

The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.en: The number of plugins in the Jenkins instance that started successfully.
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.id: Jumlah plugin di instance Jenkins yang berhasil dimulai.
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.zh: Jenkins 实例中成功启动的插件数量。
The number of plugins in the Jenkins ins.zh-hant: Jenkins 實例中成功啟動的插件數量。

The number of pods created for this Stat.en: The number of pods created for this StatefulSet with a Ready Condition.
The number of pods created for this Stat.id: Jumlah pod yang dibuat untuk StatefulSet ini dengan Kondisi Siap.
The number of pods created for this Stat.zh: 为此 StatefulSet 创建的具有就绪条件的 Pod 数量。
The number of pods created for this Stat.zh-hant: 為此 StatefulSet 所建立的具有就緒條件的 Pod 數量。

The number of pods targeted by this Depl.en: The number of pods targeted by this Deployment with a Ready Condition.
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.id: Jumlah pod yang ditargetkan oleh Deployment ini dengan Kondisi Siap.
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.zh: 此部署针对的处于就绪状态的 Pod 数量。
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.zh-hant: 此部署針對的處於就緒狀態的 Pod 數量。

The number of pods targeted by this Depl.en: The number of pods targeted by this Deployment with a Ready Condition. (Deprecated)
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.id: Jumlah pod yang ditargetkan oleh Deployment ini dengan Kondisi Siap. (Tidak digunakan lagi)
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.zh: 此部署针对的处于就绪状态的 Pod 数量。 （已弃用）
The number of pods targeted by this Depl.zh-hant: 此部署針對的處於就緒狀態的 Pod 數量。 （已棄用）

The number of pods which reached phase F.en: The number of pods which reached phase Failed.
The number of pods which reached phase F.id: Jumlah pod yang mencapai fase Gagal.
The number of pods which reached phase F.zh: 达到失败阶段的 Pod 数量。
The number of pods which reached phase F.zh-hant: 達到失敗階段的 Pod 數量。

The number of pods which reached phase S.en: The number of pods which reached phase Succeeded.
The number of pods which reached phase S.id: Jumlah pod yang mencapai fase Berhasil.
The number of pods which reached phase S.zh: 达到成功阶段的 Pod 数量。
The number of pods which reached phase S.zh-hant: 達到成功階段的 Pod 數量。

The number of pointer lookups performed.en: The number of pointer lookups performed by the runtime.
The number of pointer lookups performed.id: Jumlah pencarian penunjuk yang dilakukan oleh runtime.
The number of pointer lookups performed.zh: 运行时执行的指针查找的数量。
The number of pointer lookups performed.zh-hant: 運行時執行的指標查找的數量。

The number of pointers to currently runn.en: The number of pointers to currently running jobs.
The number of pointers to currently runn.id: Jumlah petunjuk ke pekerjaan yang sedang berjalan.
The number of pointers to currently runn.zh: 指向当前正在运行的作业的指针数量。
The number of pointers to currently runn.zh-hant: 指向目前正在執行的作業的指標數量。

The number of points accepted by the HTT.en: The number of points accepted by the HTTP /write endpoint, but unable to be persisted.
The number of points accepted by the HTT.id: Jumlah poin yang diterima oleh titik akhir HTTP /write, namun tidak dapat dipertahankan.
The number of points accepted by the HTT.zh: HTTP/write 端点接受但无法持久化的点数。
The number of points accepted by the HTT.zh-hant: HTTP/write 端點接受但無法持久化的點數。

The number of points dropped by the stor.en: The number of points dropped by the storage engine.
The number of points dropped by the stor.id: Jumlah poin yang dijatuhkan oleh mesin penyimpanan.

The number of points successfully accept.en: The number of points successfully accepted and persisted by the HTTP /write endpoint.
The number of points successfully accept.id: Jumlah poin yang berhasil diterima dan dipertahankan oleh titik akhir HTTP /write.
The number of points successfully accept.zh: HTTP /write 端点成功接受并保留的点数。
The number of points successfully accept.zh-hant: HTTP /write 端點成功接受並保留的點數。

The number of points written successfull.en: The number of points written successfully.

The number of processes created. This is.en: The number of processes created. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
The number of processes created. This is.id: Jumlah proses yang dibuat. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
The number of processes created. This is.zh: 创建的进程数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
The number of processes created. This is.zh-hant: 創建的進程數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

The number of processors available to th.en: The number of processors available to the Java virtual machine
The number of processors available to th.id: Jumlah prosesor yang tersedia untuk mesin virtual Java
The number of processors available to th.zh: Java虚拟机可用的处理器数量
The number of processors available to th.zh-hant: Java虛擬機器可用的處理器數量

The number of project to Jenkins.en: The number of project to Jenkins

The number of queries added to the query.en: The number of queries added to the query cache.
The number of queries added to the query.id: Jumlah kueri yang ditambahkan ke cache kueri.
The number of queries added to the query.zh: 添加到查询缓存的查询数。
The number of queries added to the query.zh-hant: 新增到查詢快取的查詢數。

The number of queries executed (started).zh: 已执行（已启动）的查询数。
The number of queries executed (started).zh-hant: 已執行（已啟動）的查詢數。

The number of queries in the current que.en: The number of queries in the current query result cache.
The number of queries in the current que.id: Jumlah kueri dalam cache hasil kueri saat ini.
The number of queries in the current que.zh: 当前查询结果缓存中的查询数量。
The number of queries in the current que.zh-hant: 目前查詢結果快取中的查詢數量。

The number of queries registered in the.en: The number of queries registered in the query cache.
The number of queries registered in the.id: Jumlah kueri yang terdaftar di cache kueri.
The number of queries registered in the.zh: 查询缓存中注册的查询数。
The number of queries registered in the.zh-hant: 查詢快取中註冊的查詢數。

The number of queries that have finished.en: The number of queries that have finished executing.
The number of queries that have finished.id: Jumlah kueri yang telah selesai dieksekusi.

The number of queries that have taken mo.en: The number of queries that have taken more than long_query_time seconds. This counter increments regardless of whether the slow query log is enabled
The number of queries that have taken mo.id: Jumlah kueri yang memakan waktu lebih dari long_query_time detik. Penghitung ini bertambah terlepas dari apakah log kueri lambat diaktifkan

The number of rows. Some storage engines.en: The number of rows. Some storage engines, such as MyISAM, store the exact count. For other storage engines, such as InnoDB, this value is an approximation, and may vary from the actual value by as much as 40% to 50%. In such cases, use SELECT COUNT(*) to obtain an accurate count.
The number of rows. Some storage engines.id: Jumlah baris. Beberapa mesin penyimpanan, seperti MyISAM, menyimpan jumlah pastinya. Dalam kasus seperti ini, gunakan SELECT COUNT(*) untuk mendapatkan penghitungan yang akurat.
The number of rows. Some storage engines.zh: 行数。某些存储引擎（例如 MyISAM）存储精确的计数。对于其他存储引擎，例如 InnoDB，该值是一个近似值，可能与实际值相差 40% 到 50%。在这种情况下，请使用 SELECT COUNT(*) 来获取准确的计数。
The number of rows. Some storage engines.zh-hant: 行數。某些儲存引擎（例如 MyISAM）儲存精確的計數。對於其他儲存引擎，例如 InnoDB，該值是一個近似值，可能與實際值相差 40% 到 50%。在這種情況下，請使用 SELECT COUNT(*) 來取得準確的計數。
