The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.id: Berapa kali perintah 'temukan' dan 'modifikasi' dijalankan pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.zh: 在此 mongod 上执行“查找”和“修改”命令的次数
The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上執行「尋找」和「修改」指令的次數

The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.en: The number of times that 'find' and 'modify' commands failed on this mongod
The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.id: Berapa kali perintah 'temukan' dan 'modifikasi' gagal pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.zh: 在此 mongod 上“查找”和“修改”命令失败的次数
The number of times that 'find' and 'mod.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上「尋找」和「修改」指令失敗的次數

The number of times that 'find' command.en: The number of times that 'find' command executed on this mongod
The number of times that 'find' command.id: Berapa kali perintah 'find' dieksekusi pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'find' command.zh: 在此 mongod 上执行“find”命令的次数
The number of times that 'find' command.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上執行「find」指令的次數

The number of times that 'find' command.en: The number of times that 'find' command failed on this mongod
The number of times that 'find' command.id: Berapa kali perintah 'find' gagal pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'find' command.zh: “find”命令在此 mongod 上失败的次数
The number of times that 'find' command.zh-hant: 「find」指令在此 mongod 上失敗的次數

The number of times that 'get more' comm.en: The number of times that 'get more' command executed on this mongod
The number of times that 'get more' comm.id: Berapa kali perintah 'dapatkan lebih banyak' dijalankan pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'get more' comm.zh: 在此 mongod 上执行“get more”命令的次数
The number of times that 'get more' comm.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上執行「get more」指令的次數

The number of times that 'get more' comm.en: The number of times that 'get more' command failed on this mongod
The number of times that 'get more' comm.id: Berapa kali perintah 'dapatkan lebih banyak' gagal pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'get more' comm.zh: 在此 mongod 上“获取更多”命令失败的次数
The number of times that 'get more' comm.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上「取得更多」指令失敗的次數

The number of times that 'insert' comman.en: The number of times that 'insert' command executed on this mongod
The number of times that 'insert' comman.id: Berapa kali perintah 'masukkan' dijalankan pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'insert' comman.zh: 在此 mongod 上执行“insert”命令的次数
The number of times that 'insert' comman.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上執行「insert」指令的次數

The number of times that 'insert' comman.en: The number of times that 'insert' command failed on this mongod
The number of times that 'insert' comman.id: Berapa kali perintah 'masukkan' gagal pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'insert' comman.zh: 在此 mongod 上“插入”命令失败的次数
The number of times that 'insert' comman.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上「插入」指令失敗的次數

The number of times that 'update' comman.en: The number of times that 'update' command executed on this mongod
The number of times that 'update' comman.id: Berapa kali perintah 'perbarui' dijalankan pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'update' comman.zh: 在此 mongod 上执行“update”命令的次数
The number of times that 'update' comman.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上執行「update」指令的次數

The number of times that 'update' comman.en: The number of times that 'update' command failed on this mongod
The number of times that 'update' comman.id: Berapa kali perintah 'perbarui' gagal pada mongod ini
The number of times that 'update' comman.zh: 在此 mongod 上“更新”命令失败的次数
The number of times that 'update' comman.zh-hant: 在此 mongod 上「更新」指令失敗的次數

The number of times that TCP connections.en: The number of times that TCP connections have made a direct transition to the CLOSED state from either the ESTABLISHED state or the CLOSE-WAIT state.
The number of times that TCP connections.id: Berapa kali koneksi TCP melakukan transisi langsung ke status TERTUTUP, baik dari status ESTABLISHED atau status CLOSE-WAIT.
The number of times that TCP connections.zh: TCP 连接从 ESTABLISHED 状态或 CLOSE-WAIT 状态直接转换到 CLOSED 状态的次数。
The number of times that TCP connections.zh-hant: TCP 連線從 ESTABLISHED 狀態或 CLOSE-WAIT 狀態直接轉換到 CLOSED 狀態的次數。

The number of times that TCP connections.en: The number of times that TCP connections have made a direct transition to the CLOSED state from either the SYN-SENT state or the SYN-RCVD state, or to the LISTEN state from the SYN-RCVD state.
The number of times that TCP connections.id: Berapa kali koneksi TCP melakukan transisi langsung ke status TERTUTUP dari status SYN-SENT atau status SYN-RCVD, atau ke status LISTEN dari status SYN-RCVD.
The number of times that TCP connections.zh: TCP 连接从 SYN-SENT 状态或 SYN-RCVD 状态直接转换到 CLOSED 状态，或者从 SYN-RCVD 状态直接转换到 LISTEN 状态的次数。
The number of times that TCP connections.zh-hant: TCP 連線從 SYN-SENT 狀態或 SYN-RCVD 狀態直接轉換到 CLOSED 狀態，或從 SYN-RCVD 狀態直接轉換到 LISTEN 狀態的次數。

The number of times that TCP connections.en: The number of times that TCP connections have made a direct transition to the SYN-SENT state from the CLOSED state.
The number of times that TCP connections.id: Berapa kali koneksi TCP melakukan transisi langsung ke status SYN-SENT dari status CLOSED.
The number of times that TCP connections.zh: TCP 连接从 CLOSED 状态直接转换到 SYN-SENT 状态的次数。
The number of times that TCP connections.zh-hant: TCP 連線從 CLOSED 狀態直接轉換到 SYN-SENT 狀態的次數。

The number of times that a request for a.en: The number of times that a request for a table lock could be granted immediately.
The number of times that a request for a.id: Berapa kali permintaan kunci meja dapat dikabulkan dengan segera.
The number of times that a request for a.zh: 可以立即授予表锁请求的次数。
The number of times that a request for a.zh-hant: 可以立即授予表鎖請求的次數。

The number of times that a request to lo.en: The number of times that a request to lock an object timed out instead of being granted.
The number of times that a request to lo.id: Berapa kali waktu tunggu permintaan untuk mengunci suatu objek habis dan bukannya dikabulkan.
The number of times that a request to lo.zh: 锁定对象的请求超时而不是被授予的次数。
The number of times that a request to lo.zh-hant: 鎖定物件的請求超時而不是被授予的次數。

The number of times that mongod has chec.en: The number of times that mongod has checked the free list without finding a suitably large record allocation.
The number of times that mongod has chec.id: Berapa kali mongod memeriksa daftar gratis tanpa menemukan alokasi catatan besar yang sesuai.
The number of times that mongod has chec.zh: mongod 检查空闲列表但未找到适当大的记录分配的次数。
The number of times that mongod has chec.zh-hant: mongod 檢查空閒清單但未找到適當大的記錄分配的次數。

The number of times that the application.en: The number of times that the application pool has been recycled since Windows Process Activation Service (WAS) started.
The number of times that the application.id: Berapa kali kumpulan aplikasi telah didaur ulang sejak Layanan Aktivasi Proses Windows (WAS) dimulai.
The number of times that the application.zh: 自 Windows Process Activation Service (WAS) 启动以来应用程序池被回收的次数。
The number of times that the application.zh-hant: 自 Windows Process Activation Service (WAS) 啟動以來應用程式集區被回收的次數。

The number of times that the query acces.en: The number of times that the query accesses the plan cache.
The number of times that the query acces.id: Berapa kali kueri mengakses cache paket.
The number of times that the query acces.zh: 查询访问计划缓存的次数。
The number of times that the query acces.zh-hant: 查詢存取計劃快取的次數。

The number of times that the rollover co.en: The number of times that the rollover counters have rolled over since the last time the MongoDB process started. The counters will rollover to zero after 2 30 assertions. Use this value to provide context to the other values in the asserts data structure.
The number of times that the rollover co.id: Berapa kali penghitung rollover bergulir sejak terakhir kali proses MongoDB dimulai. Penghitung akan bergulir ke nol setelah 2 30 pernyataan. Gunakan nilai ini untuk memberikan konteks pada nilai lain dalam struktur data pernyataan.
The number of times that the rollover co.zh: 自上次 MongoDB 进程启动以来滚动计数器滚动的次数。在 2 30 次断言后，计数器将翻转为零。使用此值为断言数据结构中的其他值提供上下文。
The number of times that the rollover co.zh-hant: 自上次 MongoDB 進程啟動以來滾動計數器滾動的次數。在 2 30 次斷言後，計數器將翻轉為零。使用此值為斷言資料結構中的其他值提供上下文。

The number of times the background proce.en: The number of times the background process removes documents from collections with a ttl index.
The number of times the background proce.id: Berapa kali proses latar belakang menghapus dokumen dari koleksi dengan indeks ttl.
The number of times the background proce.zh: 后台进程从具有 ttl 索引的集合中删除文档的次数。
The number of times the background proce.zh-hant: 後台程序從具有 ttl 索引的集合中刪除文件的次數。

The number of times the background write.en: The number of times the background writer stopped a cleaning scan due to writing too many buffers.
The number of times the background write.id: Berapa kali penulis latar belakang menghentikan pemindaian pembersihan karena menulis terlalu banyak buffer.
The number of times the background write.zh: 后台写入器由于写入太多缓冲区而停止清理扫描的次数。
The number of times the background write.zh-hant: 後台寫入器因寫入太多緩衝區而停止清理掃描的次數。

The number of times the cache has prefet.en: The number of times the cache has prefetched a cached item.
The number of times the cache has prefet.id: Berapa kali cache mengambil item yang disimpan dalam cache.
The number of times the cache has prefet.zh: 缓存预取缓存项的次数。
The number of times the cache has prefet.zh-hant: 快取預取快取項目的次數。

The number of times the checkpoint proce.en: The number of times the checkpoint process was limited during the most recent checkpoint.
The number of times the checkpoint proce.id: Berapa kali proses pos pemeriksaan dibatasi selama pos pemeriksaan terbaru.
The number of times the checkpoint proce.zh: 在最近的检查点期间检查点过程受到限制的次数。
The number of times the checkpoint proce.zh-hant: 在最近的檢查點期間檢查點過程受到限制的次數。

The number of times the container has be.en: The number of times the container has been restarted.
The number of times the container has be.id: Berapa kali kontainer telah dimulai ulang.
The number of times the container has be.zh: 容器已重新启动的次数。
The number of times the container has be.zh-hant: 容器已重新啟動的次數。

The number of times the health checks fa.en: The number of times the health checks failed

The number of times the historical metad.en: The number of times the historical metadata log was cleared.
The number of times the historical metad.id: Berapa kali log metadata historis dihapus.
The number of times the historical metad.zh: 历史元数据日志被清除的次数。
The number of times the historical metad.zh-hant: 歷史元資料日誌被清除的次數。

The number of times the query was execut.en: The number of times the query was executed during the collection interval (delta value).
The number of times the query was execut.id: Berapa kali kueri dieksekusi selama interval pengumpulan (nilai delta).
The number of times the query was execut.zh: 在收集间隔期间执行查询的次数（增量值）。
The number of times the query was execut.zh-hant: 在收集間隔期間執行查詢的次數（增量值）。

The number of times the system swapped f.en: The number of times the system swapped from disk to memory.
The number of times the system swapped f.id: Berapa kali sistem bertukar dari disk ke memori.
The number of times the system swapped f.zh: 系统从磁盘交换到内存的次数。
The number of times the system swapped f.zh-hant: 系統從磁碟交換到記憶體的次數。

The number of times the system swapped f.en: The number of times the system swapped from memory to disk.
The number of times the system swapped f.id: Berapa kali sistem bertukar dari memori ke disk.
The number of times the system swapped f.zh: 系统从内存交换到磁盘的次数。
The number of times the system swapped f.zh-hant: 系統從記憶體交換到磁碟的次數。

The number of times this function has be.en: The number of times this function has been called.

The number of times this table has been.en: The number of times this table has been analyzed by the `autovacuum` daemon.
The number of times this table has been.id: Berapa kali tabel ini dianalisis oleh daemon `autovacuum`.

The number of times this table has been.en: The number of times this table has been manually analyzed.
The number of times this table has been.id: Berapa kali tabel ini dianalisis secara manual.

The number of times this table has been.en: The number of times this table has been manually vacuumed.
The number of times this table has been.id: Berapa kali meja ini disedot secara manual.
The number of times this table has been.zh: 该表已被手动清理的次数。
The number of times this table has been.zh-hant: 該表已被手動清理的次數。

The number of times this table has been.en: The number of times this table has been vacuumed by the `autovacuum` daemon.
The number of times this table has been.id: Berapa kali tabel ini dikosongkan oleh daemon `autovacuum`.

The number of times writing a cache bloc.en: The number of times writing a cache block to the secondary cache failed.
The number of times writing a cache bloc.id: Berapa kali gagal menulis blok cache ke cache sekunder.
The number of times writing a cache bloc.zh: 缓存块写入二级缓存失败的次数。
The number of times writing a cache bloc.zh-hant: 快取塊寫入二級快取失敗的次數。

The number of times, the process limit h.en: The number of times, the process limit has been reached, when pm tries to start more children (works only for pm 'dynamic' and 'ondemand').
The number of times, the process limit h.id: Berapa kali, batas proses telah tercapai, ketika pm mencoba memulai lebih banyak anak (hanya berfungsi untuk pm 'dinamis' dan 'ondemand').
The number of times, the process limit h.zh: 当 pm 尝试启动更多子进程时，已达到进程限制的次数（仅适用于 pm 'dynamic' 和 'ondemand'）。
The number of times, the process limit h.zh-hant: 當 pm 嘗試啟動更多子進程時，已達到進程限制的次數（僅適用於 pm 'dynamic' 和 'ondemand'）。

The number of tokens used by the Compact.en: The number of tokens used by the Compaction task.
The number of tokens used by the Compact.id: Jumlah token yang digunakan oleh tugas Pemadatan.
The number of tokens used by the Compact.zh: 压缩任务使用的令牌数量。
The number of tokens used by the Compact.zh-hant: 壓縮任務使用的令牌數量。

The number of transaction rows which can.en: The number of transaction rows which can be used for certification, but have not been garbage collected. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transaction rows which can.id: Jumlah baris transaksi yang dapat digunakan untuk sertifikasi, namun sampahnya belum dikumpulkan. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transaction rows which can.zh: 可用于认证但尚未被垃圾回收的交易行数。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transaction rows which can.zh-hant: 可用於認證但尚未被垃圾回收的交易行數。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions in the queue.en: The number of transactions in the queue pending conflict detection checks. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions in the queue.id: Jumlah transaksi dalam antrian menunggu pemeriksaan deteksi konflik. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions in the queue.zh: 队列中等待冲突检测检查的事务数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions in the queue.zh-hant: 佇列中等待衝突偵測檢查的事務數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions that can occu.en: The number of transactions that can occur until a transaction wraparound.
The number of transactions that can occu.id: Jumlah transaksi yang dapat terjadi hingga penyelesaian transaksi.
The number of transactions that can occu.zh: 事务回滚之前可以发生的事务数。
The number of transactions that can occu.zh-hant: 事務回滾之前可以發生的事務數。

The number of transactions that have bee.en: The number of transactions that have been checked for conflicts. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions that have bee.id: Jumlah transaksi yang telah diperiksa konfliknya. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions that have bee.zh: 已检查冲突的事务数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions that have bee.zh-hant: 已檢查衝突的事務數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions that have bee.en: The number of transactions that have been committed in this database.
The number of transactions that have bee.id: Jumlah transaksi yang telah dilakukan dalam database ini.
The number of transactions that have bee.zh: 此数据库中已提交的事务数。
The number of transactions that have bee.zh-hant: 此資料庫中已提交的交易數。

The number of transactions that have bee.en: The number of transactions that have been rolled back in this database.
The number of transactions that have bee.id: Jumlah transaksi yang telah dibatalkan dalam database ini.
The number of transactions that have bee.zh: 此数据库中已回滚的事务数。
The number of transactions that have bee.zh-hant: 此資料庫中已回滾的事務數。

The number of transactions that have not.en: The number of transactions that have not passed the conflict detection check. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions that have not.id: Jumlah transaksi yang belum lolos pemeriksaan deteksi konflik. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions that have not.zh: 未通过冲突检测检查的事务数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions that have not.zh-hant: 未透過衝突檢測檢查的事務數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions that this mem.en: The number of transactions that this member has received from the replication group which are waiting to be applied. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions that this mem.id: Jumlah transaksi yang diterima anggota ini dari grup replikasi yang menunggu untuk diterapkan. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions that this mem.zh: 该成员已从复制组接收到的等待应用的事务数。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions that this mem.zh-hant: 此成員已從複製群組接收到的等待應用程式的交易數。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions that used the.en: The number of transactions that used the binary log cache.
The number of transactions that used the.id: Jumlah transaksi yang menggunakan cache log biner.
The number of transactions that used the.zh: 使用二进制日志缓存的事务数。
The number of transactions that used the.zh-hant: 使用二進位日誌快取的交易數。

The number of transactions that used the.en: The number of transactions that used the temporary binary log cache but that exceeded the value of binlog_cache_size and used a temporary file to store statements from the transaction.
The number of transactions that used the.id: Jumlah transaksi yang menggunakan cache log biner sementara tetapi melebihi nilai binlog_cache_size dan menggunakan file sementara untuk menyimpan pernyataan dari transaksi tersebut.
The number of transactions that used the.zh: 使用临时二进制日志缓存但超出 binlog_cache_size 值并使用临时文件存储事务中的语句的事务数。
The number of transactions that used the.zh-hant: 使用臨時二進位日誌快取但超出 binlog_cache_size 值並使用暫存檔案儲存交易中的語句的交易數。

The number of transactions this member h.en: The number of transactions this member has received from the group and applied. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions this member h.id: Jumlah transaksi yang diterima anggota ini dari grup dan diterapkan. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions this member h.zh: 该成员从群组收到并申请的交易数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions this member h.zh-hant: 該成員從群組收到併申請的交易數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions which origina.en: The number of transactions which originated on this member and were rolled back by the group. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions which origina.id: Jumlah transaksi yang berasal dari anggota ini dan dibatalkan oleh grup. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions which origina.zh: 源自该成员并被该组回滚的事务数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions which origina.zh-hant: 源自該成員並被該群組回滾的交易數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of transactions which origina.en: The number of transactions which originated on this member and were sent to the group. Collected as group replication metric.
The number of transactions which origina.id: Jumlah transaksi yang berasal dari anggota ini dan dikirim ke grup. Dikumpulkan sebagai metrik replikasi grup.
The number of transactions which origina.zh: 源自该成员并发送到该组的交易数量。作为组复制指标收集。
The number of transactions which origina.zh-hant: 源自該成員並發送到該群組的交易數量。作為組複製指標收集。

The number of under replicated partition.en: The number of under replicated partitions

The number of unhealthy nodes in the clu.en: The number of unhealthy nodes in the cluster. They represent each individual node's view of the cluster and thus should not be summed across reporting nodes.
The number of unhealthy nodes in the clu.id: Jumlah node yang tidak sehat di cluster. Mereka mewakili pandangan masing-masing node terhadap cluster dan oleh karena itu tidak boleh dijumlahkan di seluruh node pelaporan.
The number of unhealthy nodes in the clu.zh: 集群中不健康节点的数量。它们代表每个单独节点的集群视图，因此不应跨报告节点求和。
The number of unhealthy nodes in the clu.zh-hant: 叢集中不健康節點的數量。它們代表每個單獨節點的叢集視圖，因此不應跨報告節點求和。

The number of unused incoming connection.en: The number of unused incoming connections available.
The number of unused incoming connection.id: Jumlah koneksi masuk yang tersedia dan belum terpakai.
The number of unused incoming connection.zh: 未使用的可用传入连接数。

The phase indicates if a volume is avail.zh-hant: 此階段指示磁碟區是否可用、綁定到聲明或由聲明釋放。 （待定/綁定/丟失）

The phase of a Pod is a simple, high-lev.en: The phase of a Pod is a simple, high-level summary of where the Pod is in its lifecycle.(Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed/Unknown)

The rate of CPU time usage by the JVM pe.zh-hant: Jenkins 控制器上 JVM 每單位時間的 CPU 時間使用率。這相當於 Jenkins JVM 所使用的 CPU 核心數量。

The rate of internal on-disk temporary t.id: Tingkat tabel sementara internal pada disk yang dibuat per detik oleh server saat menjalankan pernyataan.
The rate of internal on-disk temporary t.zh: 服务器在执行语句时每秒创建内部磁盘临时表的速率。
The rate of internal on-disk temporary t.zh-hant: 伺服器在執行語句時每秒建立內部磁碟臨時表的速率。

The rate of internal temporary tables cr.zh-hant: 伺服器在執行語句時每秒建立內部臨時表的速率。

The rate of statements executed by the s.zh-hant: 伺服器執行語句的速率。

The rate of temporary files created by s.zh-hant: 每秒建立臨時檔案的速率。

The ratio of Bloom filter false positive.en: The ratio of Bloom filter false positives to total checks.
The ratio of Bloom filter false positive.id: Rasio Bloom memfilter positif palsu terhadap total pemeriksaan.
The ratio of Bloom filter false positive.zh: 布隆过滤器误报与总检查的比率。
The ratio of Bloom filter false positive.zh-hant: 布隆過濾器誤報與總檢查的比率。

The ratio of data pages found and read f.en: The ratio of data pages found and read from the buffer cache over all data page requests.
The ratio of data pages found and read f.id: Rasio halaman data yang ditemukan dan dibaca dari cache buffer terhadap semua permintaan halaman data.
The ratio of data pages found and read f.zh: 从缓冲区高速缓存中找到和读取的数据页与所有数据页请求的比率。
The ratio of data pages found and read f.zh-hant: 從緩衝區快取中找到和讀取的資料頁與所有資料頁請求的比率。

The ratio of hits to the total number of.en: The ratio of hits to the total number of lookups in the page cache. Performance relies on efficiently using the page cache, so this metric should be in the 98-100% range consistently. If it is much lower than that, then the database is going to disk too often.
The ratio of hits to the total number of.id: Rasio klik terhadap jumlah total pencarian di cache halaman. Kinerja bergantung pada penggunaan cache halaman secara efisien, sehingga metrik ini harus berada dalam kisaran 98-100% secara konsisten. Jika jauh lebih rendah dari itu, database akan terlalu sering dimasukkan ke dalam disk.
The ratio of hits to the total number of.zh: 页面缓存中的命中数与查找总数的比率。性能依赖于有效使用页面缓存，因此该指标应始终处于 98-100% 的范围内。如果远低于该值，则数据库将过于频繁地访问磁盘。
The ratio of hits to the total number of.zh-hant: 頁面快取中的命中數與尋找總數的比率。效能依賴於有效使用頁面緩存，因此該指標應始終處於 98-100% 的範圍內。如果遠低於該值，則資料庫將過於頻繁地存取磁碟。

The ratio of number of used pages to tot.en: The ratio of number of used pages to total number of available pages. This metric shows what percentage of the allocated page cache is actually being used. If it is 100%, then it is likely that the hit ratio will start dropping, and you should consider allocating more RAM to page cache.
The ratio of number of used pages to tot.id: Rasio jumlah halaman yang digunakan dengan jumlah halaman yang tersedia. Metrik ini menunjukkan berapa persentase cache halaman yang dialokasikan yang sebenarnya digunakan. Jika 100%, kemungkinan besar rasio hit akan mulai menurun, dan Anda harus mempertimbangkan untuk mengalokasikan lebih banyak RAM ke cache halaman.
The ratio of number of used pages to tot.zh: 已用页面数与可用页面总数的比率。该指标显示实际使用的已分配页面缓存的百分比。如果是 100%，那么命中率很可能会开始下降，您应该考虑为页面缓存分配更多 RAM。
The ratio of number of used pages to tot.zh-hant: 已使用頁面數與可用頁面總數的比率。此指標顯示實際使用的已指派頁面快取的百分比。如果是 100%，那麼命中率很可能會開始下降，您應該考慮為頁面快取分配更多 RAM。

The ratio of time spent for running hard.en: The ratio of time spent for running hardware interrupt requests on the CPU. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. A high number of this metric may indicate hardware misconfiguration or a very high network load. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time spent for running hard.id: Rasio waktu yang dihabiskan untuk menjalankan permintaan interupsi perangkat keras pada CPU. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Tingginya angka metrik ini mungkin menunjukkan kesalahan konfigurasi perangkat keras atau beban jaringan yang sangat tinggi. Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time spent for running hard.zh: CPU 上运行硬件中断请求所花费的时间比率。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。此指标的数值较高可能表示硬件配置错误或网络负载非常高。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time spent for running hard.zh-hant: CPU 上執行硬體中斷要求所花費的時間比率。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。此指標的數值較高可能表示硬體配置錯誤或網路負載非常高。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time spent for running soft.en: The ratio of time spent for running software interrupt requests on the CPU. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. A high number of this metric may indicate inefficient software running on the system. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time spent for running soft.id: Rasio waktu yang dihabiskan untuk menjalankan permintaan interupsi perangkat lunak pada CPU. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Tingginya angka metrik ini mungkin menunjukkan tidak efisiennya perangkat lunak yang berjalan di sistem. Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time spent for running soft.zh: CPU 上运行软件中断请求所花费的时间比率。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。此指标的数值较高可能表明系统上运行的软件效率低下。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time spent for running soft.zh-hant: CPU 上執行軟體中斷請求所花費的時間比率。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。此指標的數值較高可能表示系統上運作的軟體效率低。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time spent in other operati.en: The ratio of time spent in other operating systems by the CPU when running in a virtualized environment. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. Not every virtualized environments present this metric, and most of them don't. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time spent in other operati.id: Rasio waktu yang dihabiskan CPU di sistem operasi lain saat berjalan di lingkungan tervirtualisasi. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Tidak semua lingkungan tervirtualisasi menyajikan metrik ini, dan sebagian besar tidak. Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time spent in other operati.zh: 在虚拟化环境中运行时，CPU 在其他操作系统上花费的时间比例。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。并非每个虚拟化环境都提供此指标，而且大多数虚拟化环境都没有。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time spent in other operati.zh-hant: 在虛擬化環境中運作時，CPU 在其他作業系統上花費的時間比例。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。並非每個虛擬化環境都提供此指標，而且大多數虛擬化環境都沒有。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time spent running a virtua.en: The ratio of time spent running a virtual CPU for guest operating systems under the control of the Linux kernel (See `man procfs`). This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. This metric is irrelevant for ClickHouse, but still exists for completeness. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.id: Rasio waktu yang dihabiskan untuk menjalankan CPU virtual untuk sistem operasi tamu di bawah kendali kernel Linux (Lihat `man procfs`). Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Metrik ini tidak relevan untuk ClickHouse, namun tetap ada untuk kelengkapan. Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.zh: 在 Linux 内核控制下为来宾操作系统运行虚拟 CPU 所花费的时间比率（请参阅“man procfs”）。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。该指标与 ClickHouse 无关，但为了完整性仍然存在。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.zh-hant: 在 Linux 核心控制下為來賓作業系統執行虛擬 CPU 所花費的時間比率（請參閱「man procfs」）。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。該指標與 ClickHouse 無關，但為了完整性仍然存在。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time spent running a virtua.en: The ratio of time spent running a virtual CPU for guest operating systems under the control of the Linux kernel, when a guest was set to a higher priority (See `man procfs`). This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. This metric is irrelevant for ClickHouse, but still exists for completeness. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.id: Rasio waktu yang dihabiskan untuk menjalankan CPU virtual untuk sistem operasi tamu di bawah kendali kernel Linux, ketika tamu ditetapkan ke prioritas yang lebih tinggi (Lihat `man procfs`). Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Metrik ini tidak relevan untuk ClickHouse, namun tetap ada untuk kelengkapan. Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.zh: 当客户设置为较高优先级时，在 Linux 内核控制下为客户操作系统运行虚拟 CPU 所花费的时间比率（请参阅“man procfs”）。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。该指标与 ClickHouse 无关，但为了完整性仍然存在。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time spent running a virtua.zh-hant: 當客戶設定為較高優先權時，在 Linux 核心控制下為客戶作業系統執行虛擬 CPU 所花費的時間比率（請參閱「man procfs」）。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。該指標與 ClickHouse 無關，但為了完整性仍然存在。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time that a queue's consume.zh-hant: 隊列的消費者可以接收新訊息的時間比率

The ratio of time the CPU core was idle.en: The ratio of time the CPU core was idle (not even ready to run a process waiting for IO) from the OS kernel standpoint. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. This does not include the time when the CPU was under-utilized due to the reasons internal to the CPU (memory loads, `pipeline stalls`, branch `mispredictions`, running another SMT core). The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].
The ratio of time the CPU core was idle.id: Rasio waktu inti CPU menganggur (bahkan belum siap menjalankan proses menunggu IO) dari sudut pandang kernel OS. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`. Ini tidak termasuk waktu ketika CPU kurang dimanfaatkan karena alasan internal CPU (beban memori, `pipa terhenti`, `kesalahan prediksi` cabang, menjalankan inti SMT lain). Nilai untuk satu inti CPU akan berada dalam interval [0..1]. Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time the CPU core was idle.zh: 从操作系统内核的角度来看，CPU 核心空闲的时间比率（甚至没有准备好运行等待 IO 的进程）。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。这不包括由于 CPU 内部原因（内存负载、“管道停顿”、分支“错误预测”、运行另一个 SMT 核心）而导致 CPU 利用率不足的时间。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time the CPU core was idle.zh-hant: 從作業系統核心的角度來看，CPU 核心空閒的時間比率（甚至沒有準備好運行等待 IO 的進程）。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。這不包括由於 CPU 內部原因（記憶體負載、「管道停頓」、分支「錯誤預測」、運行另一個 SMT 核心）而導致 CPU 使用率不足的時間。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The ratio of time the CPU core was not r.en: The ratio of time the CPU core was not running the code but when the OS kernel did not run any other process on this CPU as the processes were waiting for IO. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`. The value for a single CPU core will be in the interval [0..1]. The value for all CPU cores is calculated as a sum across them [0..num cores].

Nilai untuk semua inti CPU dihitung sebagai jumlah seluruh inti tersebut [0..num inti].
The ratio of time the CPU core was not r.zh: CPU 核心未运行代码但操作系统内核未在该 CPU 上运行任何其他进程（因为进程正在等待 IO）的时间比率。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。单个 CPU 核心的值将位于 [0..1] 区间内。所有 CPU 核心的值计算为它们的总和 [0..num cores]。
The ratio of time the CPU core was not r.zh-hant: CPU 核心未執行程式碼但作業系統核心未在該 CPU 上執行任何其他進程（因為進程正在等待 IO）的時間比率。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。單一 CPU 核心的值將位於 [0..1] 區間內。所有 CPU 核心的值計算為它們的總和 [0..num cores]。

The total CPU limit (in millicores) acro.zh: 此 Pod 中所有容器的总 CPU 限制（以毫核为单位）。注意：该值是所有容器限制值的总和，因为 Pod 没有直接的限制值。
The total CPU limit (in millicores) acro.zh-hant: 此 Pod 中所有容器的總 CPU 限制（以毫核為單位）。注意：該值是所有容器限制值的總和，因為 Pod 沒有直接的限制值。

The total CPU request (in millicores) ac.en: The total CPU request (in millicores) across all containers in this Pod.  Note: This value is the sum of all container request values, as Pods do not have a direct request value.
The total CPU request (in millicores) ac.id: Total permintaan CPU (dalam milicore) di seluruh container di Pod ini.  Catatan: Nilai ini merupakan jumlah seluruh nilai permintaan kontainer, karena Pod tidak memiliki nilai permintaan langsung.
The total CPU request (in millicores) ac.zh: 此 Pod 中所有容器的总 CPU 请求（以毫核为单位）。  注意：该值是所有容器请求值的总和，因为 Pod 没有直接请求值。
The total CPU request (in millicores) ac.zh-hant: 此 Pod 中所有容器的總 CPU 請求（以毫核為單位）。  注意：該值是所有容器請求值的總和，因為 Pod 沒有直接請求值。

The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.en: The total CPU time (microseconds) consumed by query executions (cumulative value from Oracle).
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.id: Total waktu CPU (mikrodetik) yang digunakan oleh eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari Oracle).
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.zh: 查询执行消耗的总 CPU 时间（微秒）（来自 Oracle 的累积值）。
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.zh-hant: 查詢執行消耗的總 CPU 時間（微秒）（來自 Oracle 的累積值）。

The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.en: The total CPU time (microseconds) consumed by query executions (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.id: Total waktu CPU (mikrodetik) yang digunakan oleh eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.zh: 查询执行消耗的总 CPU 时间（微秒）（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total CPU time (microseconds) consum.zh-hant: 查詢執行消耗的總 CPU 時間（微秒）（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total CPU time consumed by these com.en: The total CPU time consumed by these commands.
The total CPU time consumed by these com.id: Total waktu CPU yang digunakan oleh perintah ini.
The total CPU time consumed by these com.zh: 这些命令消耗的总 CPU 时间。
The total CPU time consumed by these com.zh-hant: 這些命令消耗的總 CPU 時間。

The total CPU usage (in millicores) aver.en: The total CPU usage (in millicores) averaged over the sample window for all containers.
The total CPU usage (in millicores) aver.id: Total penggunaan CPU (dalam milicore) dirata-ratakan pada jendela sampel untuk semua container.
The total CPU usage (in millicores) aver.zh: 所有容器的样本窗口内的平均 CPU 使用率（以毫核为单位）。
The total CPU usage (in millicores) aver.zh-hant: 所有容器的樣本視窗內的平均 CPU 使用率（以毫核為單位）。

The total CPU usage across all container.en: The total CPU usage across all containers in this Pod.
The total CPU usage across all container.id: Total penggunaan CPU di seluruh container di Pod ini.
The total CPU usage across all container.zh: 此 Pod 中所有容器的 CPU 使用总量。
The total CPU usage across all container.zh-hant: 此 Pod 中所有容器的 CPU 使用總量。

The total Java heap memory committed to.en: The total Java heap memory committed to be used.
The total Java heap memory committed to.id: Total memori heap Java yang dikomit untuk digunakan.
The total Java heap memory committed to.zh: 提交使用的 Java 堆内存总量。
The total Java heap memory committed to.zh-hant: 提交使用的 Java 堆記憶體總量。

The total Java heap memory used..en: The total Java heap memory used.
The total Java heap memory used..id: Total memori heap Java yang digunakan.
The total Java heap memory used..zh: 使用的 Java 堆内存总量。
The total Java heap memory used..zh-hant: 使用的 Java 堆記憶體總量。

The total Java non-heap memory committed.en: The total Java non-heap memory committed to be used.
The total Java non-heap memory committed.id: Total memori non-heap Java yang dikomit untuk digunakan.
The total Java non-heap memory committed.zh: 提交使用的 Java 非堆内存总量。
The total Java non-heap memory committed.zh-hant: 提交使用的 Java 非堆記憶體總量。

The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.en: The total Java non-heap memory used. Non-heap memory is calculated as follows: 'Metaspace' + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.id: Total memori non-heap Java yang digunakan. Memori non-heap dihitung sebagai berikut: 'Metaspace' + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.zh: 使用的 Java 非堆内存总量。非堆内存的计算方式如下：'Metaspace' + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.zh-hant: 使用的 Java 非堆記憶體總量。非堆疊記憶體的運算方式如下：'Metaspace' + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache

The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.en: The total Java non-heap memory used. Non-heap memory is: `Metaspace + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache`.
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.id: Total memori non-heap Java yang digunakan. Memori non-heap adalah: `Metaspace + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache`.
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.zh: 使用的 Java 非堆内存总量。非堆内存是：`Metaspace + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache`。
The total Java non-heap memory used. Non.zh-hant: 使用的 Java 非堆記憶體總量。非堆疊記憶體是：`Metaspace + CompressedClassSpace + CodeCache`。

The total RSS memory usage of all contai.en: The total RSS memory usage of all containers in this Pod, which is not supported by metrics-server.
The total RSS memory usage of all contai.id: Total penggunaan memori RSS dari semua container di Pod ini, yang tidak didukung oleh server metrik.
The total RSS memory usage of all contai.zh: 该 Pod 中所有容器的 RSS 内存使用总量，metrics-server 不支持。
The total RSS memory usage of all contai.zh-hant: 該 Pod 中所有容器的 RSS 記憶體使用總量，metrics-server 不支援。

The total SQL execution time, excluding.en: The total SQL execution time, excluding SCHEMA operations and BEGIN / COMMIT
The total SQL execution time, excluding.id: Total waktu eksekusi SQL, tidak termasuk operasi SCHEMA dan BEGIN/COMMIT
The total SQL execution time, excluding.zh: SQL 执行总时间，不包括 SCHEMA 操作和 BEGIN / COMMIT
The total SQL execution time, excluding.zh-hant: SQL 執行總時間，不包括 SCHEMA 運算和 BEGIN / COMMIT

The total amount of Flink managed memory.en: The total amount of Flink managed memory, in bytes.
The total amount of Flink managed memory.id: Jumlah total memori yang dikelola Flink, dalam byte.
The total amount of Flink managed memory.zh: Flink 托管内存总量，以字节为单位。
The total amount of Flink managed memory.zh-hant: Flink 託管記憶體總量，以位元組為單位。

The total amount of checkpoint processin.en: The total amount of checkpoint processing time spent synchronizing files to disk.
The total amount of checkpoint processin.id: Jumlah total waktu pemrosesan pos pemeriksaan yang dihabiskan untuk menyinkronkan file ke disk.
The total amount of checkpoint processin.zh: 将文件同步到磁盘所花费的检查点处理总时间。
The total amount of checkpoint processin.zh-hant: 將檔案同步到磁碟所花費的檢查點處理總時間。

The total amount of checkpoint processin.en: The total amount of checkpoint processing time spent writing files to disk.
The total amount of checkpoint processin.id: Jumlah total waktu pemrosesan pos pemeriksaan yang dihabiskan untuk menulis file ke disk.
The total amount of checkpoint processin.zh: 将文件写入磁盘所花费的检查点处理总时间。
The total amount of checkpoint processin.zh-hant: 將檔案寫入磁碟所花費的檢查點處理總時間。

The total amount of data read from the r.en: The total amount of data read from the replication sync source.
The total amount of data read from the r.id: Jumlah total data yang dibaca dari sumber sinkronisasi replikasi.
The total amount of data read from the r.zh: 从复制同步源读取的数据总量。
The total amount of data read from the r.zh-hant: 從複製同步來源讀取的資料總量。

The total amount of granted memory actua.en: The total amount of granted memory actually used (KB) (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total amount of granted memory actua.id: Jumlah total memori yang diberikan sebenarnya digunakan (KB) (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total amount of granted memory actua.zh: 实际使用的授予内存总量 (KB)（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total amount of granted memory actua.zh-hant: 實際使用的授予記憶體總量 (KB)（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total amount of memory granted (KB).en: The total amount of memory granted (KB) (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total amount of memory granted (KB).id: Jumlah total memori yang diberikan (KB) (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total amount of memory granted (KB).zh: 授予的内存总量 (KB)（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total amount of memory granted (KB).zh-hant: 授予的記憶體總量 (KB)（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total amount of memory on the host s.en: The total amount of memory on the host system, in bytes.
The total amount of memory on the host s.id: Jumlah total memori pada sistem host, dalam byte.
The total amount of memory on the host s.zh: 主机系统上的内存总量（以字节为单位）。
The total amount of memory on the host s.zh-hant: 主機系統上的記憶體總量（以位元組為單位）。

The total amount of memory that can be u.en: The total amount of memory that can be used by all user connections.
The total amount of memory that can be u.id: Jumlah total memori yang dapat digunakan oleh semua koneksi pengguna.
The total amount of memory that can be u.zh: 所有用户连接可以使用的内存总量。
The total amount of memory that can be u.zh-hant: 所有使用者連線可以使用的記憶體總量。

The total amount of memory that is guara.en: The total amount of memory that is guaranteed by the operating system as available for use by the Jenkins JVM, in bytes.
The total amount of memory that is guara.id: Jumlah total memori yang dijamin oleh sistem operasi tersedia untuk digunakan oleh Jenkins JVM, dalam byte.
The total amount of memory that is guara.zh: 操作系统保证可供 Jenkins JVM 使用的内存总量（以字节为单位）。
The total amount of memory that is guara.zh-hant: 作業系統保證可供 Jenkins JVM 使用的記憶體總量（以位元組為單位）。

The total amount of memory that the Jenk.en: The total amount of memory that the Jenkins JVM is currently using, in bytes.
The total amount of memory that the Jenk.id: Jumlah total memori yang digunakan Jenkins JVM saat ini, dalam byte.
The total amount of memory that the Jenk.zh: Jenkins JVM 当前使用的内存总量（以字节为单位）。
The total amount of memory that the Jenk.zh-hant: Jenkins JVM 目前使用的記憶體總量（以位元組為單位）。

The total amount of memory that the Redi.en: The total amount of memory that the Redis host has.
The total amount of memory that the Redi.id: Jumlah total memori yang dimiliki host Redis.
The total amount of memory that the Redi.zh: Redis 主机拥有的内存总量。
The total amount of memory that the Redi.zh-hant: Redis 主機擁有的記憶體總量。

The total amount of space allocated to c.en: The total amount of space allocated to collections in this database for document storage.
The total amount of space allocated to c.id: Jumlah total ruang yang dialokasikan pada koleksi di database ini untuk penyimpanan dokumen.
The total amount of space allocated to c.zh: 分配给该数据库中的集合用于文档存储的空间总量。
The total amount of space allocated to c.zh-hant: 指派給該資料庫中的集合用於文件儲存的空間總量。

The total amount of storage allocated to.en: The total amount of storage allocated to this collection for document storage.
The total amount of storage allocated to.id: Jumlah total penyimpanan yang dialokasikan pada koleksi ini untuk penyimpanan dokumen.
The total amount of storage allocated to.zh: 分配给该集合用于文档存储的存储总量。
The total amount of storage allocated to.zh-hant: 指派給該集合用於文件儲存的儲存總量。

The total amount of time in milliseconds.en: The total amount of time in milliseconds that worker threads have been processing messages. Useful for monitoring load via Bolt drivers in combination with other metrics.
The total amount of time in milliseconds.id: Jumlah total waktu dalam milidetik saat thread pekerja memproses pesan. Berguna untuk memantau beban melalui driver Bolt yang dikombinasikan dengan metrik lainnya.
The total amount of time in milliseconds.zh: 工作线程处理消息的总时间（以毫秒为单位）。对于通过 Bolt 驱动程序结合其他指标来监控负载非常有用。
The total amount of time in milliseconds.zh-hant: 工作執行緒處理訊息的總時間（以毫秒為單位）。對於透過 Bolt 驅動程式結合其他指標來監控負載非常有用。

The total amount of time in milliseconds.en: The total amount of time in milliseconds the mongod has spent applying operations from the oplog.
The total amount of time in milliseconds.id: Jumlah total waktu dalam milidetik yang dihabiskan mongod untuk menerapkan operasi dari oplog.
The total amount of time in milliseconds.zh: mongod 从 oplog 应用操作所花费的总时间（以毫秒为单位）。
The total amount of time in milliseconds.zh-hant: mongod 從 oplog 套用作業所花費的總時間（以毫秒為單位）。

The total amount of time required to col.en: The total amount of time required to collect data from getmore operations.
The total amount of time required to col.id: Jumlah total waktu yang diperlukan untuk mengumpulkan data dari operasi getmore.
The total amount of time required to col.zh: 从 getmore 操作收集数据所需的总时间。
The total amount of time required to col.zh-hant: 從 getmore 操作收集資料所需的總時間。

The total byte size of pending outgoing.en: The total byte size of pending outgoing messages in the queue.The queue is composed of multiple bounded channels associated with different peers. A size higher than the average baseline could indicate issues streaming messages to at least one peer. Use this metric together with send-queue-size, to have a fuller picture.
The total byte size of pending outgoing.id: Total ukuran byte pesan keluar yang tertunda dalam antrian. Antrian terdiri dari beberapa saluran terbatas yang terkait dengan rekan yang berbeda. Ukuran yang lebih tinggi dari garis dasar rata-rata dapat mengindikasikan masalah streaming pesan ke setidaknya satu rekan. Gunakan metrik ini bersama dengan ukuran antrian pengiriman, untuk mendapatkan gambaran yang lebih lengkap.
The total byte size of pending outgoing.zh: 队列中待处理传出消息的总字节大小。队列由与不同对等方关联的多个有界通道组成。高于平均基线的大小可能表明向至少一个对等方传输消息存在问题。将此指标与发送队列大小结合使用，以获得更全面的了解。
The total byte size of pending outgoing.zh-hant: 佇列中待處理傳出訊息的總位元組大小。隊列由與不同對等方關聯的多個有界通道組成。高於平均基線的大小可能表示向至少一個對等方傳輸訊息存在問題。將此指標與發送隊列大小結合使用，以獲得更全面的了解。

The total bytes of memory obtained from.en: The total bytes of memory obtained from the OS by the Go runtime.
The total bytes of memory obtained from.id: Total byte memori yang diperoleh dari OS pada runtime Go.
The total bytes of memory obtained from.zh: Go 运行时从操作系统获取的内存总字节数。
The total bytes of memory obtained from.zh-hant: Go 運行時從作業系統取得的記憶體總位元組數。

The total capacity (bytes) of the filesy.en: The total capacity (bytes) of the filesystems underlying storage.
The total capacity (bytes) of the filesy.id: Total kapasitas (byte) penyimpanan yang mendasari sistem file.
The total capacity (bytes) of the filesy.zh: 底层存储的文件系统的总容量（字节）。
The total capacity (bytes) of the filesy.zh-hant: 底層儲存的檔案系統的總容量（位元組）。

The total capacity of all buffers in the.en: The total capacity of all buffers in the direct buffer pool, in bytes.
The total capacity of all buffers in the.id: Kapasitas total semua buffer di kumpulan buffer langsung, dalam byte.
The total capacity of all buffers in the.zh: 直接缓冲池中所有缓冲区的总容量，以字节为单位。
The total capacity of all buffers in the.zh-hant: 直接緩衝池中所有緩衝區的總容量，以位元組為單位。

The total capacity of all buffers in the.en: The total capacity of all buffers in the mapped buffer pool, in bytes.
The total capacity of all buffers in the.id: Kapasitas total semua buffer di kumpulan buffer yang dipetakan, dalam byte.
The total capacity of all buffers in the.zh: 映射缓冲池中所有缓冲区的总容量（以字节为单位）。
The total capacity of all buffers in the.zh-hant: 映射緩衝池中所有緩衝區的總容量（以位元組為單位）。

The total combined size of all existing.en: The total combined size of all existing relay log files.
The total combined size of all existing.id: Total ukuran gabungan dari semua file log relai yang ada.
The total combined size of all existing.zh: 所有现有中继日志文件的总大小。
The total combined size of all existing.zh-hant: 所有现有中继日志文件的总大小。

The total count of executed queries per.en: The total count of executed queries per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of executed queries per.id: Jumlah total kueri yang dieksekusi per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of executed queries per.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构执行的查询总数（累积）。
The total count of executed queries per.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構執行的查詢總數（累積）。

The total count of full table scans on a.en: The total count of full table scans on a joined table per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of full table scans on a.id: Jumlah total pemindaian tabel penuh pada tabel gabungan per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of full table scans on a.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构对连接表进行全表扫描的总数（累积）。
The total count of full table scans on a.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構對連接表進行全表掃描的總數（累積）。

The total count of full table scans on t.en: The total count of full table scans on the first table per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of full table scans on t.id: Jumlah total pemindaian tabel penuh pada tabel pertama per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of full table scans on t.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构对第一个表的全表扫描总数（累积）。
The total count of full table scans on t.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構對第一個表的全表掃描總數（累積）。

The total count of queries run with an e.en: The total count of queries run with an error per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of queries run with an e.id: Jumlah total kueri yang dijalankan dengan kesalahan per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of queries run with an e.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构运行时出现错误的查询总数（累计）。
The total count of queries run with an e.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構執行時間出現錯誤的查詢總數（累計）。

The total count of queries which do not.en: The total count of queries which do not use an index per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of queries which do not.id: Jumlah total kueri yang tidak menggunakan indeks per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of queries which do not.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构不使用索引的查询总数（累积）。
The total count of queries which do not.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構不使用索引的查詢總數（累積）。

The total count of queries which used a.en: The total count of queries which used a sub-optimal index per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total count of queries which used a.id: Jumlah total kueri yang menggunakan indeks suboptimal per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total count of queries which used a.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构使用次优索引的查询总数（累积）。
The total count of queries which used a.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構使用次優索引的查詢總數（累積）。

The total count of successful backups ma.en: The total count of successful backups made for a database
The total count of successful backups ma.id: Jumlah total pencadangan yang berhasil dilakukan untuk database
The total count of successful backups ma.zh: 数据库成功备份的总数
The total count of successful backups ma.zh-hant: 資料庫成功備份的總數

The total degree of parallelism used (cu.en: The total degree of parallelism used (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total degree of parallelism used (cu.id: Tingkat total paralelisme yang digunakan (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total degree of parallelism used (cu.zh: 使用的总并行度（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total degree of parallelism used (cu.zh-hant: 使用的總平行度（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total disk size used by Analytics..en: The total disk size used by Analytics.
The total disk size used by Analytics..id: Total ukuran disk yang digunakan oleh Analytics.
The total disk size used by Analytics..zh: Analytics 使用的总磁盘大小。
The total disk size used by Analytics..zh-hant: Analytics 使用的總磁碟大小。

The total disk space used by indexes att.en: The total disk space used by indexes attached to the specified table.
The total disk space used by indexes att.id: Total ruang disk yang digunakan oleh indeks yang dilampirkan pada tabel tertentu.
The total disk space used by indexes att.zh: 附加到指定表的索引使用的总磁盘空间。
The total disk space used by indexes att.zh-hant: 附加到指定表的索引所使用的總磁碟空間。

The total disk space used by the specifi.en: The total disk space used by the specified table with TOAST data. Free space map and visibility map are not included.
The total disk space used by the specifi.id: Total ruang disk yang digunakan oleh tabel tertentu dengan data TOAST. Peta ruang bebas dan peta visibilitas tidak termasuk.
The total disk space used by the specifi.zh: 包含 TOAST 数据的指定表使用的总磁盘空间。不包括自由空间图和可见性图。
The total disk space used by the specifi.zh-hant: 包含 TOAST 資料的指定表所使用的總磁碟空間。不包括自由空間圖和可見性圖。

The total disk space used by the table,.en: The total disk space used by the table, including indexes and TOAST data.
The total disk space used by the table,.id: Total ruang disk yang digunakan oleh tabel, termasuk indeks dan data TOAST.
The total disk space used by the table,.zh: 表使用的总磁盘空间，包括索引和 TOAST 数据。
The total disk space used by the table,.zh-hant: 表使用的總磁碟空間，包括索引和 TOAST 資料。

The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.en: The total elapsed time (microseconds) for query executions (cumulative value from Oracle).
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.id: Total waktu yang berlalu (mikrodetik) untuk eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari Oracle).
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.zh: 查询执行所用的总时间（微秒）（来自 Oracle 的累积值）。
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.zh-hant: 查詢執行所花費的總時間（微秒）（來自 Oracle 的累積值）。

The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.en: The total elapsed time (microseconds) for query executions (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.id: Total waktu yang berlalu (mikrodetik) untuk eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.zh: 查询执行所用的总时间（微秒）（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total elapsed time (microseconds) fo.zh-hant: 查詢執行所花費的總時間（微秒）（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total elapsed time in milliseconds.en: The total elapsed time in milliseconds
The total elapsed time in milliseconds.id: Total waktu yang berlalu dalam milidetik
The total elapsed time in milliseconds.zh: 总经过时间（以毫秒为单位）
The total elapsed time in milliseconds.zh-hant: 總經過時間（以毫秒為單位）

The total ideal amount of memory (KB) th.en: The total ideal amount of memory (KB) that should have been granted (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total ideal amount of memory (KB) th.id: Total jumlah memori ideal (KB) yang seharusnya diberikan (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total ideal amount of memory (KB) th.zh: 应授予的理想内存总量 (KB)（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total ideal amount of memory (KB) th.zh-hant: 應授予的理想記憶體總量 (KB)（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total latency distributions of save.en: The total latency distributions of save called by snapshot.
The total latency distributions of save.id: Total distribusi latensi penyimpanan yang dipanggil oleh snapshot.
The total latency distributions of save.zh: 快照调用的保存的总延迟分布。
The total latency distributions of save.zh-hant: 快照呼叫的保存的總延遲分佈。

The total latency distributions of v3 sn.en: The total latency distributions of v3 snapshot save
The total latency distributions of v3 sn.id: Total distribusi latensi penyimpanan snapshot v3
The total latency distributions of v3 sn.zh: v3快照保存的总延迟分布
The total latency distributions of v3 sn.zh-hant: v3快照保存的總延遲分佈

The total latency of all web spans, corr.en: The total latency of all web spans, corresponding to the 'latency_count'
The total latency of all web spans, corr.id: Total latensi semua rentang web, sesuai dengan 'latency_count'
The total latency of all web spans, corr.zh: 所有网络跨度的总延迟，对应于“latency_count”
The total latency of all web spans, corr.zh-hant: 所有網路跨度的總延遲，對應於“latency_count”

The total memory capacity of the host ma.en: The total memory capacity of the host machine.

The total memory in the host machine (De.en: The total memory in the host machine (Deprecated use `mem_capacity`).
The total memory in the host machine (De.id: Total memori di mesin host (Tidak digunakan lagi menggunakan `mem_capacity`).
The total memory in the host machine (De.zh: 主机中的总内存（不推荐使用“mem_capacity”）。
The total memory in the host machine (De.zh-hant: 主機中的總記憶體（不建議使用“mem_capacity”）。

The total memory limit across all contai.en: The total memory limit across all containers in this Pod.  Note: This value is the sum of all container limit values, as Pods do not have a direct limit value.
The total memory limit across all contai.id: Batas total memori di seluruh container di Pod ini.  Catatan: Nilai ini merupakan jumlah dari seluruh nilai batas kontainer, karena Pod tidak mempunyai nilai batas langsung.
The total memory limit across all contai.zh: 此 Pod 中所有容器的总内存限制。  注意：该值是所有容器限制值的总和，因为 Pod 没有直接的限制值。
The total memory limit across all contai.zh-hant: 此 Pod 中所有容器的總記憶體限制。  注意：該值是所有容器限制值的總和，因為 Pod 沒有直接的限制值。

The total memory on the system host..en: The total memory on the system host.
The total memory on the system host..zh-hant: 系統主機上的總記憶體。

The total memory request across all cont.en: The total memory request across all containers in this Pod.  Note: This value is the sum of all container request values, as Pods do not have a direct request value.
The total memory request across all cont.id: Total permintaan memori di seluruh container di Pod ini.  Catatan: Nilai ini merupakan jumlah seluruh nilai permintaan kontainer, karena Pod tidak memiliki nilai permintaan langsung.
The total memory request across all cont.zh: 此 Pod 中所有容器的总内存请求。  注意：该值是所有容器请求值的总和，因为 Pod 没有直接请求值。
The total memory request across all cont.zh-hant: 此 Pod 中所有容器的總記憶體請求。  注意：該值是所有容器請求值的總和，因為 Pod 沒有直接請求值。

The total memory usage of all containers.en: The total memory usage of all containers in this Pod.
The total memory usage of all containers.id: Total penggunaan memori semua container di Pod ini.
The total memory usage of all containers.zh: 该 Pod 中所有容器的内存使用总量。
The total memory usage of all containers.zh-hant: 該 Pod 中所有容器的記憶體使用總量。

The total number of \"command\" event is.en: The total number of "command" event issues.

The total number of \"insert\" event iss.en: The total number of "insert" event issues.

The total number of \"queries\" event is.en: The total number of "queries" event issues.

The total number of \"readLock\" event i.en: The total number of "readLock" event issues.

The total number of \"remove\" event iss.en: The total number of "remove" event issues.

The total number of \"total\" event issu.en: The total number of "total" event issues.

The total number of \"update\" event iss.en: The total number of "update" event issues.

The total number of \"writeLock\" event.en: The total number of "writeLock" event issues.

The total number of 'runnable' threads,.en: The total number of 'runnable' threads, as the OS kernel scheduler seeing it.
The total number of 'runnable' threads,.id: Jumlah total thread yang 'dapat dijalankan', seperti yang dilihat oleh penjadwal kernel OS.
The total number of 'runnable' threads,.zh: 操作系统内核调度程序看到的“可运行”线程总数。
The total number of 'runnable' threads,.zh-hant: 作業系統核心調度程式看到的「可運行」執行緒總數。

The total number of Bolt connections clo.en: The total number of Bolt connections closed since startup. This includes both properly and abnormally ended connections. Useful for monitoring load via Bolt drivers in combination with other metrics.
The total number of Bolt connections clo.id: Jumlah total koneksi Bolt yang ditutup sejak pengaktifan. Ini termasuk koneksi yang berakhir dengan benar dan tidak normal. Berguna untuk memantau beban melalui driver Bolt yang dikombinasikan dengan metrik lainnya.
The total number of Bolt connections clo.zh: 自启动以来关闭的 Bolt 连接总数。这包括正确和异常结束的连接。对于通过 Bolt 驱动程序结合其他指标来监控负载非常有用。
The total number of Bolt connections clo.zh-hant: 自啟動以來關閉的 Bolt 連接總數。這包括正確和異常結束的連接。對於透過 Bolt 驅動程式結合其他指標來監控負載非常有用。

The total number of Bolt connections ope.en: The total number of Bolt connections opened since startup. This includes both succeeded and failed connections. Useful for monitoring load via the Bolt drivers in combination with other metrics.
The total number of Bolt connections ope.id: Jumlah total koneksi Bolt yang dibuka sejak startup. Ini mencakup koneksi yang berhasil dan gagal. Berguna untuk memantau beban melalui driver Bolt yang dikombinasikan dengan metrik lainnya.
The total number of Bolt connections ope.zh: 自启动以来打开的 Bolt 连接总数。这包括成功的连接和失败的连接。对于通过 Bolt 驱动程序结合其他指标来监控负载非常有用。
The total number of Bolt connections ope.zh-hant: 自啟動以來開啟的 Bolt 連接總數。這包括成功的連接和失敗的連接。對於透過 Bolt 驅動程式結合其他指標來監控負載非常有用。

The total number of Bolt connections tha.en: The total number of Bolt connections that are currently executing `Cypher` and returning results. Useful to track the overall load on Bolt connections. This is limited to the number of Bolt worker threads that have been configured via `dbms.connector.bolt.thread_pool_max_size`. Reaching this maximum indicated the server is running at capacity.
The total number of Bolt connections tha.id: Jumlah total koneksi Bolt yang saat ini menjalankan `Cypher` dan mengembalikan hasilnya. Berguna untuk melacak beban keseluruhan pada sambungan Bolt. Ini terbatas pada jumlah thread pekerja Bolt yang telah dikonfigurasi melalui `dbms.connector.bolt.thread_pool_max_size`. Mencapai maksimum ini menunjukkan server berjalan pada kapasitasnya.
The total number of Bolt connections tha.zh: 当前正在执行“Cypher”并返回结果的 Bolt 连接总数。可用于跟踪螺栓连接上的总体负载。这仅限于通过“dbms.connector.bolt.thread_pool_max_size”配置的 Bolt 工作线程数。达到此最大值表明服务器正在满负荷运行。
The total number of Bolt connections tha.zh-hant: 目前正在執行“Cypher”並傳回結果的 Bolt 連接總數。可用於追蹤螺栓連接上的整體負載。這僅限於透過「dbms.connector.bolt.thread_pool_max_size」配置的 Bolt 工作執行緒數。達到此最大值表示伺服器正在滿載運行。

The total number of Bolt connections tha.en: The total number of Bolt connections that are not currently executing `Cypher` or returning results.
The total number of Bolt connections tha.id: Jumlah total koneksi Bolt yang saat ini tidak menjalankan `Cypher` atau mengembalikan hasil.
The total number of Bolt connections tha.zh: 当前未执行“Cypher”或返回结果的 Bolt 连接总数。
The total number of Bolt connections tha.zh-hant: 目前未執行「Cypher」或傳回結果的 Bolt 連線總數。

The total number of Bolt messages that h.en: The total number of Bolt messages that have completed processing whether successfully or unsuccessfully. Useful for tracking overall load.
The total number of Bolt messages that h.id: Jumlah total pesan Bolt yang telah menyelesaikan pemrosesan, baik berhasil maupun tidak. Berguna untuk melacak beban keseluruhan.
The total number of Bolt messages that h.zh: 已完成处理（无论成功还是失败）的 Bolt 消息总数。对于跟踪总体负载很有用。
The total number of Bolt messages that h.zh-hant: 已完成處理（無論成功或失敗）的 Bolt 訊息總數。對於追蹤總體負載很有用。

The total number of CPUs on the node whe.en: The total number of CPUs on the node where the Pod is running.
The total number of CPUs on the node whe.id: Jumlah total CPU pada node dimana Pod sedang berjalan.
The total number of CPUs on the node whe.zh: 运行 Pod 的节点上的 CPU 总数。
The total number of CPUs on the node whe.zh-hant: 運行 Pod 的節點上的 CPU 總數。

The total number of Go routines..en: The total number of Go routines.

The total number of HTTP requests in a c.en: The total number of HTTP requests in a collection cycle
The total number of HTTP requests in a c.id: Jumlah total permintaan HTTP dalam satu siklus pengumpulan
The total number of HTTP requests in a c.zh: 一个采集周期内HTTP请求总数
The total number of HTTP requests in a c.zh-hant: 一個採集週期內HTTP請求總數

The total number of HTTP requests served.en: The total number of HTTP requests served.
The total number of HTTP requests served.id: Jumlah total permintaan HTTP yang dilayani.
The total number of HTTP requests served.zh: 服务的 HTTP 请求总数。
The total number of HTTP requests served.zh-hant: 服務的 HTTP 請求總數。

The total number of IO operations perfor.en: The total number of IO operations performed by page cache.
The total number of IO operations perfor.id: Jumlah total operasi IO yang dilakukan oleh cache halaman.
The total number of IO operations perfor.zh: 页缓存执行的 IO 操作总数。
The total number of IO operations perfor.zh-hant: 頁面快取執行的 IO 操作總數。

The total number of Raft in-flight cache.en: The total number of Raft in-flight cache lookups that missed the cache.
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.id: Jumlah total pencarian cache dalam penerbangan Raft yang melewatkan cache.
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.zh: 错过缓存的 Raft 进行中缓存查找总数。
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.zh-hant: 錯過緩存的 Raft 進行中緩存查找總數。

The total number of Raft in-flight cache.en: The total number of Raft in-flight cache lookups that were served from cache.
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.id: Jumlah total pencarian cache dalam penerbangan Raft yang disajikan dari cache.
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.zh: 从缓存提供的 Raft 运行中缓存查找总数。
The total number of Raft in-flight cache.zh-hant: 從緩存提供的 Raft 運行中緩存查找總數。

The total number of Raft replication att.en: The total number of Raft replication attempts that have failed.
The total number of Raft replication att.id: Jumlah total upaya replikasi Rakit yang gagal.
The total number of Raft replication att.zh: 失败的 Raft 复制尝试总数。
The total number of Raft replication att.zh-hant: 失敗的 Raft 複製嘗試總數。

The total number of Raft replication att.en: The total number of Raft replication attempts whose outcome remained uncertain.
The total number of Raft replication att.id: Jumlah total upaya replikasi Rakit yang hasilnya masih belum pasti.
The total number of Raft replication att.zh: 结果仍不确定的 Raft 复制尝试总数。
The total number of Raft replication att.zh-hant: 結果仍不確定的 Raft 複製嘗試總數。

The total number of Raft replication req.en: The total number of Raft replication requests attempts. It is bigger or equal to the replication requests.
The total number of Raft replication req.id: Jumlah total upaya permintaan replikasi Raft. Ini lebih besar atau sama dengan permintaan replikasi.
The total number of Raft replication req.zh: Raft 复制请求尝试的总数。它大于或等于复制请求。
The total number of Raft replication req.zh-hant: Raft 複製請求嘗試的總數。它大於或等於複製請求。

The total number of Raft replication req.en: The total number of Raft replication requests that have succeeded.
The total number of Raft replication req.id: Jumlah total permintaan replikasi Raft yang berhasil.
The total number of Raft replication req.zh: 已成功的 Raft 复制请求总数。
The total number of Raft replication req.zh-hant: 已成功的 Raft 複製請求總數。

The total number of Raft replication req.en: The total number of Raft replication requests. It increases with write transactions (possibly internal) activity.
The total number of Raft replication req.id: Jumlah total permintaan replikasi Rakit. Ini meningkat dengan aktivitas transaksi tulis (mungkin internal).
The total number of Raft replication req.zh: Raft 复制请求总数。它随着写入事务（可能是内部）活动而增加。
The total number of Raft replication req.zh-hant: Raft 複製請求總數。它隨著寫入事務（可能是內部）活動而增加。

The total number of TSM full compactions.en: The total number of TSM full compactions that have ever run.
The total number of TSM full compactions.id: Jumlah total pemadatan penuh TSM yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of TSM full compactions.zh: 曾经运行过的 TSM 完全压缩总数。
The total number of TSM full compactions.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的 TSM 完全壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM full compactions.en: The total number of TSM full compactions that have failed due to errors.
The total number of TSM full compactions.id: Jumlah total pemadatan penuh TSM yang gagal karena kesalahan.
The total number of TSM full compactions.zh: 由于错误而失败的 TSM 完全压缩总数。
The total number of TSM full compactions.zh-hant: 由於錯誤而失敗的 TSM 完全壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.en: The total number of TSM level 1 compactions that have ever run.
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.id: Jumlah total pemadatan TSM level 1 yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.zh: 曾经运行过的 TSM 1 级压缩总数。
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的 TSM 1 級壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.en: The total number of TSM level 1 compactions that have failed due to errors.
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.id: Jumlah total pemadatan TSM level 1 yang gagal karena kesalahan.
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.zh: 由于错误而失败的 TSM 1 级压缩总数。
The total number of TSM level 1 compacti.zh-hant: 由於錯誤而失敗的 TSM 1 級壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM level 2 compacti.en: The total number of TSM level 2 compactions that have ever run.
The total number of TSM level 2 compacti.id: Jumlah total pemadatan TSM level 2 yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of TSM level 2 compacti.zh: 曾经运行过的 TSM 2 级压缩总数。
The total number of TSM level 2 compacti.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的 TSM 2 級壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM level 3 compacti.en: The total number of TSM level 3 compactions that have ever run.
The total number of TSM level 3 compacti.id: Jumlah total pemadatan TSM level 3 yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of TSM level 3 compacti.zh: 曾经运行过的 TSM 3 级压缩总数。
The total number of TSM level 3 compacti.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的 TSM 3 級壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM optimize compact.en: The total number of TSM optimize compactions that have ever run.
The total number of TSM optimize compact.id: Jumlah total pemadatan optimalisasi TSM yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of TSM optimize compact.zh: 曾经运行过的 TSM 优化压缩总数。
The total number of TSM optimize compact.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的 TSM 優化壓縮總數。

The total number of TSM optimize compact.en: The total number of TSM optimize compactions that have failed due to errors.
The total number of TSM optimize compact.id: Jumlah total pemadatan optimalisasi TSM yang gagal karena kesalahan.
The total number of TSM optimize compact.zh: 由于错误而失败的 TSM 优化压缩总数。
The total number of TSM optimize compact.zh-hant: 由於錯誤而失敗的 TSM 優化壓縮總數。

The total number of `fulltext` index pop.en: The total number of `fulltext` index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of `fulltext` index pop.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks `teks lengkap` yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of `fulltext` index pop.zh: 已完成的“全文”索引填充作业总数。
The total number of `fulltext` index pop.zh-hant: 已完成的「全文」索引填入作業總數。

The total number of `getMore` operations.en: The total number of `getMore` operations since the mongod instance last started. This counter can be high even if the query count is low. Secondary nodes send `getMore` operations as part of the replication process.
The total number of `getMore` operations.id: Jumlah total operasi `getMore` sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai. Penghitung ini bisa tinggi meskipun jumlah kuerinya rendah. Node sekunder mengirimkan operasi `getMore` sebagai bagian dari proses replikasi.
The total number of `getMore` operations.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来“getMore”操作的总数。即使查询计数较低，该计数器也可能很高。辅助节点发送“getMore”操作作为复制过程的一部分。
The total number of `getMore` operations.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來「getMore」操作的總數。即使查詢計數較低，該計數器也可能很高。輔助節點發送“getMore”操作作為複製過程的一部分。

The total number of `getmore` event issu.en: The total number of `getmore` event issues.

The total number of `inodes` on the volu.en: The total number of `inodes` on the volume where ClickHouse logs path is mounted.
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.id: Jumlah total `inode` pada volume tempat jalur log ClickHouse dipasang.
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.zh: 挂载 ClickHouse 日志路径的卷上“inode”的总数。
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.zh-hant: 掛載 ClickHouse 日誌路徑的磁碟區上「inode」的總數。

The total number of `inodes` on the volu.en: The total number of `inodes` on the volume where the main ClickHouse path is mounted. If it is less than 25 million, it indicates a misconfiguration.
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.id: Jumlah total `inode` pada volume tempat jalur utama ClickHouse dipasang. Jika kurang dari 25 juta, berarti ada kesalahan konfigurasi.
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.zh: 挂载主 ClickHouse 路径的卷上“inode”的总数。如果小于2500万，则表明配置错误。
The total number of `inodes` on the volu.zh-hant: 掛載主 ClickHouse 路徑的磁碟區上「inode」的總數。如果小於2500萬，則表示配置錯誤。

The total number of batches applied acro.en: The total number of batches applied across all databases.
The total number of batches applied acro.id: Jumlah total batch yang diterapkan di semua database.
The total number of batches applied acro.zh: 跨所有数据库应用的批次总数。
The total number of batches applied acro.zh-hant: 跨所有資料庫應用的批次總數。

The total number of batches of points re.en: The total number of batches of points requested to be written to this node.
The total number of batches of points re.id: Jumlah total kumpulan poin yang diminta untuk ditulis ke node ini.
The total number of batches of points re.zh: 请求写入此节点的点批次总数。
The total number of batches of points re.zh-hant: 請求寫入此節點的點批次總數。

The total number of batches of points th.en: The total number of batches of points that failed to be sent to the subscription dispatcher.
The total number of batches of points th.id: Jumlah total kumpulan poin yang gagal dikirim ke operator berlangganan.
The total number of batches of points th.zh: 未能发送到订阅调度程序的点的批次总数。
The total number of batches of points th.zh-hant: 未能傳送到訂閱調度程序的點的批次總數。

The total number of batches of points th.en: The total number of batches of points that were not successfully written, due to a failure to write to a local or remote shard.
The total number of batches of points th.id: Jumlah total kumpulan poin yang tidak berhasil ditulis, karena kegagalan menulis ke pecahan lokal atau jarak jauh.
The total number of batches of points th.zh: 由于无法写入本地或远程分片而未成功写入的点批次总数。
The total number of batches of points th.zh-hant: 由於無法寫入本機或遠端分片而未成功寫入的點批次總數。

The total number of batches of points th.en: The total number of batches of points that were successfully sent to the subscription dispatcher.
The total number of batches of points th.id: Jumlah total kumpulan poin yang berhasil dikirim ke operator langganan.
The total number of batches of points th.zh: 成功发送到订阅调度程序的点批次总数。
The total number of batches of points th.zh-hant: 成功傳送到訂閱排程器的點批次總數。

The total number of batches of points wr.en: The total number of batches of points written at the requested consistency level.
The total number of batches of points wr.id: Jumlah total kumpulan poin yang ditulis pada tingkat konsistensi yang diminta.
The total number of batches of points wr.zh: 以请求的一致性级别写入的点批次总数。
The total number of batches of points wr.zh-hant: 以請求的一致性等級寫入的點批次總數。

The total number of batches that failed.en: The total number of batches that failed to be written to subscribers.
The total number of batches that failed.id: Jumlah total batch yang gagal ditulis ke pelanggan.
The total number of batches that failed.zh: 未能写入订阅者的批次总数。
The total number of batches that failed.zh-hant: 未能寫入訂閱者的批次總數。

The total number of blocks in the query.en: The total number of blocks in the query cache.
The total number of blocks in the query.id: Jumlah total blok dalam cache kueri.
The total number of blocks in the query.zh-hant: 查詢快取中的區塊總數。

The total number of buffer gets (cumulat.en: The total number of buffer gets (cumulative value from Oracle).
The total number of buffer gets (cumulat.id: Jumlah total buffer yang didapat (nilai kumulatif dari Oracle).
The total number of buffer gets (cumulat.zh: 缓冲区获取总数（来自 Oracle 的累积值）。
The total number of buffer gets (cumulat.zh-hant: 緩衝區取得總數（來自 Oracle 的累積值）。

The total number of bytes appended to th.en: The total number of bytes appended to the transaction log.
The total number of bytes appended to th.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditambahkan ke log transaksi.
The total number of bytes appended to th.zh: 附加到事务日志的总字节数。
The total number of bytes appended to th.zh-hant: 附加到交易日誌的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes flushed during.en: The total number of bytes flushed during the most recent checkpoint event.
The total number of bytes flushed during.id: Jumlah total byte yang dihapus selama peristiwa pos pemeriksaan terbaru.
The total number of bytes flushed during.zh: 最近检查点事件期间刷新的总字节数。
The total number of bytes flushed during.zh-hant: 最近檢查點事件期間刷新的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes in the InnoDB.en: The total number of bytes in the InnoDB buffer pool containing data. The number includes both dirty and clean pages.
The total number of bytes in the InnoDB.id: Jumlah total byte di kumpulan buffer InnoDB yang berisi data. Jumlah tersebut mencakup halaman kotor dan halaman bersih.
The total number of bytes in the InnoDB.zh: InnoDB 缓冲池中包含数据的总字节数。该数量包括脏页和干净页。
The total number of bytes in the InnoDB.zh-hant: InnoDB 緩衝池中包含資料的總位元組數。此數量包括髒頁和乾淨頁。

The total number of bytes in the WiredTi.en: The total number of bytes in the WiredTiger cache that are tracked as dirty.
The total number of bytes in the WiredTi.id: Jumlah total byte dalam cache WiredTiger yang dilacak sebagai kotor.
The total number of bytes in the WiredTi.zh: WiredTiger 缓存中被跟踪为脏的字节总数。
The total number of bytes in the WiredTi.zh-hant: WiredTiger 快取中被追蹤為髒的位元組總數。

The total number of bytes of line protoc.en: The total number of bytes of line protocol data received by write requests, using the HTTP /write endpoint.
The total number of bytes of line protoc.id: Jumlah total byte data protokol jalur yang diterima oleh permintaan tulis, menggunakan titik akhir HTTP /write.
The total number of bytes of line protoc.zh: 使用 HTTP /write 端点通过写入请求接收的线路协议数据的总字节数。
The total number of bytes of line protoc.zh-hant: 使用 HTTP /write 端點透過寫入請求接收的線路協定資料的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes of memory obta.en: The total number of bytes of memory obtained from the stack in use.
The total number of bytes of memory obta.id: Jumlah total byte memori yang diperoleh dari tumpukan yang digunakan.
The total number of bytes of memory obta.zh: 从正在使用的堆栈中获取的内存总字节数。
The total number of bytes of memory obta.zh-hant: 從正在使用的堆疊中取得的記憶體總位元組數。

The total number of bytes output to port.en: The total number of bytes output to ports.
The total number of bytes output to port.id: Jumlah total output byte ke port.
The total number of bytes output to port.zh: 输出到端口的总字节数。
The total number of bytes output to port.zh-hant: 輸出到連接埠的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes read by the pa.en: The total number of bytes read by the page cache.
The total number of bytes read by the pa.id: Jumlah total byte yang dibaca oleh cache halaman.
The total number of bytes read by the pa.zh: 页缓存读取的总字节数。
The total number of bytes read by the pa.zh-hant: 頁快取讀取的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes read from the.en: The total number of bytes read from the network for replication purposes.
The total number of bytes read from the.id: Jumlah total byte yang dibaca dari jaringan untuk tujuan replikasi.
The total number of bytes read from the.zh: 出于复制目的从网络读取的总字节数。
The total number of bytes read from the.zh-hant: 出於複製目的從網路讀取的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes read from the.en: The total number of bytes read from the network.
