The total number of bytes read from the.id: Jumlah total byte yang dibaca dari jaringan.
The total number of bytes read from the.zh: 从网络读取的总字节数。
The total number of bytes read from the.zh-hant: 從網路讀取的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes read into the.en: The total number of bytes read into the WiredTiger cache.
The total number of bytes read into the.id: Jumlah total byte yang dibaca ke dalam cache WiredTiger.
The total number of bytes read into the.zh: 读入 WiredTiger 缓存的总字节数。
The total number of bytes read into the.zh-hant: 讀入 WiredTiger 快取的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes received from.en: The total number of bytes received from grpc clients.
The total number of bytes received from.id: Jumlah total byte yang diterima dari klien grpc.
The total number of bytes received from.zh: 从 grpc 客户端接收的字节总数。
The total number of bytes received from.zh-hant: 從 grpc 用戶端接收的位元組總數。

The total number of bytes received from.en: The total number of bytes received from peers.
The total number of bytes received from.id: Jumlah total byte yang diterima dari rekan-rekan.
The total number of bytes received from.zh: 从对等方接收的字节总数。
The total number of bytes received from.zh-hant: 從對等方接收的位元組總數。

The total number of bytes received throu.en: The total number of bytes received through ports.
The total number of bytes received throu.id: Jumlah total byte yang diterima melalui port.
The total number of bytes received throu.zh: 通过端口接收的总字节数。
The total number of bytes received throu.zh-hant: 透過連接埠接收的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes returned in qu.en: The total number of bytes returned in query responses.
The total number of bytes returned in qu.id: Jumlah total byte yang dikembalikan dalam respons kueri.
The total number of bytes returned in qu.zh: 查询响应中返回的总字节数。
The total number of bytes returned in qu.zh-hant: 查詢回應中傳回的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes sent to grpc c.en: The total number of bytes sent to grpc clients.
The total number of bytes sent to grpc c.id: Jumlah total byte yang dikirim ke klien grpc.
The total number of bytes sent to grpc c.zh: 发送到 grpc 客户端的总字节数。
The total number of bytes sent to grpc c.zh-hant: 傳送到 grpc 客戶端的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes sent to peers..en: The total number of bytes sent to peers.
The total number of bytes sent to peers..id: Jumlah total byte yang dikirim ke rekan-rekan.
The total number of bytes sent to peers..zh: 发送到对等方的总字节数。
The total number of bytes sent to peers..zh-hant: 發送到對等方的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes that have been.en: The total number of bytes that have been written into snapshots.
The total number of bytes that have been.id: Jumlah total byte yang telah ditulis ke dalam snapshot.
The total number of bytes that have been.zh: 已写入快照的总字节数。
The total number of bytes that have been.zh-hant: 已寫入快照的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes that the serve.en: The total number of bytes that the server has received over network connections initiated by clients or other mongod instances.
The total number of bytes that the serve.id: Jumlah total byte yang diterima server melalui koneksi jaringan yang dimulai oleh klien atau instance mongod lainnya.
The total number of bytes that the serve.zh: 服务器通过客户端或其他 mongod 实例发起的网络连接接收到的总字节数。
The total number of bytes that the serve.zh-hant: 伺服器透過客戶端或其他 mongod 實例發起的網路連線接收到的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes that the serve.en: The total number of bytes that the server has sent over network connections initiated by clients or other mongod instances.
The total number of bytes that the serve.id: Jumlah total byte yang dikirim server melalui koneksi jaringan yang diinisiasi oleh klien atau instance mongod lainnya.
The total number of bytes that the serve.zh: 服务器通过客户端或其他 mongod 实例发起的网络连接发送的总字节数。
The total number of bytes that the serve.zh-hant: 伺服器透過客戶端或其他 mongod 實例發起的網路連線發送的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes written by the.en: The total number of bytes written by the page cache.
The total number of bytes written by the.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditulis oleh cache halaman.
The total number of bytes written by the.zh: 页缓存写入的总字节数。
The total number of bytes written by the.zh-hant: 頁快取寫入的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes written from t.en: The total number of bytes written from the WiredTiger cache.
The total number of bytes written from t.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditulis dari cache WiredTiger.
The total number of bytes written from t.zh: 从 WiredTiger 缓存写入的总字节数。
The total number of bytes written from t.zh-hant: 從 WiredTiger 快取寫入的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes written to the.en: The total number of bytes written to the network for replication purposes.
The total number of bytes written to the.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditulis ke jaringan untuk tujuan replikasi.
The total number of bytes written to the.zh: 出于复制目的写入网络的总字节数。
The total number of bytes written to the.zh-hant: 出於複製目的寫入網路的總位元組數。

The total number of bytes written to the.en: The total number of bytes written to the network.
The total number of bytes written to the.id: Jumlah total byte yang ditulis ke jaringan.
The total number of bytes written to the.zh-hant: 寫入網路的總位元組數。

The total number of cache compactions th.en: The total number of cache compactions that have ever run.
The total number of cache compactions th.id: Jumlah total pemadatan cache yang pernah dijalankan.
The total number of cache compactions th.zh: 曾经运行过的缓存压缩总数。
The total number of cache compactions th.zh-hant: 曾經運行過的緩存壓縮總數。

The total number of canceled page faults.en: The total number of canceled page faults happened in the page cache.
The total number of canceled page faults.id: Jumlah total kesalahan halaman yang dibatalkan terjadi di cache halaman.
The total number of canceled page faults.zh: 页面缓存中发生的已取消页面错误总数。
The total number of canceled page faults.zh-hant: 頁面快取中發生的已取消頁面錯誤總數。

The total number of cases where a pusher.en: The total number of cases where a pusher waited more than the excessive wait threshold.
The total number of cases where a pusher.id: Jumlah total kasus dimana pendorong menunggu lebih dari ambang batas tunggu yang berlebihan.
The total number of cases where a pusher.zh: 推送者等待时间超过过度等待阈值的案例总数。
The total number of cases where a pusher.zh-hant: 推送者等待時間超過過度等待閾值的案例總數。

The total number of checkpoint events ex.en: The total number of checkpoint events executed so far.
The total number of checkpoint events ex.id: Jumlah total peristiwa pos pemeriksaan yang dilaksanakan sejauh ini.
The total number of checkpoint events ex.zh: 到目前为止执行的检查点事件总数。
The total number of checkpoint events ex.zh-hant: 到目前為止執行的檢查點事件總數。

The total number of classes loaded since.en: The total number of classes loaded since the start of the JVM.
The total number of classes loaded since.id: Jumlah total kelas yang dimuat sejak awal JVM.
The total number of classes loaded since.zh: 自 JVM 启动以来加载的类总数。
The total number of classes loaded since.zh-hant: 自 JVM 啟動以來載入的類別總數。

The total number of classes unloaded sin.en: The total number of classes unloaded since the Java virtual machine has started execution
The total number of classes unloaded sin.id: Jumlah total kelas yang dibongkar sejak mesin virtual Java mulai dieksekusi
The total number of classes unloaded sin.zh: 自Java虚拟机开始执行以来卸载的类总数
The total number of classes unloaded sin.zh-hant: 自Java虛擬機器開始執行以來卸載的類別總數

The total number of classes unloaded sin.en: The total number of classes unloaded since the start of the JVM.
The total number of classes unloaded sin.id: Jumlah total kelas yang dibongkar sejak dimulainya JVM.
The total number of classes unloaded sin.zh: 自 JVM 启动以来卸载的类总数。
The total number of classes unloaded sin.zh-hant: 自 JVM 啟動以來卸載的類別總數。

The total number of client requests per.en: The total number of client requests per client version.
The total number of client requests per.id: Jumlah total permintaan klien per versi klien.
The total number of client requests per.zh: 每个客户端版本的客户端请求总数。
The total number of client requests per.zh-hant: 每個客戶端版本的客戶端請求總數。

The total number of collections that hav.en: The total number of collections that have occurred.
The total number of collections that hav.id: Jumlah total koleksi yang telah terjadi.

The total number of column-organized tab.en: The total number of column-organized table data pages read from the table space containers for temporary, regular, and large table spaces.
The total number of column-organized tab.id: Jumlah total halaman data tabel yang disusun kolom yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The total number of column-organized tab.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的表空间容器中读取的按列组织的表数据页的总数。
The total number of column-organized tab.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的表空間容器中讀取的按列組織的表資料頁的總數。

The total number of columnstore segments.en: The total number of columnstore segments read (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of columnstore segments.id: Jumlah total segmen penyimpan kolom yang dibaca (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of columnstore segments.zh: 读取的列存储段总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of columnstore segments.zh-hant: 讀取的資料列儲存段總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of columnstore segments.en: The total number of columnstore segments skipped (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of columnstore segments.id: Jumlah total segmen penyimpan kolom yang dilewati (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of columnstore segments.zh: 跳过的列存储段总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of columnstore segments.zh-hant: 跳過的資料列儲存段總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of commands issued to t.en: The total number of commands issued to the database since the mongod instance last started. `opcounters.command` counts all commands except the write commands: insert, update, and delete.
The total number of commands issued to t.id: Jumlah total perintah yang dikeluarkan ke database sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai. `opcounters.command` menghitung semua perintah kecuali perintah tulis: masukkan, perbarui, dan hapus.
The total number of commands issued to t.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来向数据库发出的命令总数。 `opcounters.command` 对除写入命令之外的所有命令进行计数：插入、更新和删除。
The total number of commands issued to t.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來向資料庫發出的命令總數。 `opcounters.command` 對除寫入命令之外的所有命令進行計數：插入、更新和刪除。

The total number of committed read trans.en: The total number of committed read transactions. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate high read load.
The total number of committed read trans.id: Jumlah total transaksi baca yang dilakukan. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan beban baca yang tinggi.
The total number of committed read trans.zh: 已提交的读取事务总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明读取负载较高。
The total number of committed read trans.zh-hant: 已提交的讀取事務總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。峰值或大幅增加表示讀取負載較高。

The total number of committed transactio.en: The total number of committed transactions. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads or just high read load.
The total number of committed transactio.id: Jumlah total transaksi yang dilakukan. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan beban data yang besar atau hanya beban baca yang tinggi.
The total number of committed transactio.zh: 已提交事务的总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表示数据负载较大或读取负载较高。
The total number of committed transactio.zh-hant: 已提交交易的總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。峰值或大幅增加表示資料負載較大或讀取負載較高。

The total number of committed write tran.en: The total number of committed write transactions. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads, which could correspond with some behavior you are investigating.
The total number of committed write tran.id: Jumlah total transaksi tulis yang dilakukan. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan muatan data yang besar, yang mungkin berhubungan dengan beberapa perilaku yang Anda selidiki.
The total number of committed write tran.zh: 已提交的写入事务总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明数据负载较大，这可能与您正在调查的某些行为相对应。
The total number of committed write tran.zh-hant: 已提交的寫入交易總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。尖峰或大幅增加表示資料負載較大，這可能與您正在調查的某些行為相對應。

The total number of connections to the d.en: The total number of connections to the database since the first connect, activate, or last reset (coordinator agents).
The total number of connections to the d.id: Jumlah total koneksi ke database sejak koneksi pertama, aktivasi, atau reset terakhir (agen koordinator).
The total number of connections to the d.zh: 自第一次连接、激活或上次重置（协调器代理）以来到数据库的连接总数。
The total number of connections to the d.zh-hant: 自第一次連接、啟動或上次重置（協調器代理）以來到資料庫的連接總數。

The total number of consensus proposals.en: The total number of consensus proposals applied.
The total number of consensus proposals.id: Jumlah total proposal konsensus yang diterapkan.

The total number of consensus proposals.en: The total number of consensus proposals committed.
The total number of consensus proposals.id: Jumlah total proposal konsensus yang disepakati.
The total number of consensus proposals.zh: 已提交的共识提案总数。
The total number of consensus proposals.zh-hant: 已提交的共識提案總數。

The total number of continuous queries t.en: The total number of continuous queries that executed but failed.
The total number of continuous queries t.id: Jumlah total kueri berkelanjutan yang dijalankan namun gagal.
The total number of continuous queries t.zh: 已执行但失败的连续查询总数。
The total number of continuous queries t.zh-hant: 已執行但失敗的連續查詢總數。

The total number of continuous queries t.en: The total number of continuous queries that executed successfully.
The total number of continuous queries t.id: Jumlah total kueri berkelanjutan yang berhasil dijalankan.
The total number of continuous queries t.zh: 成功执行的连续查询总数。
The total number of continuous queries t.zh-hant: 成功執行的連續查詢總數。

The total number of cooperative page evi.en: The total number of cooperative page evictions executed by the page cache due to low available pages.
The total number of cooperative page evi.id: Jumlah total penggusuran halaman kooperatif yang dilakukan oleh cache halaman karena rendahnya halaman yang tersedia.
The total number of cooperative page evi.zh: 由于可用页面较少而由页面缓存执行的协作页面驱逐的总数。
The total number of cooperative page evi.zh-hant: 由於可用頁面較少而由頁面快取執行的協作頁面驅逐的總數。

The total number of cursors that have ti.en: The total number of cursors that have timed out since the server process started. If this number is large or growing at a regular rate, this may indicate an application error.
The total number of cursors that have ti.id: Jumlah total kursor yang waktunya habis sejak proses server dimulai. Jika jumlah ini besar atau bertambah secara teratur, ini mungkin menunjukkan kesalahan aplikasi.
The total number of cursors that have ti.zh: 自服务器进程启动以来已超时的游标总数。如果该数字很大或以正常速度增长，则可能表明存在应用程序错误。
The total number of cursors that have ti.zh-hant: 自伺服器進程啟動以來已逾時的遊標總數。如果該數字很大或以正常速度增長，則可能表示存在應用程式錯誤。

The total number of data pages for XML s.en: The total number of data pages for XML storage objects (XDAs) read from the table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The total number of data pages for XML s.id: Jumlah total halaman data untuk objek penyimpanan XML (XDA) yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The total number of data pages for XML s.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的表空间容器中读取的 XML 存储对象 (XDA) 的数据页总数。
The total number of data pages for XML s.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的表空間容器中讀取的 XML 儲存物件 (XDA) 的資料頁總數。

The total number of data pages read from.en: The total number of data pages read from the table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The total number of data pages read from.id: Jumlah total halaman data yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The total number of data pages read from.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的表空间容器中读取的数据页总数。
The total number of data pages read from.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的表空間容器中讀取的資料頁總數。

The total number of deadlocks that have.en: The total number of deadlocks that have occurred.

The total number of delete operations si.en: The total number of delete operations since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of delete operations si.id: Jumlah total operasi penghapusan sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of delete operations si.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来删除操作的总数。
The total number of delete operations si.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來刪除操作的總數。

The total number of different property n.en: The total number of different property names used in the database. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads, which could correspond with some behavior you are investigating.
The total number of different property n.id: Jumlah total nama properti berbeda yang digunakan dalam database. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan muatan data yang besar, yang mungkin berhubungan dengan beberapa perilaku yang Anda selidiki.
The total number of different property n.zh: 数据库中使用的不同属性名称的总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明数据负载较大，这可能与您正在调查的某些行为相对应。
The total number of different property n.zh-hant: 資料庫中使用的不同屬性名稱的總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。尖峰或大幅增加表示資料負載較大，這可能與您正在調查的某些行為相對應。

The total number of different relationsh.en: The total number of different relationship types stored in the database. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads, which could correspond with some behavior you are investigating.
The total number of different relationsh.id: Jumlah total tipe hubungan berbeda yang disimpan dalam database. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan muatan data yang besar, yang mungkin berhubungan dengan beberapa perilaku yang Anda selidiki.
The total number of different relationsh.zh: 数据库中存储的不同关系类型的总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明数据负载较大，这可能与您正在调查的某些行为相对应。
The total number of different relationsh.zh-hant: 資料庫中儲存的不同關係類型的總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。尖峰或大幅增加表示資料負載較大，這可能與您正在調查的某些行為相對應。

The total number of disconnected peers..en: The total number of disconnected peers.
The total number of disconnected peers..zh: 断开连接的对等点总数。
The total number of disconnected peers..zh-hant: 斷開連接的對等點總數。

The total number of documents deleted fr.en: The total number of documents deleted from collections with a ttl index.
The total number of documents deleted fr.id: Jumlah total dokumen yang dihapus dari koleksi dengan indeks ttl.
The total number of documents deleted fr.zh: 从具有 ttl 索引的集合中删除的文档总数。
The total number of documents deleted fr.zh-hant: 從具有 ttl 索引的集合中刪除的文檔總數。

The total number of documents deleted..en: The total number of documents deleted.

The total number of documents inserted..en: The total number of documents inserted.

The total number of documents returned b.en: The total number of documents returned by queries.
The total number of documents returned b.id: Jumlah total dokumen yang dikembalikan oleh kueri.

The total number of documents updated..en: The total number of documents updated.

The total number of every point requeste.en: The total number of every point requested to be written to this data node.
The total number of every point requeste.id: Jumlah total setiap titik yang diminta untuk ditulis ke node data ini.
The total number of every point requeste.zh: 请求写入该数据节点的每个点的总数。
The total number of every point requeste.zh-hant: 請求寫入該資料節點的每個點的總數。

The total number of exceptions seen duri.en: The total number of exceptions seen during the eviction process in the page cache.
The total number of exceptions seen duri.id: Jumlah total pengecualian yang terlihat selama proses penggusuran di cache halaman.
The total number of exceptions seen duri.zh: 页面缓存中驱逐过程中出现的异常总数。
The total number of exceptions seen duri.zh-hant: 頁面快取中驅逐過程中出現的異常總數。

The total number of expired leases..en: The total number of expired leases.
The total number of expired leases..id: Jumlah total sewa yang telah habis masa berlakunya.

The total number of failed health checks.en: The total number of failed health checks
The total number of failed health checks.id: Jumlah total pemeriksaan kesehatan yang gagal

The total number of failed learner promo.en: The total number of failed learner promotions (likely learner not ready) while this member is leader.
The total number of failed learner promo.id: Jumlah total promosi pelajar yang gagal (kemungkinan pelajar belum siap) saat anggota ini menjadi pemimpin.
The total number of failed learner promo.zh: 当该成员担任领导者时，学习者升级失败的总数（可能是学习者尚未准备好）。
The total number of failed learner promo.zh-hant: 當該成員擔任領導者時，學習者升級失敗的總數（可能是學習者尚未準備好）。

The total number of failed page faults h.en: The total number of failed page faults happened in the page cache.
The total number of failed page faults h.id: Jumlah total kesalahan halaman yang gagal terjadi di cache halaman.
The total number of failed page faults h.zh: 页缓存中发生的失败页错误总数。
The total number of failed page faults h.zh-hant: 頁快取中發生的失敗頁錯誤總數。

The total number of failed proposals see.en: The total number of failed proposals seen.
The total number of failed proposals see.id: Jumlah total proposal yang gagal terlihat.

The total number of failed read indexes.en: The total number of failed read indexes seen.
The total number of failed read indexes.id: Jumlah total indeks gagal dibaca yang terlihat.
The total number of failed read indexes.zh: 看到的失败读取索引总数。
The total number of failed read indexes.zh-hant: 看到的失敗讀取索引總數。

The total number of garbage collections.en: The total number of garbage collections that have occurred.
The total number of garbage collections.id: Jumlah total pengumpulan sampah yang telah terjadi.
The total number of garbage collections.zh: 已发生的垃圾收集总数。
The total number of garbage collections.zh-hant: 已發生的垃圾收集總數。

The total number of getmore operations,.en: The total number of getmore operations, which are operations that request an additional set of operations from the replication sync source.
The total number of getmore operations,.id: Jumlah total operasi getmore, yaitu operasi yang meminta serangkaian operasi tambahan dari sumber sinkronisasi replikasi.
The total number of getmore operations,.zh: getmore 操作的总数，这些操作是从复制同步源请求一组附加操作的操作。
The total number of getmore operations,.zh-hant: getmore 操作的總數，這些操作是從複製同步來源請求一組附加操作的操作。

The total number of granted leases..en: The total number of granted leases.

The total number of heap objects allocat.en: The total number of heap objects allocated.
The total number of heap objects allocat.id: Jumlah total objek heap yang dialokasikan.

The total number of idle threads in the.en: The total number of idle threads in the jetty pool.
The total number of idle threads in the.id: Jumlah total thread menganggur di jetty pool.
The total number of idle threads in the.zh: jetty 池中的空闲线程总数。
The total number of idle threads in the.zh-hant: jetty 池中的空閒線程總數。

The total number of index items scanned.en: The total number of index items scanned during queries and query-plan evaluation.
The total number of index items scanned.id: Jumlah total item indeks yang dipindai selama kueri dan evaluasi rencana kueri.
The total number of index items scanned.zh: 查询和查询计划评估期间扫描的索引项总数。
The total number of index items scanned.zh-hant: 查詢和查詢計劃評估期間掃描的索引項總數。

The total number of index pages read fro.en: The total number of index pages read from the table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The total number of index pages read fro.id: Jumlah total halaman indeks yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The total number of index pages read fro.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的表空间容器中读取的索引页总数。
The total number of index pages read fro.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的表空間容器中讀取的索引頁總數。

The total number of indexed documents..en: The total number of indexed documents.

The total number of insert operations re.en: The total number of insert operations received since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of insert operations re.id: Jumlah total operasi penyisipan yang diterima sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of insert operations re.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来收到的插入操作总数。
The total number of insert operations re.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來收到的插入操作總數。

The total number of kilobytes read acros.en: The total number of kilobytes read across all devices used by Elasticsearch since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes read acros.id: Jumlah total kilobyte yang dibaca di seluruh perangkat yang digunakan oleh Elasticsearch sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes read acros.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来 Elasticsearch 使用的所有设备读取的总千字节数。
The total number of kilobytes read acros.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來 Elasticsearch 使用的所有裝置讀取的總千位元組數。

The total number of kilobytes read for t.en: The total number of kilobytes read for the device since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes read for t.id: Jumlah total kilobyte yang dibaca perangkat sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes read for t.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来设备读取的总千字节数。
The total number of kilobytes read for t.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來裝置讀取的總千位元組數。

The total number of kilobytes written ac.en: The total number of kilobytes written across all devices used by Elasticsearch since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes written ac.id: Jumlah total kilobyte yang ditulis di seluruh perangkat yang digunakan oleh Elasticsearch sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes written ac.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来在 Elasticsearch 使用的所有设备上写入的总千字节数。
The total number of kilobytes written ac.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來在 Elasticsearch 使用的所有裝置上寫入的總千位元組數。

The total number of kilobytes written fo.en: The total number of kilobytes written for the device since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes written fo.id: Jumlah total kilobyte yang ditulis untuk perangkat sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of kilobytes written fo.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来为设备写入的总千字节数。
The total number of kilobytes written fo.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來為裝置寫入的總千位元組數。

The total number of known nodes in the c.en: The total number of known nodes in the cluster, including nodes in HANDSHAKE state that may not currently be proper members of the cluster.
The total number of known nodes in the c.id: Jumlah total node yang diketahui dalam cluster, termasuk node dalam status HANDSHAKE yang saat ini mungkin bukan anggota cluster yang tepat.
The total number of known nodes in the c.zh: 集群中已知节点的总数，包括当前可能不是集群正确成员的处于握手状态的节点。
The total number of known nodes in the c.zh-hant: 叢集中已知節點的總數，包括目前可能不是叢集正確成員的處於握手狀態的節點。

The total number of leader heartbeat sen.en: The total number of leader heartbeat send failures (likely overloaded from slow disk).
The total number of leader heartbeat sen.id: Jumlah total kegagalan pengiriman detak jantung pemimpin (kemungkinan kelebihan beban dari disk lambat).
The total number of leader heartbeat sen.zh: 领导者心跳发送失败的总数（可能因慢速磁盘而过载）。
The total number of leader heartbeat sen.zh-hant: 領導者心跳發送失敗的總數（可能因慢速磁碟而過載）。

The total number of live threads includi.en: The total number of live threads including daemon and non-daemon threads.
The total number of live threads includi.id: Jumlah total thread aktif termasuk thread daemon dan non-daemon.
The total number of live threads includi.zh: 活动线程总数，包括守护线程和非守护线程。
The total number of live threads includi.zh-hant: 活動線程總數，包括守護線程和非守護線程。

The total number of live threads..en: The total number of live threads.

The total number of logical reads (cumul.en: The total number of logical reads (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of logical reads (cumul.id: Jumlah total pembacaan logis (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of logical reads (cumul.zh: 逻辑读取总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of logical reads (cumul.zh-hant: 邏輯讀取總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of logical writes (cumu.en: The total number of logical writes (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of logical writes (cumu.id: Jumlah total penulisan logis (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of logical writes (cumu.zh: 逻辑写入总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of logical writes (cumu.zh-hant: 邏輯寫入總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of lookup index populat.en: The total number of lookup index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of lookup index populat.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks pencarian yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of lookup index populat.zh: 已完成的查找索引填充作业总数。
The total number of lookup index populat.zh-hant: 已完成的查找索引填入作業總數。

The total number of messages received vi.en: The total number of messages received via Bolt since startup. Useful to track general message activity in combination with other metrics.
The total number of messages received vi.id: Jumlah total pesan yang diterima melalui Bolt sejak startup. Berguna untuk melacak aktivitas pesan umum yang dikombinasikan dengan metrik lainnya.
The total number of messages received vi.zh: 自启动以来通过 Bolt 接收的消息总数。结合其他指标可用于跟踪一般消息活动。
The total number of messages received vi.zh-hant: 自啟動以來透過 Bolt 接收的訊息總數。結合其他指標可用於追蹤一般訊息活動。

The total number of messages that have f.en: The total number of messages that have failed while processing. A high number of failures may indicate an issue with the server and further investigation of the logs is recommended.
The total number of messages that have f.id: Jumlah total pesan yang gagal saat diproses. Jumlah kegagalan yang tinggi mungkin mengindikasikan adanya masalah pada server dan disarankan untuk melakukan penyelidikan lebih lanjut terhadap log tersebut.
The total number of messages that have f.zh: 处理时失败的消息总数。大量失败可能表明服务器存在问题，建议进一步调查日志。
The total number of messages that have f.zh-hant: 處理時失敗的訊息總數。大量失敗可能表示伺服器有問題，建議進一步調查日誌。

The total number of messages that have s.en: The total number of messages that have started processing since being received. A received message may have begun processing until a Bolt worker thread becomes available. A large gap observed between `bolt.messages_received` and `bolt.messages_started` could indicate the server is running at capacity.
The total number of messages that have s.id: Jumlah total pesan yang sudah mulai diproses sejak diterima. Pesan yang diterima mungkin sudah mulai diproses hingga thread pekerja Bolt tersedia. Kesenjangan besar yang terlihat antara `bolt.messages_received` dan `bolt.messages_started` dapat menunjukkan bahwa server berjalan pada kapasitasnya.
The total number of messages that have s.zh: 自收到以来已开始处理的消息总数。收到的消息可能已经开始处理，直到 Bolt 工作线程变得可用。在“bolt.messages_received”和“bolt.messages_started”之间观察到的较大差距可能表明服务器正在满负荷运行。
The total number of messages that have s.zh-hant: 自收到以來已開始處理的訊息總數。收到的訊息可能已經開始處理，直到 Bolt 工作執行緒變得可用。在“bolt.messages_received”和“bolt.messages_started”之間觀察到的較大差距可能表明伺服器正在滿載運行。

The total number of nodes in the databas.en: The total number of nodes in the database. A rough metric of how big your graph is. And if you are running a bulk insert operation you can see this tick up.
The total number of nodes in the databas.id: Jumlah total node dalam database. Metrik kasar tentang seberapa besar grafik Anda. Dan jika Anda menjalankan operasi penyisipan massal, Anda dapat melihat tanda centang ini.
The total number of nodes in the databas.zh: 数据库中的节点总数。图表大小的粗略衡量标准。如果您正在运行批量插入操作，您可以看到此标记。
The total number of nodes in the databas.zh-hant: 資料庫中的節點總數。圖表大小的粗略衡量標準。如果您正在執行批次插入操作，您可以看到此標記。

The total number of nodes stored in the.en: The total number of nodes stored in the database. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads, which could correspond with some behavior you are investigating.
The total number of nodes stored in the.id: Jumlah total node yang disimpan dalam database. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan muatan data yang besar, yang mungkin berhubungan dengan beberapa perilaku yang Anda selidiki.
The total number of nodes stored in the.zh: 数据库中存储的节点总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明数据负载较大，这可能与您正在调查的某些行为相对应。
The total number of nodes stored in the.zh-hant: 資料庫中儲存的節點總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。尖峰或大幅增加表示資料負載較大，這可能與您正在調查的某些行為相對應。

The total number of nodes that are runni.en: The total number of nodes that are running updated daemon pod.
The total number of nodes that are runni.id: Jumlah total node yang menjalankan pod daemon yang diperbarui.
The total number of nodes that are runni.zh: 正在运行更新的守护程序 pod 的节点总数。
The total number of nodes that are runni.zh-hant: 正在運行更新的守護程序 pod 的節點總數。

The total number of nodes that should be.en: The total number of nodes that should be running the daemon pod (including nodes correctly running the daemon pod).
The total number of nodes that should be.id: Jumlah total node yang harus menjalankan daemon pod (termasuk node yang menjalankan daemon pod dengan benar).
The total number of nodes that should be.zh: 应运行守护程序 pod 的节点总数（包括正确运行守护程序 pod 的节点）。
The total number of nodes that should be.zh-hant: 應運行守護程序 pod 的節點總數（包括正確運行守護程序 pod 的節點）。

The total number of opened files on the.en: The total number of opened files on the host machine. This is a system-wide metric, it includes all the processes on the host machine, not just `clickhouse-server`.
The total number of opened files on the.id: Jumlah total file yang dibuka di mesin host. Ini adalah metrik seluruh sistem, mencakup semua proses pada mesin host, bukan hanya `clickhouse-server`.
The total number of opened files on the.zh: 主机上打开的文件总数。这是一个系统范围的指标，它包括主机上的所有进程，而不仅仅是“clickhouse-server”。
The total number of opened files on the.zh-hant: 主機上開啟的檔案總數。這是一個系統範圍的指標，它包括主機上的所有進程，而不僅僅是「clickhouse-server」。

The total number of operations read from.en: The total number of operations read from the replication source.
The total number of operations read from.id: Jumlah total operasi yang dibaca dari sumber replikasi.
The total number of operations read from.zh: 从复制源读取的操作总数。
The total number of operations read from.zh-hant: 從複製來源讀取的操作總數。

The total number of oplog operations app.en: The total number of oplog operations applied. metrics.repl.apply.ops is incremented after each operation.
The total number of oplog operations app.id: Jumlah total operasi oplog yang diterapkan. metrics.repl.apply.ops bertambah setelah setiap operasi.
The total number of oplog operations app.zh: 应用的 oplog 操作总数。 metrics.repl.apply.ops 在每次操作后都会递增。
The total number of oplog operations app.zh-hant: 應用的 oplog 操作總數。 metrics.repl.apply.ops 在每次操作後都會增加。

The total number of packets sent by each.en: The total number of packets sent by each network card is accumulated. Collected from /proc/net/dev.
The total number of packets sent by each.id: Jumlah total paket yang dikirim oleh setiap kartu jaringan diakumulasikan. Dikumpulkan dari /proc/net/dev.
The total number of packets sent by each.zh: 累加各网卡发送的数据包总数。从 /proc/net/dev 收集。
The total number of packets sent by each.zh-hant: 累加各網卡發送的資料包總數。從 /proc/net/dev 收集。

The total number of page copies happened.en: The total number of page copies happened in the page cache.
The total number of page copies happened.id: Jumlah total salinan halaman yang terjadi di cache halaman.
The total number of page copies happened.zh: 页面缓存中发生的页面副本总数。
The total number of page copies happened.zh-hant: 頁面快取中發生的頁面副本總數。

The total number of page evictions execu.en: The total number of page evictions executed by the page cache.
The total number of page evictions execu.id: Jumlah total penggusuran halaman yang dilakukan oleh cache halaman.
The total number of page evictions execu.zh: 页面缓存执行的页面驱逐总数。
The total number of page evictions execu.zh-hant: 頁面快取執行的頁面驅逐總數。

The total number of page faults happened.en: The total number of page faults happened in the page cache. If this continues to rise over time, it could be an indication that more page cache is needed.
The total number of page faults happened.id: Jumlah total kesalahan halaman yang terjadi di cache halaman. Jika jumlah ini terus meningkat seiring berjalannya waktu, ini bisa menjadi indikasi bahwa diperlukan lebih banyak cache halaman.
The total number of page faults happened.zh: 页缓存中发生的页错误总数。如果这个值随着时间的推移继续上升，则可能表明需要更多的页面缓存。
The total number of page faults happened.zh-hant: 頁快取中發生的頁錯誤總數。如果這個值隨著時間的推移繼續上升，則可能表示需要更多的頁面快取。

The total number of page faults..en: The total number of page faults.

The total number of page flushes execute.en: The total number of page flushes executed by the page cache.
The total number of page flushes execute.id: Jumlah total pembersihan halaman yang dijalankan oleh cache halaman.
The total number of page flushes execute.zh: 页缓存执行的页刷新总数。
The total number of page flushes execute.zh-hant: 頁快取執行的頁刷新總數。

The total number of page hits happened i.en: The total number of page hits happened in the page cache.
The total number of page hits happened i.id: Jumlah total klik halaman yang terjadi di cache halaman.
The total number of page hits happened i.zh: 页面缓存中发生的页面命中总数。
The total number of page hits happened i.zh-hant: 頁面快取中發生的頁面命中總數。

The total number of page merges executed.en: The total number of page merges executed by the page cache.
The total number of page merges executed.id: Jumlah total penggabungan halaman yang dijalankan oleh cache halaman.
The total number of page merges executed.zh: 页面缓存执行的页面合并总数。
The total number of page merges executed.zh-hant: 頁面快取執行的頁面合併總數。

The total number of page pins executed b.en: The total number of page pins executed by the page cache.
The total number of page pins executed b.id: Jumlah total pin halaman yang dieksekusi oleh cache halaman.
The total number of page pins executed b.zh: 页缓存执行的页引脚总数。
The total number of page pins executed b.zh-hant: 頁快取執行的頁引腳總數。

The total number of page unpins executed.en: The total number of page unpins executed by the page cache.
The total number of page unpins executed.id: Jumlah total pelepasan pin halaman yang dijalankan oleh cache halaman.
The total number of page unpins executed.zh: 页面缓存执行的页面取消固定总数。
The total number of page unpins executed.zh-hant: 頁面快取執行的頁面取消固定總數。

The total number of pages read from the.en: The total number of pages read from the table space containers for temporary, regular and large table spaces.
The total number of pages read from the.id: Jumlah total halaman yang dibaca dari wadah ruang tabel untuk ruang tabel sementara, reguler, dan besar.
The total number of pages read from the.zh: 从临时表空间、常规表空间和大型表空间的表空间容器中读取的页总数。
The total number of pages read from the.zh-hant: 從臨時表空間、常規表空間和大型表空間的表空間容器中讀取的頁總數。

The total number of pages spilled to dis.en: The total number of pages spilled to disk (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of pages spilled to dis.id: Jumlah total halaman yang ditumpahkan ke disk (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of pages spilled to dis.zh: 溢出到磁盘的总页数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of pages spilled to dis.zh-hant: 溢位到磁碟的總頁數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of panics recovered by.en: The total number of panics recovered by the HTTP handler.
The total number of panics recovered by.id: Jumlah total kepanikan yang dipulihkan oleh pengendali HTTP.
The total number of panics recovered by.zh: HTTP 处理程序恢复的恐慌总数。
The total number of panics recovered by.zh-hant: HTTP 處理程序復原的總恐慌數。

The total number of parts detached from.en: The total number of parts detached from MergeTree tables by users with the `ALTER TABLE DETACH` query (as opposed to unexpected, broken or ignored parts). The server does not care about detached parts and they can be removed.
The total number of parts detached from.id: Jumlah total bagian yang terlepas dari tabel MergeTree oleh pengguna dengan kueri `ALTER TABLE DETACH` (berlawanan dengan bagian yang tidak diharapkan, rusak, atau diabaikan). Server tidak peduli dengan bagian yang terlepas dan dapat dihapus.
The total number of parts detached from.zh: 用户使用“ALTER TABLE DETACH”查询从 MergeTree 表分离的部分总数（而不是意外、损坏或忽略的部分）。服务器不关心分离的部分，它们可以被移除。
The total number of parts detached from.zh-hant: 使用者使用「ALTER TABLE DETACH」查詢從 MergeTree 表分離的部分總數（而不是意外、損壞或忽略的部分）。伺服器不關心分離的部分，它們可以被移除。

The total number of parts detached from.en: The total number of parts detached from MergeTree tables. A part can be detached by a user with the `ALTER TABLE DETACH` query or by the server itself it the part is broken, unexpected or unneeded. The server does not care about detached parts and they can be removed.
The total number of parts detached from.id: Jumlah total bagian yang terlepas dari tabel MergeTree. Suatu bagian dapat dilepas oleh pengguna dengan query `ALTER TABLE DETACH` atau oleh server itu sendiri jika bagian tersebut rusak, tidak diharapkan atau tidak dibutuhkan. Server tidak peduli dengan bagian yang terlepas dan dapat dihapus.
The total number of parts detached from.zh: 从 MergeTree 表分离的部分总数。用户可以通过“ALTER TABLE DETACH”查询来分离某个部分，或者在该部分损坏、意外或不需要时由服务器本身分离。服务器不关心分离的部分，它们可以被移除。
The total number of parts detached from.zh-hant: 從 MergeTree 表分離的部分總數。使用者可以透過「ALTER TABLE DETACH」查詢來分離某個部分，或在該部分損壞、意外或不需要時由伺服器本身分離。伺服器不關心分離的部分，它們可以被移除。

The total number of pending read indexes.en: The total number of pending read indexes not in sync with leader's or timed out read index requests.
The total number of pending read indexes.id: Jumlah total indeks baca tertunda yang tidak sinkron dengan permintaan indeks baca pemimpin atau permintaan indeks baca yang waktunya habis.
The total number of pending read indexes.zh: 与领导者不同步或超时的读取索引请求的挂起读取索引总数。
The total number of pending read indexes.zh-hant: 與領導者不同步或逾時的讀取索引請求的掛起讀取索引總數。

The total number of pending tasks..en: The total number of pending tasks.

The total number of physical reads (cumu.en: The total number of physical reads (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of physical reads (cumu.id: Jumlah total pembacaan fisik (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of physical reads (cumu.zh: 物理读取总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of physical reads (cumu.zh-hant: 物理讀取總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of point index populati.en: The total number of point index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of point index populati.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks poin yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of point index populati.zh: 已完成的点指数人口作业总数。
The total number of point index populati.zh-hant: 已完成的點指數人口作業總數。

The total number of point requests that.en: The total number of point requests that have been attempted to be written into a shard on the same (local) node.
The total number of point requests that.id: Jumlah total permintaan titik yang telah dicoba untuk ditulis ke dalam pecahan pada node (lokal) yang sama.
The total number of point requests that.zh: 已尝试写入同一（本地）节点上的分片的点请求总数。
The total number of point requests that.zh-hant: 已嘗試寫入同一（本地）節點上的分片的點請求總數。

The total number of points that were suc.en: The total number of points that were successfully written to subscribers.
The total number of points that were suc.id: Jumlah total poin yang berhasil dituliskan ke pelanggan.
The total number of points that were suc.zh: 成功写入订阅者的总点数。
The total number of points that were suc.zh-hant: 成功寫入訂閱者的總點數。

The total number of pull requests made b.en: The total number of pull requests made by this instance.
The total number of pull requests made b.id: Jumlah total permintaan penarikan yang dibuat oleh instance ini.
The total number of pull requests made b.zh: 此实例发出的拉取请求总数。
The total number of pull requests made b.zh-hant: 此實例發出的拉取請求總數。

The total number of queries executed loc.en: The total number of queries executed locally.
The total number of queries executed loc.id: Jumlah total kueri yang dieksekusi secara lokal.

The total number of queries executed rem.en: The total number of queries executed remotely to a member of a different cluster.
The total number of queries executed rem.id: Jumlah total kueri yang dieksekusi dari jarak jauh ke anggota cluster yang berbeda.
The total number of queries executed rem.zh: 对不同集群的成员远程执行的查询总数。
The total number of queries executed rem.zh-hant: 對不同叢集的成員遠端執行的查詢總數。

The total number of queries executed rem.en: The total number of queries executed remotely to a member of the same cluster.
The total number of queries executed rem.id: Jumlah total kueri yang dieksekusi jarak jauh ke anggota cluster yang sama.
The total number of queries executed rem.zh: 对同一集群的成员远程执行的查询总数。
The total number of queries executed rem.zh-hant: 對同一叢集的成員遠端執行的查詢總數。

The total number of queries received sin.en: The total number of queries received since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of queries received sin.id: Jumlah total kueri yang diterima sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of queries received sin.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来收到的查询总数。
The total number of queries received sin.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來收到的查詢總數。

The total number of queries that encount.en: The total number of queries that encountered write conflicts.
The total number of queries that encount.id: Jumlah total kueri yang mengalami konflik penulisan.
The total number of queries that encount.zh: 遇到写入冲突的查询总数。
The total number of queries that encount.zh-hant: 遇到寫入衝突的查詢總數。

The total number of queries that return.en: The total number of queries that return sorted numbers that cannot perform the sort operation using an index.
The total number of queries that return.id: Jumlah total kueri yang mengembalikan nomor yang diurutkan yang tidak dapat melakukan operasi pengurutan menggunakan indeks.
The total number of queries that return.zh: 返回无法使用索引执行排序操作的已排序数字的查询总数。
The total number of queries that return.zh-hant: 傳回無法使用索引執行排序操作的已排序數字的查詢總數。

The total number of query executions (cu.en: The total number of query executions (cumulative value from Oracle).
The total number of query executions (cu.id: Jumlah total eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari Oracle).
The total number of query executions (cu.zh: 查询执行总数（来自 Oracle 的累积值）。
The total number of query executions (cu.zh-hant: 查詢執行總數（來自 Oracle 的累積值）。

The total number of query executions (cu.en: The total number of query executions (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of query executions (cu.id: Jumlah total eksekusi kueri (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of query executions (cu.zh: 查询执行总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of query executions (cu.zh-hant: 查詢執行總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of range index populati.en: The total number of range index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of range index populati.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks rentang yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of range index populati.zh: 已完成的范围索引人口作业总数。
The total number of range index populati.zh-hant: 已完成的範圍索引人口作業總數。

The total number of read and write opera.en: The total number of read and write operations across all devices used by Elasticsearch completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of read and write opera.id: Jumlah total operasi baca dan tulis di seluruh perangkat yang digunakan oleh Elasticsearch yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of read and write opera.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来 Elasticsearch 使用的所有设备完成的读写操作总数。
The total number of read and write opera.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來 Elasticsearch 使用的所有裝置完成的讀寫作業總數。

The total number of read and write opera.en: The total number of read and write operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of read and write opera.id: Jumlah total operasi baca dan tulis untuk perangkat yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of read and write opera.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来设备完成的读写操作总数。
The total number of read and write opera.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來裝置完成的讀寫操作總數。

The total number of read operations for.en: The total number of read operations for across all devices used by Elasticsearch completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of read operations for.id: Jumlah total operasi baca di seluruh perangkat yang digunakan oleh Elasticsearch yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of read operations for.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来 Elasticsearch 使用的所有设备完成的读取操作总数。
The total number of read operations for.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來 Elasticsearch 使用的所有裝置完成的讀取操作總數。

The total number of read operations for.en: The total number of read operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of read operations for.id: Jumlah total operasi baca untuk perangkat yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of read operations for.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来设备完成的读取操作总数。
The total number of read operations for.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來裝置完成的讀取操作總數。

The total number of receive failures fro.en: The total number of receive failures from peers.
The total number of receive failures fro.id: Jumlah total kegagalan penerimaan dari rekan-rekan.
The total number of receive failures fro.zh: 来自对等方的接收失败总数。
The total number of receive failures fro.zh-hant: 來自對等方的接收失敗總數。

The total number of relationships in the.en: The total number of relationships in the database.

The total number of relationships stored.en: The total number of relationships stored in the database. Informational, not an indication of any issue. Spikes or large increases indicate large data loads, which could correspond with some behavior you are investigating.
The total number of relationships stored.id: Jumlah total hubungan yang disimpan dalam database. Informasional, bukan indikasi masalah apa pun. Lonjakan atau peningkatan yang besar menunjukkan muatan data yang besar, yang mungkin berhubungan dengan beberapa perilaku yang Anda selidiki.
The total number of relationships stored.zh: 数据库中存储的关系总数。仅供参考，不代表任何问题。峰值或大幅增加表明数据负载较大，这可能与您正在调查的某些行为相对应。
The total number of relationships stored.zh-hant: 資料庫中儲存的關係總數。僅供參考，不代表任何問題。尖峰或大幅增加表示資料負載較大，這可能與您正在調查的某些行為相對應。

The total number of replicated commands.en: The total number of replicated commands issued to the database since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated commands.id: Jumlah total perintah yang direplikasi yang dikeluarkan ke database sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated commands.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来向数据库发出的复制命令总数。
The total number of replicated commands.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來向資料庫發出的複製命令總數。

The total number of replicated delete op.en: The total number of replicated delete operations since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated delete op.id: Jumlah total operasi penghapusan yang direplikasi sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated delete op.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来复制的删除操作的总数。
The total number of replicated delete op.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來複製的刪除操作的總數。

The total number of replicated getmore o.en: The total number of replicated getmore operations since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated getmore o.id: Jumlah total operasi getmore yang direplikasi sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated getmore o.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来复制的 getmore 操作的总数。
The total number of replicated getmore o.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來複製的 getmore 操作的總數。

The total number of replicated insert op.en: The total number of replicated insert operations since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated insert op.id: Jumlah total operasi penyisipan yang direplikasi sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated insert op.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来复制的插入操作总数。
The total number of replicated insert op.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來複製的插入操作總數。

The total number of replicated queries s.en: The total number of replicated queries since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated queries s.id: Jumlah total kueri yang direplikasi sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated queries s.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来的复制查询总数。
The total number of replicated queries s.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來的複製查詢總數。

The total number of replicated update op.en: The total number of replicated update operations since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of replicated update op.id: Jumlah total operasi pembaruan yang direplikasi sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of replicated update op.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来复制的更新操作的总数。
The total number of replicated update op.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來複製的更新操作的總數。

The total number of reserved threads use.en: The total number of reserved threads used (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of reserved threads use.id: Jumlah total thread cadangan yang digunakan (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of reserved threads use.zh: 使用的保留线程总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of reserved threads use.zh-hant: 使用的保留執行緒總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of revoked leases..en: The total number of revoked leases.

The total number of rolled back read tra.en: The total number of rolled back read transactions.
The total number of rolled back read tra.id: Jumlah total transaksi baca yang dibatalkan.

The total number of rolled back transact.en: The total number of rolled back transactions.

The total number of rolled back write tr.en: The total number of rolled back write transactions.  Seeing a lot of writes rolled back may indicate various issues with locking, transaction timeouts, etc.
The total number of rolled back write tr.id: Jumlah total transaksi tulis yang dibatalkan.  Melihat banyak penulisan dibatalkan mungkin mengindikasikan berbagai masalah dengan penguncian, batas waktu transaksi, dll.
The total number of rolled back write tr.zh: 回滚的写入事务总数。  看到大量写入回滚可能表明锁定、事务超时等各种问题。
The total number of rolled back write tr.zh-hant: 回滾的寫入事務總數。  看到大量寫入回滾可能表示鎖定、交易逾時等各種問題。

The total number of rows inserted, updat.en: The total number of rows inserted, updated, or deleted.
The total number of rows inserted, updat.id: Jumlah total baris yang disisipkan, diperbarui, atau dihapus.
The total number of rows inserted, updat.zh: 插入、更新或删除的总行数。
The total number of rows inserted, updat.zh-hant: 插入、更新或刪除的總行數。

The total number of rows processed (cumu.en: The total number of rows processed (cumulative value from Oracle).
The total number of rows processed (cumu.id: Jumlah total baris yang diproses (nilai kumulatif dari Oracle).
The total number of rows processed (cumu.zh: 处理的总行数（来自 Oracle 的累积值）。
The total number of rows processed (cumu.zh-hant: 處理的總行數（來自 Oracle 的累積值）。

The total number of rows returned (cumul.en: The total number of rows returned (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of rows returned (cumul.id: Jumlah total baris yang dikembalikan (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of rows returned (cumul.zh: 返回的总行数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of rows returned (cumul.zh-hant: 傳回的總行數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of rows that had to be.en: The total number of rows that had to be read in order to return result sets.
The total number of rows that had to be.id: Jumlah total baris yang harus dibaca untuk mengembalikan kumpulan hasil.
The total number of rows that had to be.zh: 为了返回结果集而必须读取的总行数。
The total number of rows that had to be.zh-hant: 為了傳回結果集而必須讀取的總行數。

The total number of rows that have been.en: The total number of rows that have been selected by and returned to applications.
The total number of rows that have been.id: Jumlah total baris yang telah dipilih dan dikembalikan ke aplikasi.
The total number of rows that have been.zh: 已由应用程序选择并返回到应用程序的总行数。
The total number of rows that have been.zh-hant: 已由應用程式選擇並返回應用程式的總行數。

The total number of seconds waited betwe.en: The total number of seconds waited between query replans.
The total number of seconds waited betwe.id: Jumlah total detik menunggu antara perencanaan ulang kueri.
The total number of seconds waited betwe.zh: 查询重新计划之间等待的总秒数。
The total number of seconds waited betwe.zh-hant: 查詢重新規劃之間等待的總秒數。

The total number of send failures from p.en: The total number of send failures from peers.
The total number of send failures from p.id: Jumlah total kegagalan pengiriman dari rekan-rekan.
The total number of send failures from p.zh: 来自对等方的发送失败总数。
The total number of send failures from p.zh-hant: 來自對等方的發送失敗總數。

The total number of sessions within a te.en: The total number of sessions within a tenant.

The total number of slow apply requests.en: The total number of slow apply requests (likely overloaded from slow disk).
The total number of slow apply requests.id: Jumlah total permintaan penerapan yang lambat (kemungkinan kelebihan beban dari disk yang lambat).
The total number of slow apply requests.zh: 慢速应用请求的总数（可能因慢速磁盘而过载）。
The total number of slow apply requests.zh-hant: 慢速應用請求的總數（可能因慢速磁碟而過載）。

The total number of started transactions.en: The total number of started transactions.

The total number of stream failures from.en: The total number of stream failures from the local server.
The total number of stream failures from.id: Jumlah total kegagalan streaming dari server lokal.
The total number of stream failures from.zh: 来自本地服务器的流失败总数。
The total number of stream failures from.zh-hant: 來自本地伺服器的流失敗總數。

The total number of successful health ch.en: The total number of successful health checks
The total number of successful health ch.id: Jumlah total pemeriksaan kesehatan yang berhasil

The total number of successful learner p.en: The total number of successful learner promotions while this member is leader.
The total number of successful learner p.id: Jumlah total promosi pelajar yang berhasil selama anggota ini menjadi pemimpin.
The total number of successful learner p.zh: 当该成员担任领导者时，成功学习者晋升的总数。
The total number of successful learner p.zh-hant: 當該成員擔任領導者時，成功學習者晉升的總數。

The total number of successful write req.en: The total number of successful write requests.
The total number of successful write req.id: Jumlah total permintaan tulis yang berhasil.

The total number of successful writes..en: The total number of successful writes.

The total number of task slots..en: The total number of task slots.

The total number of terminated read tran.en: The total number of terminated read transactions.
The total number of terminated read tran.id: Jumlah total transaksi baca yang dihentikan.
The total number of terminated read tran.zh: 已终止的读取事务总数。
The total number of terminated read tran.zh-hant: 已終止的讀取事務總數。

The total number of terminated transacti.en: The total number of terminated transactions.

The total number of terminated write tra.en: The total number of terminated write transactions.
The total number of terminated write tra.id: Jumlah total transaksi tulis yang dihentikan.

The total number of text index populatio.en: The total number of text index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of text index populatio.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks teks yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of text index populatio.zh: 已完成的文本索引填充作业总数。
The total number of text index populatio.zh-hant: 已完成的文字索引填入作業總數。

The total number of threads (both idle a.en: The total number of threads (both idle and busy) in the jetty pool.
The total number of threads (both idle a.id: Jumlah total thread (idle dan sibuk) di jetty pool.
The total number of threads (both idle a.zh: jetty 池中的线程总数（空闲和繁忙）。
The total number of threads (both idle a.zh-hant: jetty 池中的總線程數（空閒和繁忙）。

The total number of threads in the Jenki.en: The total number of threads in the Jenkins JVM. This is the sum of: vm.blocked.count, vm.new.count, vm.runnable.count, vm.terminated.count, vm.timed_waiting.count and vm.waiting.count
The total number of threads in the Jenki.id: Jumlah total thread di Jenkins JVM. Ini adalah jumlah dari: vm.blocked.count, vm.new.count, vm.runnable.count, vm.terminated.count, vm.timed_waiting.count dan vm.waiting.count
The total number of threads in the Jenki.zh: Jenkins JVM 中的线程总数。这是以下各项的总和：vm.blocked.count、vm.new.count、vm.runnable.count、vm.terminate.count、vm.timed_waiting.count 和 vm.waiting.count
The total number of threads in the Jenki.zh-hant: Jenkins JVM 中的總線程數。這是以下各項的總和：vm.blocked.count、vm.new.count、vm.runnable.count、vm.terminate.count、vm.timed_waiting.count 和 vm.waiting.count

The total number of threads, as the OS k.en: The total number of threads, as the OS kernel scheduler seeing it.
The total number of threads, as the OS k.id: Jumlah total thread, seperti yang dilihat oleh penjadwal kernel OS.
The total number of threads, as the OS k.zh: 操作系统内核调度程序看到的线程总数。
The total number of threads, as the OS k.zh-hant: 作業系統內核調度程序看到的總線程數。

The total number of times `Cypher` has d.en: The total number of times `Cypher` has decided to re-plan a query. Neo4j caches 1000 plans by default. Seeing sustained replanning events or large spikes could indicate an issue that needs to be investigated.
The total number of times `Cypher` has d.id: Total berapa kali `Cypher` memutuskan untuk merencanakan ulang kueri. Neo4j menyimpan 1000 paket secara default. Melihat peristiwa perencanaan ulang yang berkelanjutan atau lonjakan besar dapat mengindikasikan adanya masalah yang perlu diselidiki.
The total number of times `Cypher` has d.zh: `Cypher` 决定重新计划查询的总次数。 Neo4j 默认缓存 1000 个计划。看到持续的重新计划事件或大幅峰值可能表明存在需要调查的问题。
The total number of times `Cypher` has d.zh-hant: `Cypher` 決定重新規劃查詢的總次數。 Neo4j 預設快取 1000 個方案。看到持續的重新規劃事件或大幅高峰可能表示存在需要調查的問題。

The total number of times fulltext index.en: The total number of times fulltext indexes have been queried.
The total number of times fulltext index.id: Total berapa kali indeks teks lengkap ditanyakan.
The total number of times fulltext index.zh: 全文索引被查询的总次数。
The total number of times fulltext index.zh-hant: 全文索引被查詢的總次數。

The total number of times lookup indexes.en: The total number of times lookup indexes have been queried.
The total number of times lookup indexes.id: Total berapa kali indeks pencarian ditanyakan.
The total number of times lookup indexes.zh: 查询查找索引的总次数。
The total number of times lookup indexes.zh-hant: 查詢查找索引的總次數。

The total number of times page cache flu.en: The total number of times page cache flush IO limiter was throttled during ongoing IO operations.
The total number of times page cache flu.id: Total berapa kali pembatas IO pembersihan cache halaman dibatasi selama operasi IO yang sedang berlangsung.
The total number of times page cache flu.zh: 在正在进行的 IO 操作期间页面缓存刷新 IO 限制器受到限制的总次数。
The total number of times page cache flu.zh-hant: 在正在進行的 IO 操作期間頁面快取刷新 IO 限制器受到限制的總次數。

The total number of times point indexes.en: The total number of times point indexes have been queried.
The total number of times point indexes.id: Total berapa kali indeks poin ditanyakan.
The total number of times point indexes.zh: 点索引被查询的总次数。
The total number of times point indexes.zh-hant: 點索引被查詢的總次數。

The total number of times range indexes.en: The total number of times range indexes have been queried.
The total number of times range indexes.id: Total berapa kali indeks rentang ditanyakan.
The total number of times range indexes.zh: 范围索引被查询的总次数。
The total number of times range indexes.zh-hant: 範圍索引被查詢的總次數。

The total number of times text indexes h.en: The total number of times text indexes have been queried.
The total number of times text indexes h.id: Total berapa kali indeks teks ditanyakan.
The total number of times text indexes h.zh: 查询文本索引的总次数。
The total number of times text indexes h.zh-hant: 查詢文字索引的總次數。

The total number of times that a request.en: The total number of times that a request for a table lock could not be granted immediately and a wait was needed.
The total number of times that a request.id: Jumlah total berapa kali permintaan kunci meja tidak dapat langsung dikabulkan dan perlu menunggu.
The total number of times that a request.zh: 无法立即授予表锁请求而需要等待的总次数。
The total number of times that a request.zh-hant: 無法立即授予表鎖請求而需要等待的總次數。

The total number of times vector indexes.en: The total number of times vector indexes have been queried.
The total number of times vector indexes.id: Total berapa kali indeks vektor ditanyakan.
The total number of times vector indexes.zh: 向量索引被查询的总次数。
The total number of times vector indexes.zh-hant: 向量索引被查詢的總次數。

The total number of transaction log flus.en: The total number of transaction log flushes.
The total number of transaction log flus.id: Jumlah total log transaksi yang dihapus.

The total number of transaction log rota.en: The total number of transaction log rotations executed so far.
The total number of transaction log rota.id: Jumlah total rotasi log transaksi yang dijalankan sejauh ini.
The total number of transaction log rota.zh: 迄今为止执行的事务日志轮转总数。
The total number of transaction log rota.zh-hant: 迄今為止執行的交易日誌輪轉總數。

The total number of transaction retries.en: The total number of transaction retries performed by the Raft subsystem.
The total number of transaction retries.id: Jumlah total percobaan ulang transaksi yang dilakukan oleh subsistem Raft.
The total number of transaction retries.zh: Raft 子系统执行的事务重试总数。
The total number of transaction retries.zh-hant: Raft 子系統執行的交易重試總數。

The total number of update operations re.en: The total number of update operations received since the mongod instance last started.
The total number of update operations re.id: Jumlah total operasi pembaruan yang diterima sejak instance mongod terakhir kali dimulai.
The total number of update operations re.zh: 自 mongod 实例上次启动以来收到的更新操作总数。
The total number of update operations re.zh-hant: 自 mongod 實例上次啟動以來收到的更新操作總數。

The total number of used threads (cumula.en: The total number of used threads (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total number of used threads (cumula.id: Jumlah total thread yang digunakan (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total number of used threads (cumula.zh: 使用的线程总数（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total number of used threads (cumula.zh-hant: 使用的執行緒總數（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total number of vector index populat.en: The total number of vector index population jobs that have been completed.
The total number of vector index populat.id: Jumlah total pekerjaan populasi indeks vektor yang telah diselesaikan.
The total number of vector index populat.zh: 已完成的向量索引填充作业总数。
The total number of vector index populat.zh-hant: 已完成的向量索引填入作業總數。

The total number of waits for the event..en: The total number of waits for the event.

The total number of write operations acr.en: The total number of write operations across all devices used by Elasticsearch completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of write operations acr.id: Jumlah total operasi tulis di seluruh perangkat yang digunakan oleh Elasticsearch yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of write operations acr.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来 Elasticsearch 使用的所有设备上完成的写入操作总数。
The total number of write operations acr.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來 Elasticsearch 使用的所有裝置上完成的寫入操作總數。

The total number of write operations for.en: The total number of write operations for the device completed since starting Elasticsearch.
The total number of write operations for.id: Jumlah total operasi penulisan untuk perangkat yang diselesaikan sejak memulai Elasticsearch.
The total number of write operations for.zh: 自启动 Elasticsearch 以来设备完成的写入操作总数。
The total number of write operations for.zh-hant: 自啟動 Elasticsearch 以來裝置完成的寫入操作總數。

The total number of write requests for p.en: The total number of write requests for points that have been dropped due to timestamps not matching any existing retention policies.
The total number of write requests for p.id: Jumlah total permintaan tulis untuk poin yang dibatalkan karena stempel waktu tidak cocok dengan kebijakan penyimpanan yang ada.
The total number of write requests for p.zh: 由于时间戳与任何现有保留策略不匹配而被删除的点的写入请求总数。
The total number of write requests for p.zh-hant: 由於時間戳與任何現有保留策略不符而被刪除的點的寫入請求總數。

The total number of write requests that.en: The total number of write requests that failed due to errors.
The total number of write requests that.id: Jumlah total permintaan tulis yang gagal karena kesalahan.
The total number of write requests that.zh: 由于错误而失败的写入请求总数。
The total number of write requests that.zh-hant: 由於錯誤而失敗的寫入請求總數。

The total number of write requests that.en: The total number of write requests that failed to complete within the default write timeout duration.
The total number of write requests that.id: Jumlah total permintaan tulis yang gagal diselesaikan dalam durasi waktu tunggu tulis default.
The total number of write requests that.zh: 在默认写入超时时间内未能完成的写入请求总数。
The total number of write requests that.zh-hant: 在預設寫入逾時時間內未能完成的寫入請求總數。

The total number of write requests..en: The total number of write requests.

The total number of writes dropped due t.en: The total number of writes dropped due to timeouts.
The total number of writes dropped due t.id: Jumlah total penulisan menurun karena waktu habis.
The total number of writes dropped due t.zh: 由于超时，写入总数下降。
The total number of writes dropped due t.zh-hant: 由於超時，寫入總數下降。

The total number of writes that failed..en: The total number of writes that failed.

The total query execution time(nanosecon.en: The total query execution time(nanosecond) per normalized query and schema (cumulative).
The total query execution time(nanosecon.id: Total waktu eksekusi kueri (nanodetik) per kueri dan skema yang dinormalisasi (kumulatif).
The total query execution time(nanosecon.zh: 每个规范化查询和架构的总查询执行时间（纳秒）（累积）。
The total query execution time(nanosecon.zh-hant: 每個規範化查詢和架構的總查詢執行時間（奈秒）（累積）。

The total query request duration, in nan.en: The total query request duration, in nanosecond (ns).
The total query request duration, in nan.id: Total durasi permintaan kueri, dalam nanodetik (ns).
The total query request duration, in nan.zh: 总查询请求持续时间，以纳秒 (ns) 为单位。
The total query request duration, in nan.zh-hant: 總查詢請求持續時間，以奈秒 (ns) 為單位。

The total size in bytes of the disk (vir.en: The total size in bytes of the disk (virtual filesystem). Remote `filesystems` can show a large value like 16 EiB.
The total size in bytes of the disk (vir.id: Ukuran total dalam byte disk (sistem file virtual). `Sistem file` jarak jauh dapat menampilkan nilai besar seperti 16 EiB.
The total size in bytes of the disk (vir.zh: 磁盘（虚拟文件系统）的总大小（以字节为单位）。远程“文件系统”可以显示一个很大的值，例如 16 EiB。
The total size in bytes of the disk (vir.zh-hant: 磁碟（虛擬檔案系統）的總大小（以位元組為單位）。遠端「檔案系統」可以顯示一個很大的值，例如 16 EiB。

The total size of all dirty CPU schedule.en: The total size of all dirty CPU scheduler run queues.
The total size of all dirty CPU schedule.id: Ukuran total semua antrian penjadwal CPU yang kotor.
The total size of all dirty CPU schedule.zh: 所有脏 CPU 调度程序运行队列的总大小。
The total size of all dirty CPU schedule.zh-hant: 所有髒 CPU 調度程序運行佇列的總大小。

The total size of all indexes created on.en: The total size of all indexes created on this database.
The total size of all indexes created on.id: Ukuran total semua indeks yang dibuat pada database ini.
The total size of all indexes created on.zh: 在此数据库上创建的所有索引的总大小。
The total size of all indexes created on.zh-hant: 在此資料庫上建立的所有索引的總大小。

The total size of all indexes..en: The total size of all indexes.

The total size of all normal run queues..en: The total size of all normal run queues.
The total size of all normal run queues..id: Ukuran total semua antrian yang dijalankan normal.
The total size of all normal run queues..zh: 所有正常运行队列的总大小。
The total size of all normal run queues..zh-hant: 所有正常運行隊列的總大小。

The total size of put kv pairs seen by t.en: The total size of put kv pairs seen by this member.
The total size of put kv pairs seen by t.id: Ukuran total pasangan put kv yang dilihat oleh anggota ini.
The total size of put kv pairs seen by t.zh: 该成员看到的 put kv 对的总大小。
The total size of put kv pairs seen by t.zh-hant: 該成員看到的 put kv 對的總大小。

The total size of the database and trans.en: The total size of the database and transaction logs, in bytes. The total size of the database helps determine how much cache page is required. It also helps compare the total disk space used by the data store and how much is available.
The total size of the database and trans.id: Ukuran total database dan log transaksi, dalam byte. Ukuran total database membantu menentukan berapa banyak halaman cache yang diperlukan. Ini juga membantu membandingkan total ruang disk yang digunakan oleh penyimpanan data dan berapa banyak yang tersedia.
The total size of the database and trans.zh: 数据库和事务日志的总大小（以字节为单位）。数据库的总大小有助于确定需要多少缓存页。它还有助于比较数据存储使用的总磁盘空间以及可用空间。
The total size of the database and trans.zh-hant: 資料庫和交易日誌的總大小（以位元組為單位）。資料庫的總大小有助於確定需要多少快取頁。它還有助於比較資料儲存所使用的總磁碟空間以及可用空間。

The total size of the table space in byt.en: The total size of the table space in bytes.
The total size of the table space in byt.id: Ukuran total ruang tabel dalam byte.
The total size of the table space in byt.zh: 表空间的总大小（以字节为单位）。
The total size of the table space in byt.zh-hant: 表空間的總大小（以位元組為單位）。

The total size of the uncompressed data.en: The total size of the uncompressed data held in this database. The dataSize decreases when you remove documents.
The total size of the uncompressed data.id: Ukuran total data terkompresi yang disimpan dalam database ini. dataSize berkurang saat Anda menghapus dokumen.
The total size of the uncompressed data.zh: 此数据库中保存的未压缩数据的总大小。当您删除文档时，数据大小会减小。
The total size of the uncompressed data.zh-hant: 此資料庫中保存的未壓縮資料的總大小。當您刪除文件時，資料大小會減少。

The total size on disk of all data and v.en: The total size on disk of all data and view files for this bucket.
The total size on disk of all data and v.id: Ukuran total semua data dan file tampilan pada disk untuk bucket ini.
The total size on disk of all data and v.zh: 此存储桶的所有数据和视图文件在磁盘上的总大小。
The total size on disk of all data and v.zh-hant: 此儲存桶的所有資料和視圖檔案在磁碟上的總大小。

The total time (in nanoseconds) threads.en: The total time (in nanoseconds) threads have been delayed while waiting for spinlocks in TCMalloc.
The total time (in nanoseconds) threads.id: Total waktu (dalam nanodetik) thread telah tertunda saat menunggu spinlock di TCMalloc.
The total time (in nanoseconds) threads.zh: 线程在 TCMalloc 中等待自旋锁时被延迟的总时间（以纳秒为单位）。
The total time (in nanoseconds) threads.zh-hant: 線程在 TCMalloc 中等待自旋鎖時被延遲的總時間（以奈秒為單位）。

The total time (microseconds) spent insi.en: The total time (microseconds) spent inside CLR (cumulative value from SQL Server).
The total time (microseconds) spent insi.id: Total waktu (mikrodetik) yang dihabiskan di dalam CLR (nilai kumulatif dari SQL Server).
The total time (microseconds) spent insi.zh: CLR 内花费的总时间（微秒）（来自 SQL Server 的累积值）。
The total time (microseconds) spent insi.zh-hant: CLR 內花費的總時間（微秒）（來自 SQL Server 的累積值）。

The total time application threads spend.en: The total time application threads spend reading pages from the WiredTiger cache.
The total time application threads spend.id: Total waktu yang dihabiskan thread aplikasi untuk membaca halaman dari cache WiredTiger.
The total time application threads spend.zh: 应用程序线程从 WiredTiger 缓存读取页面所花费的总时间。
The total time application threads spend.zh-hant: 應用程式執行緒從 WiredTiger 快取讀取頁面所花費的總時間。

The total time garbage collection cycles.en: The total time garbage collection cycles are paused in nanoseconds.
The total time garbage collection cycles.id: Total waktu siklus pengumpulan sampah dijeda dalam nanodetik.
The total time garbage collection cycles.zh: 垃圾收集周期暂停的总时间（以纳秒为单位）。
The total time garbage collection cycles.zh-hant: 垃圾收集週期暫停的總時間（以奈秒為單位）。

The total time in milliseconds that the.en: The total time in milliseconds that the page cache flush IO limiter throttled ongoing IO operations.
The total time in milliseconds that the.id: Total waktu dalam milidetik saat pembatas IO pembersihan cache halaman membatasi operasi IO yang sedang berlangsung.
The total time in milliseconds that the.zh: 页面缓存刷新 IO 限制器限制正在进行的 IO 操作的总时间（以毫秒为单位）。
The total time in milliseconds that the.zh-hant: 頁面快取刷新 IO 限制器限制正在進行的 IO 操作的總時間（以毫秒為單位）。

The total time in milliseconds the broke.en: The total time in milliseconds the broker has taken to service requests
The total time in milliseconds the broke.id: Total waktu dalam milidetik yang dibutuhkan broker untuk melayani permintaan
The total time in milliseconds the broke.zh: 代理处理请求所花费的总时间（以毫秒为单位）

The value is similar to `OSGuestNiceTime.en: The value is similar to `OSGuestNiceTime` but divided to the number of CPU cores to be measured in the [0..1] interval regardless of the number of cores. This allows you to average the values of this metric across multiple servers in a cluster even if the number of cores is non-uniform, and still get the average resource utilization metric.
The value is similar to `OSGuestNiceTime.id: Nilainya mirip dengan `OSGuestNiceTime` tetapi dibagi dengan jumlah inti CPU yang akan diukur dalam interval [0..1] berapa pun jumlah inti. Hal ini memungkinkan Anda untuk menghitung rata-rata nilai metrik ini di beberapa server dalam sebuah cluster meskipun jumlah inti tidak seragam, dan tetap mendapatkan metrik pemanfaatan sumber daya rata-rata.
The value is similar to `OSGuestNiceTime.zh: 该值与 OSGuestNiceTime 类似，但除以 [0..1] 区间内要测量的 CPU 核心数，而与核心数无关。这样，即使核心数量不一致，您也可以在集群中的多个服务器上平均该指标的值，并且仍然可以获得平均资源利用率指标。
The value is similar to `OSGuestNiceTime.zh-hant: 該值與 OSGuestNiceTime 類似，但除以 [0..1] 區間內要測量的 CPU 核心數，而與核心數無關。這樣，即使核心數量不一致，您也可以在叢集中的多個伺服器上平均該指標的值，並且仍然可以獲得平均資源利用率指標。

The value is similar to `OSSystemTime` b.zh: 该值与“OSSystemTime”类似，但除以要在 [0..1] 区间内测量的 CPU 核心数，而与核心数无关。这样，即使核心数量不一致，您也可以在集群中的多个服务器上平均该指标的值，并且仍然可以获得平均资源利用率指标。
The value is similar to `OSSystemTime` b.zh-hant: 該值與「OSSystemTime」類似，但除以要在 [0..1] 區間內測量的 CPU 核心數，而與核心數無關。這樣，即使核心數量不一致，您也可以在叢集中的多個伺服器上平均該指標的值，並且仍然可以獲得平均資源利用率指標。

The value is similar to `OSUserTime` but.en: The value is similar to `OSUserTime` but divided to the number of CPU cores to be measured in the [0..1] interval regardless of the number of cores. This allows you to average the values of this metric across multiple servers in a cluster even if the number of cores is non-uniform, and still get the average resource utilization metric.
The value is similar to `OSUserTime` but.id: Nilainya mirip dengan `OSUserTime` tetapi dibagi dengan jumlah inti CPU yang akan diukur dalam interval [0..1] berapa pun jumlah inti. Hal ini memungkinkan Anda untuk menghitung rata-rata nilai metrik ini di beberapa server dalam sebuah cluster meskipun jumlah inti tidak seragam, dan tetap mendapatkan metrik pemanfaatan sumber daya rata-rata.
The value is similar to `OSUserTime` but.zh: 该值与 OSUserTime 类似，但除以 [0..1] 区间内要测量的 CPU 核心数，而与核心数无关。这样，即使核心数量不一致，您也可以在集群中的多个服务器上平均该指标的值，并且仍然可以获得平均资源利用率指标。
